title_zh: InfiGUIAgent：具备原生推理与反思能力的多模态通用图形界面智能体
one_line: Two-stage supervised training adds hierarchical reasoning and reflection; grounding improves, with limited AndroidWorld task success.
one_line_zh: 两阶段监督微调加入推理反思，定位提升但在线成功率仍低。

title_zh: 交互中学习：面向真实环境自适应智能体的数据中心框架
one_line: Hindsight instruction synthesis and retrieval improve web and desktop agents, but synthesis shares evaluation environments and filtering judges lack validation.
one_line_zh: 回溯指令合成与检索提升网页桌面智能体，但合成评测环境重叠。

title_zh: Mobile-Agent-E：面向复杂任务的自进化移动助手
one_line: A manager separates planning from execution while reflection and reusable memory improve real-device tasks; human audits and runtime measurements support the design.
one_line_zh: 分层规划、反思和经验记忆改善真机任务，并有人审及耗时分析。

title_zh: UI-TARS：以原生智能体开拓自动化图形界面交互
one_line: A native policy combines perception, unified actions, reasoning, and iterative training; desktop and mobile execution improve, but supplied methods are incomplete.
one_line_zh: 原生策略统一感知动作与推理，桌面手机执行提升，方法节缺失。

title_zh: GUI-Bee：通过自主探索将界面动作定位适配到新环境
one_line: Graph-guided exploration synthesizes environment-specific grounding data; matched-model static tests improve, without end-to-end execution or held-out exploration environments.
one_line_zh: 图探索合成环境专属定位数据，静态定位提升但无端到端执行评测。

title_zh: ReachAgent：通过页面到达与操作增强移动智能体
one_line: Hindsight flow tasks, reaching-operation subtasks, and preference tuning improve offline mobile action matching; random-walk coverage and task validity remain limited.
one_line_zh: 回溯任务、到达操作子任务及偏好训练提升离线动作匹配。

title_zh: MobileA3gent：利用多用户分布式自采数据训练移动图形界面智能体
one_line: Local hindsight instruction annotation and federated aggregation reduce annotation costs; mostly offline comparisons include a small unseen-environment AndroidWorld check.
one_line_zh: 本地回溯标注与联邦聚合降低成本，主要离线评测辅以在线泛化。

title_zh: AppVLM：面向在线应用控制的轻量视觉语言模型
one_line: Offline initialization followed by successful-rollout self-training improves AndroidWorld success and latency; repeated updates degrade offline accuracy and evaluation reuses adaptation tasks.
one_line_zh: 离线初始化后用成功轨迹自训练，提升在线成功率与速度但存在遗忘。

title_zh: InSTA：迈向互联网规模的智能体训练
one_line: A proposer-agent-judge pipeline refines tasks across 150,000 sites; filtered training yields small web agents, with judge reliability measured but experiment details truncated.
one_line_zh: 提议执行评判闭环生成大规模网页任务，小模型获益但实验节缺失。

title_zh: 网页智能体的共生协作：发挥大小语言模型的互补优势
one_line: AgentSymbiotic couples trajectory retrieval, student exploration, and distillation, improving live WebArena success without held-out environments or repeated trials.
one_line_zh: 轨迹检索与大小模型共生蒸馏提升网页任务成功率。

title_zh: 通过变分子目标条件强化学习提升自主视觉语言智能体
one_line: VSC-RL combines generated subgoals, advantage-weighted updates, and reference-policy regularization, improving interactive Android and web task success.
one_line_zh: 子目标奖励与参考策略约束提升安卓及网页强化学习。

title_zh: TRISHUL：面向大型视觉语言界面智能体的区域识别与屏幕层级理解
one_line: TRISHUL combines hierarchical SAM/OCR parsing and contextual element descriptions, improving static grounding while remaining limited by missed proposals.
one_line_zh: 分层屏幕解析与语义描述改善定位，漏检仍限制性能。

title_zh: Explorer：规模化探索驱动的多模态网页智能体轨迹合成
one_line: Explorer refines tasks during live exploration, filters trajectories with a human-audited verifier, and improves online web performance and zero-shot MiniWoB transfer.
one_line_zh: 实时探索合成轨迹，经人工校验的验证器筛选后提升迁移。

title_zh: Magma：面向多模态人工智能体的基础模型
one_line: Magma unifies heterogeneous action data through Set-of-Mark and Trace-of-Mark pretraining, improving offline GUI grounding and action prediction.
one_line_zh: 标记与轨迹标记统一异构动作预训练，提升离线界面能力。

title_zh: PC-Agent：面向复杂电脑任务自动化的分层多智能体协作框架
one_line: PC-Agent combines active perception, hierarchical progress tracking, and screenshot reflection; matched-backbone ablations improve human-checked execution on 25 desktop tasks.
one_line_zh: 主动感知与分层反思提升二十五项电脑任务的执行表现。

title_zh: Digi-Q：学习用于设备控制智能体训练的动作价值函数
one_line: Digi-Q learns offline TD critics on tuned frozen features and distills best-ranked candidate actions, improving Android execution with three-run uncertainty estimates.
one_line_zh: 离线时序差分价值学习与候选动作蒸馏提升安卓执行。

title_zh: MobileSteward：融合自进化应用专属多智能体以自动执行跨应用指令
one_line: MobileSteward schedules app-specialized agents through information-flow graphs, reflection, and evolving memories, improving interactive cross-app tasks with token and completion-error reporting.
one_line_zh: 信息流调度与进化记忆改善跨应用执行，并报告成本。

title_zh: VEM：利用价值环境模型开展无环境交互的界面智能体探索训练
one_line: VEM trains a GPT-labeled frozen action-value model to reward offline PPO, with human-agreement audits and modest live Android gains.
one_line_zh: 冻结动作价值模型引导离线强化学习，并在安卓在线验证。

title_zh: 以查询导向枢纽任务平滑 MLLM 驱动 GUI 智能体的定位与推理
one_line: Adds a query-inference pretraining task (coordinates to intended query) before SFT; offline AndroidControl/AITZ action match matches OS-Atlas with <0.1% data.
one_line_zh: 在推理微调前加入由坐标反推用户意图的查询推断预训练任务，离线动作匹配上以极少数据接近 OS-Atlas。

title_zh: 迈向企业级的通用计算机使用智能体
one_line: Plan-controller plus browser/API sub-agents refined by failure-driven iteration on WebArena samples; 61.7% WebArena, no matched baselines or ablations.
one_line_zh: 以计划控制器分派浏览器与 API 子智能体，并在 WebArena 子集上迭代改进，报告 61.7% 成功率。

title_zh: AppAgentX：将 GUI 智能体进化为熟练的智能手机用户
one_line: Distils repeated low-level sequences from execution memory into shortcut actions; AndroidWorld/A3 success and fewer steps/tokens versus AppAgent.
one_line_zh: 从执行历史中抽象重复操作为快捷高层动作，在 AndroidWorld 等基准上提升成功率并减少步数与 token。

title_zh: LiteWebAgent：面向 VLM 网页智能体应用的开源套件
one_line: Open-source web-agent framework decoupling NL action generation from prompted grounding, with planning, memory and tree search; no quantitative evaluation.
one_line_zh: 开源网页智能体框架，解耦动作生成与动作定位并集成规划、记忆与树搜索，未提供定量评估。

title_zh: SpiritSight 智能体：一眼即可的先进 GUI 智能体
one_line: Pretrains InternVL2 on 5.73M harvested multi-level grounding data with block-specific coordinates (UBP); offline Mind2Web/AndroidControl step accuracy and ScreenSpot gains.
one_line_zh: 在 573 万多层级自动采集的 GUI 数据上继续预训练并引入块坐标解析，离线导航与定位基准领先。

title_zh: CHOP：基于受约束高频优化子任务规划的移动操作助手
one_line: Constrains the planner to high-frequency human basis subtasks with documentation; GPT-4o agent on real devices beats AppAgent/Mobile-Agent-v2/Moba, including out-of-domain apps.
one_line_zh: 以人类高频基础子任务约束计划智能体分解，在真实手机上优于多种基线并泛化到域外应用。

title_zh: WinClick：基于多模态大语言模型的 GUI 定位
one_line: Continual-pretrains Phi-3-vision on 60K detector-boxed, GPT-4o-captioned Windows screenshots; offline click accuracy on ScreenSpot-Desktop and new WinSpot benchmark.
one_line_zh: 用检测器框与 GPT-4o 对齐描述的 Windows 截图继续预训练 Phi-3-vision，并提出 WinSpot 定位基准。

title_zh: 三思而后点：通过快慢系统增强 GUI 定位
one_line: Trains a 2B grounder on synthesised fast/slow reasoning chains with probability-based switching; offline ScreenSpot 77.4% and ScreenSpot-Pro 13.3%.
one_line_zh: 以快慢双系统推理链数据训练 2B 定位模型并自适应切换，离线 ScreenSpot 与 ScreenSpot-Pro 提升。

title_zh: COLA：面向 Windows UI 任务自动化的可扩展多智能体框架
one_line: Planner, scheduler and pluggable decision-agent pool with reviewer and memory on Windows; GAIA 31.89%, ablation removing the agent pool.
one_line_zh: 以规划器、调度器与可插拔决策智能体池加审查者与记忆自动化 Windows 任务，GAIA 得分 31.89%。

title_zh: Plan-and-Act：提升智能体在长程任务中的规划能力
one_line: Fine-tuned planner (on trajectory-grounded synthetic plans) plus executor with per-step replanning; WebArena-Lite 57.58%, ablating planner and replanning.
one_line_zh: 以轨迹反推的合成计划训练规划器并配合执行器与动态重规划，WebArena-Lite 成功率 57.58%。

title_zh: STEVE：面向计算机使用智能体训练的步骤验证流水线
one_line: GPT-4o labels each agent step from before/after screens; KTO trains a 7B Windows agent on these labels, checked online on WinAgentArena.
one_line_zh: 用GPT-4o依据动作前后截图为每步打二值标签，再用KTO训练7B桌面智能体，在WinAgentArena在线验证

title_zh: WebNav：面向语音控制网页导航的智能体
one_line: Prompted dual-Gemini controller/assistant acts on numbered DOM marks drawn by a browser extension; system description only, no empirical evaluation.
one_line_zh: 双Gemini控制器/助手基于浏览器插件标注的DOM编号元素执行网页操作；仅系统描述，无实验评估

title_zh: 迈向使用计算机的个人智能体
one_line: Position paper proposing computer-use agents with policy-controlled access to a personal knowledge graph; roadmap only, no system or evaluation.
one_line_zh: 立场论文：提出让计算机使用智能体在策略控制下访问个人知识图谱，仅为路线图，无系统与评估

title_zh: 推进移动GUI智能体：面向实际部署的验证器驱动方法
one_line: Replaces action generation with a trained 8B verifier scoring all extracted candidate actions; online AndroidWorld/AndroidLab/MobileAgentBench gains with latency reported.
one_line_zh: 用训练的8B验证器对抽取的全部候选动作打分并执行最高分动作，在三个在线安卓基准上提升成功率并报告延迟

title_zh: GUI-Xplore：一次探索赋能可泛化GUI智能体
one_line: Feeds app exploration videos, distilled into a GUI transition graph, to an LLM agent; offline multiple-choice and step metrics on held-out apps.
one_line_zh: 将应用探索视频提炼为GUI转移图供大模型推理，在未见应用上以离线选择题和步级指标评估

title_zh: Agent S2：面向计算机使用智能体的通才-专才组合式框架
one_line: Routes a generalist planner's target descriptions to specialist grounders and replans after every subgoal; online OSWorld, WindowsAgentArena and AndroidWorld gains with ablations.
one_line_zh: 通才规划器把目标描述交给多种专才定位专家并在每个子目标后主动重规划，在OSWorld、WAA与AndroidWorld在线评测中领先。

title_zh: 为智能体任务归纳程序化技能
one_line: Induces executable, execution-verified program skills from its own WebArena episodes into the action space; beats static and text-skill agents on checker-based WebArena.
one_line_zh: 从自身WebArena轨迹归纳经执行验证的程序化技能并加入动作空间，在WebArena上优于静态与文本技能智能体。

title_zh: SkillWeaver：网页智能体通过发现与打磨技能实现自我提升
one_line: Explores each website, distils practised trajectories into tested Playwright skill APIs added to the action space; WebArena and live Online-Mind2Web gains, transferable to weaker agents.
one_line_zh: 逐站探索并把练习轨迹提炼为经测试的Playwright技能API，提升WebArena与真实网站成功率，并可迁移给较弱智能体。

title_zh: 打破数据壁垒：通过任务泛化构建GUI智能体
one_line: Mid-trains a 7B VLM planner on non-GUI math, code and perception data before GUI trajectory SFT; online WebArena and AndroidWorld gains over SFT-only.
one_line_zh: 在GUI轨迹微调前用数学、代码等非GUI数据中期训练7B规划模型，WebArena与AndroidWorld在线成功率优于仅后训练基线。

title_zh: WebRollback：以显式回滚机制增强网页智能体
one_line: Adds a post-action critique that decides when and where to roll back to an earlier URL state; live Mind2Web-Live/WebVoyager gains, GPT-4o-judged.
one_line_zh: 在每步后由评判模块决定何时、回滚到哪个先前状态，在实时网页基准上提升成功率，但评测依赖GPT-4o判分。

title_zh: TongUI：基于多模态网络教程的互联网规模轨迹构建通用GUI智能体
one_line: Turns crawled video and article tutorials into thought-action trajectories via a zero-shot agent, then SFTs Qwen2.5-VL; mostly offline grounding/step gains plus MiniWob.
one_line_zh: 把爬取的视频与图文教程经零样本智能体转为思考-动作轨迹并微调Qwen2.5-VL，主要在离线定位与步级指标及MiniWob上提升。

title_zh: LearnAct：基于统一示范基准的少样本移动GUI智能体
one_line: Retrieves parsed human demonstrations from the same app into the mobile agent's context; offline step accuracy and AndroidWorld-based online success rise, components ablated.
one_line_zh: 把同一应用的人类示范解析后检索进移动智能体上下文，离线步级准确率与基于AndroidWorld的在线成功率均提升，并做了组件消融。

title_zh: ViMo：面向应用智能体的生成式视觉GUI世界模型
one_line: Predicts each candidate action's next screen with a diffusion+LLM visual world model and lets an LLM pick the best; offline step-accuracy gains plus AndroidWorld check.
one_line_zh: 用扩散+LLM的视觉世界模型预测每个候选动作的下一屏，再由LLM择优，离线步级准确率提升并有AndroidWorld在线验证。

title_zh: InfiGUI-R1：推动多模态GUI智能体从反应式执行者走向深思熟虑的推理者
one_line: Distils teacher spatial reasoning into a 3B policy, then RL with sub-goal and error-recovery rewards; offline ScreenSpot and AndroidControl gains, no ablations.
one_line_zh: 先蒸馏教师模型的空间推理到3B策略，再用子目标与错误恢复奖励做强化学习，在离线ScreenSpot与AndroidControl上提升但无消融。

title_zh: UFO2：桌面智能体操作系统
one_line: Windows multi-agent CUA mixing GUI actions with native app APIs and hybrid UIA+OmniParser detection; checker-verified gains on WAA and OSWorld-W.
one_line_zh: Windows多智能体融合GUI与原生API动作及混合控件检测。

title_zh: 在推理时用过程奖励引导VLM智能体进行GUI导航
one_line: Per-step reranking of VLM-proposed actions by a trained process reward model; gains mostly on offline step accuracy plus a small human-judged AitW set.
one_line_zh: 用训练的过程奖励模型逐步重排VLM候选动作，证据以离线步准确率为主。

title_zh: WebEvolver：通过协同进化的世界模型增强网页智能体自我改进
one_line: Co-evolving LLM world model synthesises web trajectories mixed with real self-improvement data and enables lookahead; live-web gains judged by GPT-4o.
one_line_zh: 协同训练的世界模型合成网页轨迹并混合真实数据，兼作前瞻选择，GPT-4o评判。

title_zh: ScaleTrack：扩展与回溯的自动化GUI智能体
one_line: Adds a back-tracking objective (predict prior actions from current screen) to SFT and merges grounding datasets; mainly offline gains, small AndroidWorld check.
one_line_zh: SFT中加入由当前界面回溯历史动作的目标并合并定位数据，主要为离线提升。

title_zh: 面向GUI智能体定位的视觉测试时扩展
one_line: Training-free RegionFocus zooms around the predicted point when errors trigger, aggregates per-region actions via image landmarks; gains on ScreenSpot-Pro and live WebVoyager.
one_line_zh: 出错时放大预测点周围区域并用图像地标聚合动作，免训练。

title_zh: EcoAgent：高效的端云协同移动自动化多智能体框架
one_line: Cloud planner emits steps with expected outcomes; on-device executor acts and small observer verifies against expectations, sending text summaries; AndroidWorld SR and cost reported.
one_line_zh: 云端规划带预期结果，端侧执行并由小模型对照验证回传。

title_zh: 从计算机使用中构建通用用户模型
one_line: Builds a general user model of confidence-weighted propositions from screenshots, retrieved and revised to ground assistants; evaluated by human studies, not executable tasks.
one_line_zh: 从截图推断带置信度的用户命题并检索修订以支撑助手，仅有人工研究评估。

title_zh: InfantAgent-Next：面向自动化计算机交互的多模态通用智能体
one_line: Modular agent routes planning, tool selection and execution to separate models, mixing code tools with planner+grounder GUI clicks; OSWorld run with tools disabled.
one_line_zh: 模块化智能体融合代码工具与规划器加定位器的GUI点击。

title_zh: MobileIPL：通过迭代偏好学习增强移动智能体思维过程
one_line: Iterative thinking-level DPO over sampled CoaT reasoning trees scored by rule-based match to ground-truth actions, plus GPT-4o instruction evolution; offline step-accuracy gains.
one_line_zh: 对采样推理树按与真值动作匹配打分做思维级DPO迭代训练，仅离线步准确率提升。

title_zh: GUI-Shift：通过自监督强化学习增强基于视觉语言模型的GUI智能体
one_line: Trains VLM policies with GRPO on a k-step inverse-dynamics task from unlabeled screen pairs; offline AndroidControl/GUI Odyssey and ScreenSpot gains.
one_line_zh: 用GRPO在无指令的屏幕对上做k步逆动力学预测训练VLM，离线导航与定位基准均有提升。

title_zh: 面向计算机使用的高效智能体训练
one_line: Augments 312 human Windows trajectories with Claude-reconstructed thoughts and alternative actions, SFTs Qwen2.5-VL-72B; online WindowsAgentArena-V2 gains, OSWorld transfer.
one_line_zh: 用Claude为312条人类轨迹补全思维并合成备选动作后SFT，在WAA-V2在线提升并迁移到OSWorld。

title_zh: 构建稳定规划器：基于扩展有限状态机的移动GUI智能体规划模块
one_line: A plug-in planner traverses hand-built per-app extended finite state machines into a natural-language plan for a VLM executor; AndroidWorld 63.8% vs 35.0%.
one_line_zh: 用人工构建的应用EFSM经BFS求解生成执行计划指导VLM执行，AndroidWorld成功率由35.0%升至63.8%。

title_zh: ReGUIDE：基于空间推理与搜索的数据高效GUI定位
one_line: Grounder learns reasoning via GRPO and crop-consistency training, then zooms to a KDE-chosen region and votes; large ScreenSpot-Pro gains from 20K samples.
one_line_zh: 以GRPO学习推理并做全局-局部一致性训练，推理时KDE裁剪放大再投票，2万样本即大幅提升ScreenSpot-Pro。

title_zh: ARPO：基于经验回放的GUI智能体端到端策略优化
one_line: End-to-end GRPO on live OSWorld with a per-task success replay buffer and solvable-task filtering lifts UI-TARS-1.5 from 23.5% to 29.9%.
one_line_zh: 在OSWorld上做端到端GRPO，加入成功轨迹回放与可解任务筛选，UI-TARS-1.5从23.5%升至29.9%。

title_zh: WebAgent-R1：通过端到端多轮强化学习训练网页智能体
one_line: BC-initialised multi-turn GRPO with context compression on WebArena binary rewards; WebArena-Lite 44.8% for Llama-3.1-8B, beating WebRL, with WebVoyager OOD gains.
one_line_zh: 行为克隆初始化后在WebArena规则奖励上做多轮GRPO，8B模型WebArena-Lite达44.8%并在WebVoyager泛化。

title_zh: 解锁更智能的设备控制：基于世界模型驱动代码执行的前瞻规划
one_line: GPT-4V builds a text-graph world model of the app, plans as executable code with zoom-in verification and refinement; MobileAgentBench SR 39% vs 27%.
one_line_zh: GPT-4V先构建应用的文本图世界模型并以代码形式规划执行、带放大校验与自我修正，MobileAgentBench成功率39%。

title_zh: GUI-explorer：面向GUI智能体的自主探索与转移感知知识挖掘
one_line: Training-free agent explores apps with manifest-anchored goals, mines action-effect knowledge from transitions, retrieves it per step; AndroidWorld 47.4%, SPA-Bench 53.7%.
one_line_zh: 无训练智能体按清单锚点探索应用，从状态转移中挖掘操作知识并检索注入，在AndroidWorld与SPA-Bench上提升成功率。

title_zh: ProgRM：用进度奖励构建更好的GUI智能体
one_line: Replaces sparse outcome reward with a per-step progress reward model (LCS-derived labels) for online RL; WikiHow SR 62.0% vs 58.7% ORM.
one_line_zh: 用基于LCS自标注的逐步进度奖励模型替代稀疏结果奖励进行在线RL，WikiHow成功率优于ORM。

title_zh: LiteCUA：在AIOS上将计算机作为MCP服务器的计算机使用智能体
one_line: Wraps the computer as an MCP server (screenshot + a11y tree, pyautogui actions) for a prompted orchestrator-worker agent; OSWorld 14.66%, no ablation.
one_line_zh: 将计算机封装为MCP服务器提供结构化上下文，配合提示式编排-执行智能体，OSWorld成功率14.66%，无消融。

title_zh: ScreenExplorer：训练视觉语言模型在开放GUI世界中进行多样化探索
one_line: GRPO-trains a 3B VLM in a live desktop with world-model curiosity and state-change rewards plus experience distillation; evaluated only by exploration diversity.
one_line_zh: 在真实桌面环境中用世界模型好奇心与状态变化奖励对3B VLM做GRPO训练并蒸馏经验，仅以探索多样性评估。

title_zh: WebCoT：通过重构反思、分支与回滚思维链增强网页智能体推理
one_line: Distils reflection-lookahead, WebDreamer branching and rollback rationales into Llama-3.3-70B via SFT; GPT-4o-judged WebVoyager 24.7% to 41.0%.
one_line_zh: 将反思前瞻、分支与回滚推理重写为思维链并SFT到Llama-3.3-70B，GPT-4o评判的WebVoyager成功率显著提升。

title_zh: BacktrackAgent：通过错误检测与回溯机制增强GUI智能体
one_line: Adds rule verifier, trained judger and reflector that check each action's outcome page and rewrite it; offline Mobile3M task SR +5.65 from backtracking.
one_line_zh: 加入规则校验器、训练的判别器与反思器检查每步执行结果并改写动作，离线Mobile3M任务成功率提升。

title_zh: UI-Genie：迭代提升基于MLLM的移动GUI智能体的自我改进方法
one_line: Trains a unified step/outcome GUI reward model on synthetic labels, uses it for reward-guided beam exploration and filtering over three rounds; AndroidLab 18.1% to 38.7%.
one_line_zh: 用合成标签训练统一的步骤/结果奖励模型，引导束搜索探索与结果过滤，三轮自我改进使AndroidLab成功率大幅提升。

title_zh: UI-Evol：面向计算机使用智能体的自动知识演化
one_line: Retraces actual actions from screenshots and critiques retrieved web knowledge to evolve per-task plans for Agent S2; OSWorld gains over 3 runs, evolved on the test tasks.
one_line_zh: 从截图回溯实际动作并批判修订检索到的网页知识，为Agent S2演化任务知识，在OSWorld同一任务上提升且三次运行方差更低。

title_zh: Agent-SAMA：状态感知的移动助手
one_line: Multi-agent mobile framework builds an FSM of screens with pre/post-conditions to verify transitions and recover; AndroidWorld 63.7%, roles ablated on human-judged sets.
one_line_zh: 多智能体移动框架实时构建带前后置条件的界面有限状态机以校验转移并恢复错误，AndroidWorld成功率63.7%。

title_zh: ZeroGUI：以零人工成本实现GUI智能体在线学习自动化
one_line: Online GRPO for GUI agents on VLM-generated tasks with VLM-voted trajectory rewards; gains on OSWorld and AndroidLab over 4 runs, judge precision checked.
one_line_zh: 用VLM自动生成任务并以投票VLM判定轨迹成功作奖励做在线GRPO，在OSWorld和AndroidLab上提升，判官精度经人工标注检验

title_zh: VideoCAD：从视频学习长时程3D CAD界面交互的数据集与模型
one_line: Synthesises 41K Onshape CAD UI videos by rule-based replay and trains a behaviour-cloning transformer; mostly offline accuracy, small executed Chamfer check.
one_line_zh: 以规则脚本在Onshape中重放人类CAD设计合成4.1万条UI视频并训练行为克隆模型，主要为离线准确率，少量执行几何校验

title_zh: AgentCPM-GUI：基于强化微调构建移动端操作智能体
one_line: 8B on-device mobile agent: grounding pretraining, SFT on merged Chinese/English trajectories in a compact action schema, then GRPO; offline TM/EM only.
one_line_zh: 8B端侧移动智能体：定位预训练、紧凑动作空间下中英轨迹SFT、再GRPO强化微调，仅离线步级匹配评测

title_zh: VerificAgent：面向对齐计算机使用智能体可扩展监督的领域记忆验证
one_line: Seeds and grows Office task memory from agent trajectories, then human fact-checks and freezes it; raises OSWorld-Office success for two CUAs, small task sets.
one_line_zh: 以专家种子和轨迹分析积累Office领域记忆，经人工核查后冻结使用，提升两种CUA在OSWorld Office任务的成功率

title_zh: Surfer-H与Holo1：基于开放权重的低成本网页智能体
one_line: Web agent splitting policy, screenshot-only localizer and answer validator, powered by Holo1 VLMs trained on crawled DOM grounding data; 92.2% WebVoyager claimed.
one_line_zh: 网页智能体拆分为策略、纯截图定位器与答案验证器，由在网页DOM抽取定位数据上训练的Holo1驱动，宣称WebVoyager达92.2%

title_zh: 利用大模型评审信号进行DPO训练的计算机使用智能体
one_line: GPT-4o scores sampled UI-TARS-2B step responses to build DPO preference pairs; small OSWorld gain at 15 steps, judge unvalidated, none at 50 steps.
one_line_zh: 用GPT-4o给UI-TARS-2B采样的单步回复打分构造DPO偏好对，OSWorld 15步设置小幅提升，评审未验证

title_zh: GUI-Actor：面向GUI智能体的无坐标视觉定位
one_line: Replaces coordinate tokens with an attention action head over visual patches plus a crop verifier; strong ScreenSpot-Pro grounding, small OSWorld-W online check.
one_line_zh: 以注意力动作头在视觉patch上定位替代坐标文本生成，并加验证器挑选候选，ScreenSpot-Pro表现强，仅小规模在线检验

title_zh: Go-Browse：通过结构化探索训练网页智能体
one_line: Graph-search exploration resets to discovered pages, proposes and feasibility-filters tasks, collects trajectories; SFT 7B beats NNetNav on WebArena, weak OOD transfer.
one_line_zh: 以URL图搜索式探索重置到已发现页面提出并过滤任务、采集轨迹，SFT 7B在WebArena上超过NNetNav，域外迁移较弱

title_zh: BIMgent：基于计算机使用智能体的自主建筑建模
one_line: Hierarchical planner with documentation retrieval, region-focused grounding and LLM supervisor drives BIM software; 32% on 25 in-house human-judged tasks, roles ablated.
one_line_zh: 分层规划结合文档检索、局部区域定位与LLM监督反思操控BIM软件，在25个自建人评任务上成功率32%，并做了角色消融

title_zh: 思考还是行动：通过扩展测试时交互进行推理的智能体
one_line: Scales test-time interaction: online filtered-BC with a rollout-horizon curriculum on synthetic tasks and a validated judge; Gemma 3 12B gains on WebVoyager and WebArena.
one_line_zh: 提出扩展测试时交互步数，用横向课程的在线过滤行为克隆在合成任务上训练，Gemma 3 12B在WebVoyager和WebArena上提升

title_zh: GUI-Reflection：赋予多模态 GUI 模型自我反思行为
one_line: Injects self-reflection into a mobile GUI policy via reflection pretraining tasks, synthesised error-recovery SFT data and online reflection tuning; AndroidWorld 34.5%.
one_line_zh: 通过反思预训练任务、合成纠错 SFT 数据与在线反思微调让移动端 GUI 模型学会纠错，AndroidWorld 达 34.5%。

title_zh: 移动智能体的原子到组合泛化：新基准与调度系统
one_line: Adds a GPT-4o scheduler that decomposes compositional mobile tasks into atomic subtasks with process memory; +24-40% success on the new UI-Nexus benchmark.
one_line_zh: 提出 GPT-4o 调度器将组合式移动任务分解为原子子任务并维护过程记忆，在新基准 UI-Nexus 上成功率提升 24-40%。

title_zh: Mirage-1：以分层多模态技能增强与更新 GUI 智能体
one_line: Distils offline and MCTS-explored trajectories into hierarchical skills retrieved by a GPT-4o planner; gains on AndroidWorld, MobileMiniWob++, Mind2Web-Live and AndroidLH.
one_line_zh: 将离线轨迹与 MCTS 在线探索提炼为分层技能库供 GPT-4o 规划检索，在 AndroidWorld、Mind2Web-Live 等在线基准上提升成功率。

title_zh: UITron-Speech：面向语音指令的自动化 GUI 智能体
one_line: Replaces text with speech instructions via TTS-synthesised data, mixed-modality SFT and two-step crop regrounding; evaluated offline on ScreenSpot, AndroidControl, GUI-Odyssey.
one_line_zh: 用 TTS 合成语音指令数据、混合模态训练与两步裁剪重定位构建语音驱动 GUI 智能体，仅在离线基准上评测。

title_zh: AgentSynth：面向通用计算机使用智能体的可扩展任务生成
one_line: Chains history-conditioned, verified simple subtasks in OSWorld and summarises them into long-horizon tasks; validated LLM verifier, $0.60 per trajectory, steep difficulty curve.
one_line_zh: 在 OSWorld 中基于历史链式生成并验证简单子任务，再汇总为长程任务；验证器经人工校验，每条轨迹成本 0.6 美元。

title_zh: 记忆链：增强 GUI 智能体的跨应用导航能力
one_line: Adds explicit short-term action-result memory and long-term task-relevant screen memory, trained via a 111k-step annotated GUI Odyssey-CoM; offline AMS/SR gains.
one_line_zh: 引入显式短期动作结果记忆与长期任务相关屏幕记忆，并构建 GUI Odyssey-CoM 数据集训练，离线指标提升。

title_zh: Mobile-R1：通过系统化训练提升基于 VLM 的移动智能体交互能力
one_line: Three-stage curriculum (SFT, action-level GRPO, multi-turn task-level GRPO with GPT-4o trajectory reward) for a 3B mobile agent; offline Chinese benchmark plus 50 device tasks.
one_line_zh: 三阶段课程（SFT、动作级 GRPO、基于 GPT-4o 轨迹奖励的多轮任务级 GRPO）训练 3B 移动智能体，主要为离线评测。

title_zh: ZonUI-3B：面向跨分辨率 GUI 定位的轻量级视觉语言模型
one_line: Fine-tunes a 3B screenshot grounder on a curated 24K cross-platform, multi-resolution set with balanced sampling and two-stage tuning; ScreenSpot 84.9%, ScreenSpot-Pro 28.7%.
one_line_zh: 用 24K 跨平台多分辨率精选数据、平衡采样与两阶段微调训练 3B 截图定位模型，ScreenSpot 达 84.9%。

title_zh: CowPilot：自主与人机协作网页导航框架
one_line: Suggest-then-execute control lets humans override web actions; collaborative success and human effort are measured on 27 tasks with self-reported completion.
one_line_zh: 建议后执行允许用户接管，27项任务衡量协作成效与人力投入。

title_zh: Mobile-Agent-V：视频引导的便捷高效移动自动化操作知识注入方法
one_line: Mobile-Agent-V supplies demonstration keyframes through adaptive windows and reflection, improving Android execution and task transfer while exposing demonstration alignment and context-loss limits.
one_line_zh: 视频关键帧与动态窗口提升安卓执行及跨任务知识迁移。

title_zh: OS-Kairos：面向多模态大模型GUI智能体的自适应交互
one_line: Fine-tunes a mobile agent to emit per-step confidence (GPT-4o critic labels) and request human help below a threshold; offline TSR, small real-device check.
one_line_zh: 微调移动端智能体输出每步置信度（GPT-4o评审标注），低于阈值时请求人工介入；主要为离线评测，附少量真机测试。

title_zh: 手机UI自动化中由智能体发起的用户交互
one_line: Defines when a phone agent should contact the user; AndroidInteraction annotates 772 AndroidControl episodes; prompted LLMs over-ask (precision 0.08-0.19).
one_line_zh: 定义手机智能体何时应联系用户，在772条AndroidControl轨迹上标注交互需求；提示式大模型严重过度提问。

title_zh: ScreenLLM：用于高效动作理解与预测的状态化屏幕模式
one_line: Compresses Photoshop tutorial-video key frames, OCR text and cursor into a textual screen schema for MLLM action description and prediction; captioning metrics only.
one_line_zh: 将Photoshop教程视频的关键帧、OCR文本与光标压缩为文本屏幕模式，供多模态模型描述与预测动作；仅用字幕类指标评测。

title_zh: UI-R1：通过强化学习提升GUI智能体的高效动作预测
one_line: GRPO with action-type, point-in-box and format rule rewards on 136 hard mobile samples lifts a 3B model's grounding and AndroidControl step accuracy offline.
one_line_zh: 在136个困难移动端样本上用动作类型、点击命中与格式规则奖励做GRPO，离线提升3B模型的定位与AndroidControl单步准确率。

title_zh: Navi-plus：通过追问处理模糊的GUI导航任务
one_line: Adds an ASK action trained on LLM-made ambiguous tasks with generated QA answers; dual-stream offline evaluation on AndroidControl/Mind2Web recovers step success.
one_line_zh: 在动作空间加入ASK追问动作，用大模型生成的模糊任务与问答对训练；双流离线评测显示步骤成功率可基本恢复。

title_zh: GUI-R1：通用R1风格的GUI视觉-语言-动作模型
one_line: GRPO on 3K base-model-filtered single-step states with unified-action-space rule rewards, compared with same-data SFT; offline grounding and step benchmarks.
one_line_zh: 在3K条经基座模型采样筛选的单步状态上以统一动作空间规则奖励做GRPO，并与同数据SFT对比；离线定位与单步评测。

title_zh: 通过自进化强化学习增强GUI智能体的视觉定位
one_line: GRPO grounder on 3K filtered element-box pairs with a dense distance point reward and attention-map sample filtering across self-evolution rounds; offline grounding.
one_line_zh: 在3K条筛选后的元素-框数据上以稠密距离点奖励做GRPO定位训练，并在自进化轮次中用注意力图过滤样本；离线定位评测。

title_zh: 面向跨平台移动智能体的可扩展视频到数据集生成
one_line: Mines 20K YouTube phone tutorials into trajectories via OCR scene cuts, element detection and GPT-4o action inference; pretraining helps unseen Windows Mobile offline.
one_line_zh: 通过OCR场景切分、元素检测与GPT-4o动作推断，将2万条YouTube手机教程挖掘为轨迹；预训练提升未见Windows Mobile的离线准确率。

title_zh: Mobile-Agent-V：基于视频引导、轻松高效地为移动自动化注入操作知识（重复记录）
one_line: Abstract-only duplicate of Mobile-Agent-V: injects operational knowledge from a demo video into a mobile agent; evaluated on Mobile-Knowledge.
one_line_zh: Mobile-Agent-V的仅摘要重复记录：从演示视频为移动智能体注入操作知识，在Mobile-Knowledge上评测。

title_zh: GUI-G1：理解GUI智能体视觉定位中的类R1-Zero训练
one_line: Analyses R1-Zero-style grounding GRPO: fast template, box-size reward against hit/IoU hacking, difficulty weighting without length normalisation; 3B ScreenSpot 90.3 offline.
one_line_zh: 剖析类R1-Zero的定位GRPO：采用快速思考模板、以框尺寸奖励抑制命中/IoU奖励作弊、去长度归一化并加难度加权；离线评测。

title_zh: WorkForceAgent-R1：通过强化学习激发基于大模型的网页智能体推理能力
one_line: SFT warm-up then single-step GRPO over expert-trajectory states with format, exact-match action and penalty rewards; live WorkArena success beats same-backbone SFT.
one_line_zh: 先SFT预热，再在专家轨迹状态上以格式、精确匹配动作与惩罚奖励做单步GRPO；在线WorkArena成功率超过同骨干SFT。

title_zh: LPO：通过位置偏好优化实现精确的GUI智能体交互
one_line: GRPO with an entropy-window reward and a distance-based location reward for interaction coordinates, compared with other R1 rewards on one backbone; table numbers absent.
one_line_zh: 以信息熵窗口奖励和基于距离的位置奖励做GRPO优化交互坐标，在同一骨干上与其他R1奖励对比；提取文本缺少表格数值。

title_zh: 学习、推理、精炼：面向GUI智能体的卡尼曼双系统智能框架
one_line: Abstract only: CogniGUI pairs an omni-parser with a GRPO grounding agent using a relative reward, and proposes the ScreenSeek benchmark.
one_line_zh: 仅有摘要：CogniGUI将全能解析器与采用相对奖励的GRPO定位智能体结合，并提出ScreenSeek基准。

title_zh: DiMo-GUI：基于模态感知视觉推理的 GUI 定位测试时扩展
one_line: Training-free grounding: separate text/icon passes, each zooming iteratively around the prior prediction; evidence is ScreenSpot-Pro/ScreenSpot accuracy only.
one_line_zh: 免训练定位：文本与图标分开处理，各自围绕上一次预测逐步放大；证据仅为ScreenSpot-Pro与ScreenSpot定位准确率。

title_zh: LineRetriever：面向规划的 Web 智能体观测压缩
one_line: A small LLM keeps only plan-relevant AxTree lines each step; on WorkArena/WebArena it cuts ~60-73% of tokens but trails full observations.
one_line_zh: 每步用小模型挑选与后续规划相关的AxTree行；在WorkArena/WebArena上减少约60-73%观测，但成功率略低于完整观测。

title_zh: 少即是多：基于上下文感知简化增强 GUI 智能体
one_line: Trains a 2B screenshot policy with random region masking and in-LLM dropping of history vision tokens plus KL consistency; offline step SR, 27% fewer FLOPs.
one_line_zh: 训练2B截图策略：随机遮挡区域并在LLM浅层丢弃历史视觉token、以KL一致性约束；离线步级成功率，FLOPs降27%。

title_zh: R-VLM：面向精确 GUI 定位的区域感知视觉语言模型
one_line: Two-stage zoom-in grounding around the first predicted box plus IoU-weighted loss on SeeClick's data; ScreenSpot/GroundUI gains and offline AITW/Mind2Web.
one_line_zh: 以首次预测框为区域提议放大再定位，并用IoU加权交叉熵训练；ScreenSpot/GroundUI提升，AITW/Mind2Web为离线评测。

title_zh: MobileGUI-RL：在线环境强化学习提升移动端 GUI 智能体
one_line: Online trajectory GRPO in Android emulators with VLM-judged rewards, self-explored tasks filtered by a text world model; AndroidWorld 7B 22->30, 32B 31.5->44.8.
one_line_zh: 在安卓模拟器中做轨迹级在线GRPO，奖励由VLM判定，任务经自探索生成并由文本世界模型过滤；AndroidWorld 7B 22→30，32B 31.5→44.8。

title_zh: GTA1：GUI 测试时扩展智能体
one_line: Per-step best-of-K planner proposals chosen by an o3 judge plus a click-reward RL grounder; OSWorld 45.2% and WindowsAgentArena, K=1 baseline 43.4%.
one_line_zh: 每步采样K个规划提案由o3评判选优，并配合点击奖励RL训练的定位器；OSWorld 45.2%、WindowsAgentArena，K=1基线43.4%。

title_zh: GUI-G²：面向 GUI 定位的高斯奖励建模
one_line: Replaces binary click rewards in offline grounding GRPO with Gaussian point and coverage rewards; ScreenSpot-v2 93.3 vs 87.4 sparse, grounding benchmarks only.
one_line_zh: 在离线定位GRPO中以高斯点奖励和覆盖奖励替代二值点击奖励；ScreenSpot-v2 93.3对稀疏奖励87.4，仅定位基准。

title_zh: MobileUse：具备分层反思能力的自主移动端操作 GUI 智能体
one_line: Prompted Qwen2.5-VL-72B agent with confidence-triggered action/trajectory/global reflectors and pre-task app exploration; AndroidWorld 62.9%, ablated 49.5->62.9.
one_line_zh: 提示式Qwen2.5-VL-72B智能体，按置信度触发动作/轨迹/全局三级反思并在任务前主动探索应用；AndroidWorld 62.9%，消融49.5→62.9。

title_zh: MapAgent：基于轨迹构建记忆增强规划的移动端任务自动化
one_line: GPT-4o agent builds per-app page memory from exploration trajectories and retrieves it for coarse-to-fine planning with a judge; live phone, SPA-Bench and CHOP.
one_line_zh: GPT-4o智能体从探索轨迹构建按应用的页面记忆，检索后做由粗到细规划并配评判器；真机SPA-Bench与CHOP评测。

title_zh: UI-AGILE：以有效强化学习与精确推理时定位推进 GUI 智能体
one_line: Offline GRPO with continuous grounding and length-shaped thinking rewards, crop-resampling of zero-reward samples, plus split-and-select inference; ScreenSpot-Pro 48.7, AndroidControl offline.
one_line_zh: 离线GRPO：连续定位奖励、长度约束的思考奖励、零奖励样本裁剪重采样，并在推理时分块定位再选择；ScreenSpot-Pro 48.7，AndroidControl离线。

title_zh: Magentic-UI：迈向人在回路的智能体系统
one_line: Multi-agent web/code agent with co-planning, co-tasking and action guards; simulated-user GAIA raises success 30.3% to 51.9%, plus 12-user qualitative study.
one_line_zh: 多智能体系统加入共同规划、共同执行与动作守卫；模拟用户使GAIA成功率由30.3%升至51.9%，另有12人定性研究。

title_zh: Phi-Ground技术报告：提升GUI定位中的感知能力
one_line: Grounder trained on rendered CommonCrawl, Bing and human-labelled screenshots with resampling and resize augmentation; evidence is offline click accuracy only.
one_line_zh: 基于渲染网页、搜索截图与人工标注数据训练定位模型，含重采样与缩放增强；证据仅为离线点击准确率。

title_zh: Web-CogReasoner：面向网页智能体的多模态知识驱动认知推理
one_line: SFT of Qwen2.5-VL-7B on a factual/conceptual/procedural web-knowledge curriculum with knowledge-driven CoT; live WebVoyager and Online-Mind2Web, KCoT ablated.
one_line_zh: 以事实、概念、程序三层网页知识课程与知识驱动思维链微调7B模型；在线WebVoyager与Online-Mind2Web评测并消融KCoT。

title_zh: NaviMaster：学习GUI与具身导航的统一策略
one_line: Single-step GRPO with distance-aware grounding reward on mixed GUI and embodied visual-target trajectories; offline OOD step SR plus simulated ObjectNav.
one_line_zh: 在GUI与具身导航混合的视觉目标轨迹上做单步GRPO与距离感知奖励；证据为离线OOD步级成功率与模拟ObjectNav。

title_zh: MagicGUI：具备可扩展数据管线与强化微调的基础移动端GUI智能体
one_line: Mobile agent: 7.8M-sample continue pre-training then offline GRPO with spatial composite rule reward; evidence is offline step SR on AndroidControl, Odyssey, in-house Magic-RICH.
one_line_zh: 移动端智能体：780万样本继续预训练后以空间复合规则奖励做离线GRPO；证据为AndroidControl、Odyssey与自建基准的离线步级成功率。

title_zh: CoAct-1：以编码为动作的计算机使用多智能体系统
one_line: Orchestrator routes subtasks to a GUI operator or a code-writing programmer; OSWorld 60.76% and WindowsAgentArena 52.5%, hybrid beats GUI-only and code-only.
one_line_zh: 编排器把子任务分派给GUI操作员或编写脚本的程序员；OSWorld 60.76%、WAA 52.5%，混合优于纯GUI与纯代码。

title_zh: 不确定性感知GUI智能体：基于组件推荐与人在回路优化的自适应感知
one_line: Prompted M3A-style agent pruning UI elements via keyword, embedding and LLM recommendation plus backtracking reflection; AndroidWorld 47.8% with GPT-4o.
one_line_zh: 在M3A式提示智能体中用关键词、语义与LLM推荐裁剪UI元素并加回溯反思；GPT-4o在AndroidWorld达47.8%。

title_zh: 在任务中进化：赋能多模态大模型成为计算机使用智能体
one_line: Synthesises tasks with generated verification programs, filters trajectories, trains 7B UI-TARS with step-wise GRPO and merging; OSWorld 30.1 vs 24.9 baseline.
one_line_zh: 生成附带验证程序的任务并筛选轨迹，以逐步GRPO与模型合并训练7B模型；OSWorld 30.1对比基线24.9。

title_zh: GuirlVG：基于强化学习经验探索激励GUI视觉定位
one_line: Systematic GRPO study for GUI grounding: soft format reward, point-in-box reward, reward-scaled KL; ScreenSpot-family offline accuracy with 5.2K samples.
one_line_zh: 系统研究GUI定位的GRPO：软格式奖励、框内点奖励与按奖励缩放的KL；以5.2K样本在ScreenSpot系列离线评测。

title_zh: SEAgent：从经验中自主学习的自进化计算机使用智能体
one_line: Self-evolving curriculum with validated step-level World State Model judge, GRPO plus adversarial imitation; OSWorld five apps 11.3% to 34.5%, same apps.
one_line_zh: 自进化课程配合经验证的步级世界状态评判模型，GRPO加对失败动作的对抗模仿；OSWorld五款软件由11.3%升至34.5%。

title_zh: 面向自适应网页智能体的认知双重性
one_line: Switches per step between a small SFT fast policy and a GPT-4o reasoning-plus-reflection slow policy; WebArena 43.96% with ~75% fewer tokens.
one_line_zh: 按步在小模型 SFT 快系统与 GPT-4o 推理加反思慢系统间切换，WebArena 成功率 43.96%，token 用量降约 75%。

title_zh: 基于区域一致性的 GUI 定位测试时强化学习
one_line: Votes over sampled grounding boxes for a consensus region, then GRPO-trains on that label-free consistency reward; +2-6 points on ScreenSpot benchmarks.
one_line_zh: 对多次采样的定位结果做空间投票得到共识区域，并以无标注一致性奖励做测试时 GRPO，ScreenSpot 系列提升 2-6 个点。

title_zh: InfiGUI-G1：以自适应探索策略优化推进 GUI 定位
one_line: Has the grounder emit several candidate points per pass, rewarded by a rank-aware rule reward with collinearity penalty; beats same-data naive RLVR on grounding benchmarks.
one_line_zh: 让定位模型单次生成多个候选点，并用排名感知的规则奖励与共线惩罚训练，在多个定位基准上优于同数据的朴素 RLVR。

title_zh: OpenCUA：计算机使用智能体的开放基础
one_line: Collects 22.6K cross-OS human desktop demos, synthesises reflective long CoT per step and SFTs screenshot policies; OpenCUA-72B reaches 45.0% on OSWorld-Verified.
one_line_zh: 采集 2.26 万条跨操作系统人类桌面演示，逐步合成反思式长思维链并 SFT 截图策略，OpenCUA-72B 在 OSWorld-Verified 达 45.0%。

title_zh: UI-Venus 技术报告：以强化微调构建高性能 UI 智能体
one_line: GRPO-finetunes Qwen2.5-VL on manually cleaned grounding and navigation data with rule rewards plus history-thought realignment; ScreenSpot-Pro 61.9%, AndroidWorld 65.9%.
one_line_zh: 在人工清洗的定位与导航数据上以规则奖励对 Qwen2.5-VL 做 GRPO，并对齐历史思维轨迹，ScreenSpot-Pro 61.9%，AndroidWorld 65.9%。

title_zh: CRAFT-GUI：面向 GUI 任务的课程强化智能体
one_line: Orders single-step mobile GRPO training by trajectory length in three curriculum stages with rule plus LLM-judged rewards; AndroidWorld 51.7%, beats same-data SFT and vanilla GRPO.
one_line_zh: 按轨迹长度分三阶段课程进行移动端单步 GRPO，结合规则与 LLM 判定奖励，AndroidWorld 达 51.7%，优于同数据 SFT 与普通 GRPO。

title_zh: V2P：通过背景抑制与中心峰值校准 GUI 定位的视觉注意力
one_line: Trains a patch-attention grounding head with a background-suppression loss and size-scaled Gaussian centre targets; ScreenSpot-Pro 52.5% vs 44.6% for same-data GUI-Actor.
one_line_zh: 为基于图块注意力的定位头加入背景抑制损失和按尺寸缩放的高斯中心目标，ScreenSpot-Pro 达 52.5%，同数据 GUI-Actor 为 44.6%。

title_zh: ComputerRL：为计算机使用智能体扩展端到端在线强化学习
one_line: Runs BC then step-level online GRPO in thousands of parallel Ubuntu VMs with API-GUI actions, alternating RL and SFT against entropy collapse; OSWorld 48.9%.
one_line_zh: 先行为克隆，再在数千个并行 Ubuntu 虚拟机中以 API-GUI 动作做步级在线 GRPO，并交替 RL 与 SFT 防止熵坍塌，OSWorld 达 48.9%。

title_zh: Mobile-Agent-v3：面向 GUI 自动化的基础智能体
one_line: Post-trains Qwen2.5-VL on critic-filtered self-evolved trajectories, then trajectory-level online RL with success replay; AndroidWorld 66.4, OSWorld-Verified 34.9 after RL.
one_line_zh: 用评判器过滤的自演化轨迹后训练 Qwen2.5-VL，再以带成功回放的轨迹级在线 RL 优化，AndroidWorld 66.4，RL 后 OSWorld-Verified 达 34.9。

title_zh: WebSight：面向稳健网页智能体的视觉优先架构
one_line: Pairs LLM planning, reasoning and verification agents with a LoRA-tuned UI-TARS-7B screenshot grounder; 68.0% on a 50-task WebVoyager subset.
one_line_zh: 以 LLM 规划、推理与验证智能体配合 LoRA 微调的 UI-TARS-7B 截图定位器，在 50 题 WebVoyager 子集上成功率 68.0%。

title_zh: AppAgent-Pro：面向多领域信息整合与用户辅助的主动式 GUI 智能体系统
one_line: A GPT-4o cognitive agent infers latent user needs, spawns per-app sub-queries and iterative deep app search; shown only as a demo.
one_line_zh: GPT-4o 认知智能体推断用户潜在需求、为各应用生成子查询并迭代深度检索，仅以演示展示，无定量评测。

title_zh: InquireMobile：通过强化微调教会基于 VLM 的移动智能体请求人类协助
one_line: Adds a call_user inquiry action to a 3B mobile policy trained by SFT then rule-reward GRPO; InquireBench ISR 52.6% versus near-zero baselines.
one_line_zh: 为 3B 移动端策略加入 call_user 询问动作，经 SFT 与规则奖励 GRPO 训练，在 InquireBench 上询问成功率达 52.6%。

title_zh: CODA：以解耦强化学习协调“大脑”与“小脑”的双脑计算机使用智能体
one_line: Trains only the planner of a Qwen2.5-VL-32B planner + frozen UI-TARS-1.5 grounder via judge-labelled GRPO, then specialist-to-generalist SFT; ScienceBoard 21.0% Average@8.
one_line_zh: 冻结 UI-TARS-1.5 执行器，仅用评判器标注的 GRPO 训练 Qwen2.5-VL 规划器，再做专家到通才蒸馏，ScienceBoard 平均成功率 21.0%。

title_zh: Morae：主动暂停 UI 智能体以让用户做出选择
one_line: A GPT-4o web agent generates per-step ambiguity-verification questions and pauses for user choices; 55.2% online success vs Operator 53.1%, plus a 10-user BLV study.
one_line_zh: GPT-4o 网页智能体每步生成歧义校验问题并在决策点暂停征求用户选择，在线成功率 55.2%，并开展 10 名视障用户研究。

title_zh: UItron：具备先进感知与规划能力的基础 GUI 智能体
one_line: Unifies multi-source GUI perception and trajectory data across mobile/PC for SFT plus curriculum RL; OSWorld 24.9 and 54.1% online on Chinese apps.
one_line_zh: 统一移动端与 PC 多源感知和轨迹数据进行 SFT 并辅以课程强化学习，OSWorld 24.9，中文应用在线成功率 54.1%。

title_zh: KG-RAG：基于知识图谱检索增强生成提升 GUI 智能体决策
one_line: Converts explored app UI transition graphs into LLM-searched intent–trajectory pairs retrieved as context; DroidTask SR 66.9 to 75.8 over AutoDroid.
one_line_zh: 将探索得到的应用 UI 转移图经 LLM 搜索转为意图-轨迹向量库供在线检索，DroidTask 成功率由 66.9 提升到 75.8。

title_zh: MobiAgent：可定制移动智能体的系统化框架
one_line: Splits a mobile agent into planner, decider (target description) and 3B grounder trained with grounder-as-reward GRPO, plus record-replay speedup; tops MobiFlow over UI-TARS-1.5.
one_line_zh: 将移动智能体拆为规划器、决策器与 3B 定位器，以定位器作奖励模型训练 GRPO，并用记录回放加速，在 MobiFlow 上优于 UI-TARS-1.5。

title_zh: 成功或慢学：面向移动应用控制的样本高效离策略强化学习
one_line: Off-policy actor-critic that updates freely on positive advantages, clips negative ones, and replays successful transitions; 8B text policy reaches 51.3% on AndroidWorld.
one_line_zh: 离策略演员-评论家方法：正优势直接更新、负优势保守裁剪并回放成功转移，8B 文本策略在 AndroidWorld 达 51.3%。

title_zh: OmniActor：面向 2D 与 3D 世界的通用 GUI 与具身智能体
one_line: Unifies GUI and robot actions into one token format and shares shallow layers while separating deep layers; offline AndroidControl-High 77.5, LIBERO 69.5.
one_line_zh: 将 GUI 与机器人动作统一为同一词表格式，浅层共享、深层分离，离线 AndroidControl-High 77.5，LIBERO 69.5。

title_zh: UI-TARS-2 技术报告：以多轮强化学习推进 GUI 智能体
one_line: Native agent mixing GUI actions with terminal/SDK calls, trained via data flywheel and stabilised multi-turn PPO; OSWorld 47.5, AndroidWorld 73.3, Online-Mind2Web 88.2.
one_line_zh: 原生智能体在 GUI 动作之外加入终端/SDK 调用，经数据飞轮与稳定多轮 PPO 训练，OSWorld 47.5、AndroidWorld 73.3。

title_zh: PG-Agent：由页面图驱动的智能体
one_line: Rebuilds training episodes into page graphs and retrieves BFS-expanded action guidelines into a Qwen2.5-VL-72B multi-agent planner; offline AITW/Mind2Web/GUI Odyssey step metrics.
one_line_zh: 将训练集操作序列重建为页面图，检索BFS扩展的动作指引注入多智能体规划；仅离线步级指标评测。

title_zh: MobileRAG：以检索增强生成提升移动端智能体
one_line: Adds local-app retrieval, web-search retrieval and a memory of successful runs to a GPT-4o mobile agent; 80-task in-house emulator benchmark, single run.
one_line_zh: 为移动智能体加入本地应用检索、网络检索与成功操作记忆；在自建80任务模拟器基准上评测。

title_zh: 通过自演化偏好优化学习GUI定位中的主动感知
one_line: Trains a 7B grounder to crop-then-click via rejection-sampled SFT and region-wise DPO with Monte Carlo/IoU preferences; ScreenSpot-Pro 47.5/55.7, grounding only.
one_line_zh: 以拒绝采样SFT和区域级DPO训练7B模型先裁剪再点击的多步感知；仅在ScreenSpot系列定位基准评测。

title_zh: Instruction Agent：利用专家演示增强智能体
one_line: Converts one recorded human demo of the same task into step instructions, executes with UI-TARS grounding plus LLM verifier and backtracker; 60% on 20 OSWorld tasks.
one_line_zh: 将同一任务的人类演示转成逐步指令，配合定位、验证与回退执行；在20个OSWorld难题上成功率60%。

title_zh: VeriOS：面向可信OS智能体的查询驱动主动人-机-GUI交互
one_line: SFT+GRPO trains a 7B/32B agent to classify untrustworthy scenarios, ask the user, and act on answers; static step-wise accuracy on its own benchmark.
one_line_zh: 以SFT与GRPO训练智能体识别不可信场景并向用户提问后执行；仅在自建基准上做静态步级评测。

title_zh: UI-S1：通过半在线强化学习推进GUI自动化
one_line: Semi-online RL rolls the policy over expert trajectories with own history, patches mismatches and uses discounted step/episode advantages; AndroidWorld 34.0 at 7B.
one_line_zh: 在专家轨迹上以自身历史做半在线RL，修补不匹配动作并用折扣回报；7B在AndroidWorld达34.0%。

title_zh: 辅助推理如何释放VLM的GUI定位能力
one_line: Training-free spatial scaffolds (coordinate dots, axis grids, labelled grid with one zoom round) let VLMs output click points; grounding benchmarks only, seven backbones.
one_line_zh: 免训练地在截图上叠加坐标点、网格与带编号网格并放大一轮，提升VLM点击定位；仅定位基准评测。

title_zh: 看、想、做：通过识别开关状态教多模态智能体有效交互GUI
one_line: Rewrites toggle-step reasoning into perceive-state/infer-target/decide chains and SFTs four 7-8B agents; toggle benchmark offline plus 20 dynamic AndroidWorld-style tasks.
one_line_zh: 将开关类步骤的推理改写为感知当前状态-推断目标状态-决策的链并SFT；离线开关基准加20个动态任务。

title_zh: InfraMind：面向关键工业管理的探索式GUI智能体框架
one_line: VM-snapshot BFS/DFS exploration builds icon-caption knowledge and action-flow trees reused for planning on two DCIM systems; 10 tasks each, human-verified, three runs.
one_line_zh: 借助虚拟机快照探索构建图标说明知识库与动作流树并复用于规划；在两套DCIM系统各10任务上评测。

title_zh: TGPO：面向鲁棒Web智能体强化学习的树引导偏好优化
one_line: Merges repeated rollouts into state trees, derives tree/VLM-based step rewards and reward-weighted DPO pairs; Online-Mind2Web 38.4% with Qwen3-14B, single run.
one_line_zh: 将多条轨迹合并为状态树，生成步级过程奖励与加权DPO偏好对；Qwen3-14B在Online-Mind2Web达38.4%。

title_zh: ScaleCUA：利用跨平台数据扩展开源计算机使用智能体
one_line: Cross-platform data pipeline (random-walk plus expert trajectories, A11y/DOM grounding) and unified action space train screenshot agents; online evaluation on five live benchmarks.
one_line_zh: 跨六个平台的数据闭环与统一动作空间训练纯视觉智能体，在五个在线基准上评测并可作为规划器的定位器。

title_zh: GUI-ARP：面向 GUI 智能体的自适应区域感知增强定位
one_line: Attention-map cropping plus a learned stage controller decides when to zoom and re-ground; SFT+GRPO on 2.4K samples, evidence only offline grounding benchmarks.
one_line_zh: 基于注意力图自适应裁剪并学习是否多阶段放大再定位，SFT+GRPO训练，仅在离线定位基准上验证。

title_zh: BTL-UI：面向 GUI 智能体的 Blink-Think-Link 推理模型
one_line: Adds a blink ROI stage to the output and a rule-checked process-plus-outcome reward for offline GRPO; evidence is ScreenSpot and AndroidControl/GUI-Odyssey step accuracy.
one_line_zh: 在输出中加入注视区域（Blink）阶段，并用规则化过程+结果奖励做离线GRPO；证据为ScreenSpot与AndroidControl/GUI-Odyssey步级准确率。

title_zh: GUI-ReWalk：基于随机探索与意图感知推理的 GUI 智能体大规模数据生成
one_line: Random-walk exploration followed by LLM goal inference, goal-directed continuation and retrospective relabelling synthesises SFT trajectories; evidence is offline grounding and AndroidControl/GUI-Odyssey.
one_line_zh: 随机游走探索后由LLM推断目标、继续执行并回溯标注，合成多应用轨迹用于SFT；仅有离线定位与步级评测。

title_zh: UIPro：释放 GUI 智能体的卓越交互能力
one_line: 20.6M denoised grounding samples pre-train a screenshot policy, then a unified action superset merges heterogeneous trajectory datasets for SFT; evidence is offline step accuracy.
one_line_zh: 用2060万条去噪定位数据预训练，再以统一动作超集合并异构轨迹数据微调；证据为离线步级准确率。

title_zh: Mano 技术报告
one_line: UI-TARS-1.5-7B trained by SFT, offline GRPO and online-sampled RL in browser and Ubuntu pools, plus a verifier; OSWorld-Verified 41.6 over two runs.
one_line_zh: 在UI-TARS-1.5-7B上依次做SFT、离线GRPO与浏览器/Ubuntu环境池在线采样RL，并加验证模块；OSWorld-Verified两次运行41.6。

title_zh: Orcust：面向 GUI 智能体的逐步反馈强化学习
one_line: Stepwise GRPO reward combining rule checks with an LLM principle critic, trained on VM-collected trajectories; evidence is offline grounding and step accuracy.
one_line_zh: 结合规则校验与LLM原则评审的逐步奖励做GRPO，数据来自虚拟机采集轨迹；证据为离线定位与步级准确率。

title_zh: MobileRL：面向移动 GUI 智能体的在线智能体强化学习
one_line: Two SFT warm-ups then online GRPO with difficulty-adaptive success replay, failure filtering and shortest-path reward; AndroidWorld 80.2 and AndroidLab 53.6.
one_line_zh: 两阶段SFT预热后做在线GRPO，加入难度自适应成功回放、失败课程过滤与最短路径奖励；AndroidWorld 80.2%。

title_zh: 鲁棒、可观测、可演化的智能体系统工程：经 Fairy GUI 智能体验证的原则性框架
one_line: Prompted mobile agent that pauses to ask users at ambiguous sub-goals, with layered multi-agent architecture and evolving memory; 30 in-house tasks, simulated users.
one_line_zh: 提示式移动智能体：运行时目标细化并在歧义处向用户澄清、分层多智能体与演化记忆；在30个自建任务上用模拟用户评测。

title_zh: Recon-Act：基于网页侦察、工具生成与任务执行的自演化多智能体浏览器系统
one_line: Reconnaissance team contrasts failed and successful trajectories to write site-specific tools, with human analyst and tool manager; VisualWebArena 36.48 using GPT-5-Chat.
one_line_zh: 侦察团队对比失败与成功轨迹生成站点专用工具（分析与工具管理由人工完成），在VisualWebArena上以GPT-5-Chat达36.48%。

title_zh: 基于视觉反馈的空间推理学习GUI定位
one_line: Grounding reframed as RL-trained cursor search with rendered-cursor feedback and crop-around-first-guess refinement; ScreenSpot-Pro gains plus one OSWorld run with o3 planner.
one_line_zh: 将GUI定位重构为移动光标的多步交互搜索，用轨迹奖励GRPO训练并在推理时围绕初始预测裁剪细化；ScreenSpot-Pro大幅提升，另有OSWorld在线评测。

title_zh: D-Artemis：面向移动GUI多智能体的审慎认知框架
one_line: Training-free mobile agent adds app-specific tip retrieval, a trained pre-execution thought-action check with correction agent, and post-step reflection; AndroidWorld 75.8% with ablations.
one_line_zh: 免训练移动GUI框架：按应用检索技巧、执行前用训练的一致性检查与纠错智能体修正动作、执行后状态反思；AndroidWorld达75.8%并有逐模块消融。

title_zh: RISK：面向电商风控的GUI智能体框架
one_line: Domain dataset distilled from Browser-Use rollouts plus single-step GRPO with format, stepwise-F1, process and difficulty reweighting; offline RISK-Bench gains and a live-site check.
one_line_zh: 构建电商风控领域数据与基准，并以格式、逐步F1准确率、过程与难度重加权奖励做单步GRPO；离线基准提升明显，另有真实网页在线评测。

title_zh: 基于解耦训练与自适应数据筛选的高效多轮GUI智能体强化学习
one_line: Asynchronous decoupled online RL on OSWorld tasks with success-trajectory replay, adaptive rollouts/lengths, high-entropy step selection; 42.13% OSWorld, but trained on OSWorld tasks.
one_line_zh: 将环境、采样、数据管理与训练解耦为异步模块，并辅以成功轨迹池、动态采样与高熵步选择做在线RL；OSWorld达42.13%，但训练任务取自OSWorld。

title_zh: 通用扫描器遇见专用定位器：面向鲁棒GUI定位的协同由粗到细框架
one_line: Training-free coarse-to-fine grounding: a general VLM scans grids and verifies crops while a small grounder localises; ScreenSpot-Pro only, with ablations, no cost.
one_line_zh: 免训练由粗到细定位：通用VLM分网格筛选区域并核验裁剪，小型定位模型输出坐标；仅在ScreenSpot-Pro评测，有消融但未报告调用成本。

title_zh: 基于生成式指南的检索增强GUI智能体
one_line: A 7B adapter, trained by SFT then rejection sampling on action correctness, turns retrieved web tutorials into task guidance for a frozen agent; +13.3 AndroidWorld SR.
one_line_zh: 训练一个7B适配器（SFT加按动作正确性拒绝采样），将检索到的网络教程转为任务指南供冻结智能体使用；AndroidWorld成功率提升13.3点。

title_zh: 通过探索扩展智能体的合成任务生成
one_line: Memory-guided MLLM exploration of apps conditions task generation; executor plus GPT-4o verifier yield SFT/RL data; big AndroidWorld/OSWorld gains on the same apps.
one_line_zh: 先用带记忆的MLLM探索应用，再以探索轨迹和任务指南生成任务，经执行器与GPT-4o验证器得到SFT/RL数据；在同一批应用的AndroidWorld/OSWorld上显著提升。

title_zh: ReasoningBank：以推理记忆扩展智能体自我进化
one_line: Streaming test-time memory distils strategy items from self-judged successes and failures, plus memory-aware test-time scaling; WebArena gains over Synapse/AWM across three backbones.
one_line_zh: 在测试流中由LLM评判成败，并从成功与失败轨迹提炼策略记忆供检索，结合记忆感知的测试时扩展；WebArena上跨三种骨干优于Synapse/AWM。

title_zh: Ferret-UI Lite：构建小型端侧GUI智能体的经验
one_line: 3B end-to-end agent from unified multi-source SFT data, synthetic CoT/online rollouts, zoom-in grounding and rule-reward RLVR; AndroidWorld 28%, OSWorld 19.8%, modest RL gains.
one_line_zh: 3B端到端GUI智能体：统一多源SFT数据、合成CoT与在线轨迹、放大定位及规则奖励RLVR；AndroidWorld 28%、OSWorld 19.8%，RL增益有限。

title_zh: PAL-UI：面向视觉GUI智能体的主动回看规划
one_line: History compressed into captioner/validator text summaries plus a retrieve tool to re-view past screenshots, SFT on 8.6K distilled steps; offline AndroidControl/GUI-Odyssey/Mind2Web gains.
one_line_zh: 用观察描述与动作校验的双层文本摘要压缩历史，并提供可调回历史截图的检索工具，基于8.6K蒸馏样本SFT；仅在离线基准上提升。

title_zh: GUI-KV：具备时空感知的KV缓存压缩，实现高效GUI智能体
one_line: Training-free KV-cache compression keeps salient current-frame tokens and drops history tokens redundant with the latest screenshot; mostly offline accuracy-at-budget evidence plus OSWorld.
one_line_zh: 免训练KV缓存压缩，保留显著token并剔除历史帧冗余；证据以离线为主。

title_zh: WALT：会学习工具的网页智能体
one_line: Offline per-site exploration turns website functions (search, filter, post) into validated tool calls; online VisualWebArena/WebArena gains with a same-architecture no-tool control.
one_line_zh: 逐站探索将网站功能逆向为已验证工具，在线提升成功率并减少步数。

title_zh: 面向计算机使用的智能体扩展（行为评判器BJudge）
one_line: Wide scaling: N parallel rollouts become behavior narratives and a comparative VLM judge picks one; OSWorld 72.6% at equal rollout budgets, transfers to WindowsAgentArena/AndroidWorld.
one_line_zh: 多次rollout转为行为叙述比较选优，OSWorld达72.6%并跨平台迁移

title_zh: FocusAgent：简单而有效地裁剪网页智能体的超长上下文
one_line: A small LLM retriever prunes each AxTree to goal-relevant lines, halving observation tokens at near-equal WorkArena/WebArena success and cutting pop-up/banner injection success.
one_line_zh: 轻量LLM按目标裁剪AxTree，观测减半成功率接近，并降低注入攻击。

title_zh: 通过显式位置-坐标映射改进GUI定位
one_line: RULER tokens give explicit pixel-coordinate references and interleaved MRoPE balances axis frequencies; same-data ablations show grounding gains, largest on ScreenSpot-Pro; grounding-only evidence.
one_line_zh: RULER坐标token与交错MRoPE提升定位，高分辨率增益最大，仅定位证据。

title_zh: GUI-Spotlight：自适应迭代聚焦细化以增强GUI视觉定位
one_line: A 7B grounder learns via SFT plus modified GSPO to iteratively crop and refocus with tools; ScreenSpot-Pro 52.8% from 18.5K samples; grounding-only, no cost reported.
one_line_zh: RL训练迭代裁剪聚焦的定位模型，ScreenSpot-Pro达52.8%，未报开销。

title_zh: JEF-Hinter：利用离线知识提升网页智能体的适应能力
one_line: Zooms on decisive steps of offline success/failure traces, distils retrievable hints injected at inference; online MiniWoB++/WorkArena/WebArena-Lite gains, within-environment only.
one_line_zh: 从离线成败轨迹关键步提炼可检索提示，在线提升但仅限同环境。

title_zh: 从命令式到声明式：面向LLM的操作系统接口以增强计算机使用智能体
one_line: Declarative access/state/observation primitives over a UIA navigation forest offload GUI mechanism; OSWorld-W Office SR 44.4%->74.1% with fewer LLM calls, same apps modelled.
one_line_zh: 声明式原语替LLM完成GUI导航与交互，办公任务成功率44.4%升至74.1%。

title_zh: 观看与学习：从在线视频中学习使用计算机
one_line: An inverse-dynamics model labels 53K tutorial videos into UI trajectories used as ICL exemplars and SFT data; online OSWorld and WindowsAgentArena gains over TongUI labelling.
one_line_zh: 逆动力学模型将教程视频标注为轨迹，用于示例与SFT，桌面基准在线提升。

title_zh: ReInAgent：支持人在回路移动任务导航的上下文感知GUI智能体
one_line: Prompted multi-agent mobile system with slot-based information management asks users about ambiguous, missing or conflicting details; small live-device study versus older agents.
one_line_zh: 槽位管理信息并在模糊或冲突时主动询问用户，仅小规模真机评测。

title_zh: 面向 GUI 智能体的自动扩展连续记忆
one_line: Retrieves past GUI trajectories as Q-Former continuous embeddings, grown by a search-synthesise-rollout-judge flywheel; gains on live web benchmarks, tiny OSWorld transfer.
one_line_zh: 将历史 GUI 轨迹压缩为连续嵌入检索注入智能体，并用自动数据飞轮扩充记忆；网页基准提升明显，OSWorld 迁移增益很小。

title_zh: BrowserAgent：以类人网页浏览动作构建网页智能体
one_line: Replaces parse-and-summarise web tools with Playwright browsing primitives plus a conclusion memory, trained by SFT+RFT; beats Search-R1 on Wikipedia QA by EM.
one_line_zh: 用 Playwright 原生浏览动作和结论记忆替代网页解析摘要工具，经 SFT+RFT 训练，在维基百科问答上超过 Search-R1。

title_zh: WebRouter：基于变分信息瓶颈的成本敏感网页智能体查询级路由器
one_line: Routes each web-agent step to the cheapest capable LLM via a cost-aware VIB router; on five WebVoyager sites cuts price 87.8% for 3.8% accuracy.
one_line_zh: 用成本感知的变分信息瓶颈路由器为网页智能体每一步选择最省钱的大模型，在五个 WebVoyager 网站上成本降低 87.8%、准确率仅降 3.8%。

title_zh: R-WoM：面向计算机使用智能体的检索增强世界模型
one_line: Grounds an LLM world model's multi-step rollouts and listwise reward in retrieved tutorials to pick actions; three-run gains over WebDreamer on OSWorld/WebArena subsets.
one_line_zh: 用检索到的教程约束 LLM 世界模型的多步想象与列表式奖励来选动作，在 OSWorld/WebArena 子集上三次运行均优于 WebDreamer。

title_zh: Hi-Agent：面向移动设备控制的分层视觉语言智能体
one_line: Jointly trains subgoal planner and screenshot actor via single-step GRPO with foresight reward; AitW 87.9% over three runs, AndroidWorld 56.5% with 72B planner.
one_line_zh: 以单步 GRPO 与前瞻奖励联合训练子目标规划模型和截图动作模型，AitW 成功率 87.9%，72B 规划器下 AndroidWorld 达 56.5%。

title_zh: 大语言模型作为可扩展通用模拟器用于数字智能体的演化训练
one_line: Prompted LLM simulates UI accessibility-tree transitions; a guided teacher explores it and agents are fine-tuned on the trajectories, tested on WebArena and AndroidWorld.
one_line_zh: 用提示式 LLM 模拟 UI 无障碍树状态转移，让教师智能体在其中引导式探索并以合成轨迹训练智能体，在 WebArena 和 AndroidWorld 上评测。

title_zh: CORE：通过云端与本地大模型协作减少移动智能体的界面暴露
one_line: Local LLM splits the XML screen into blocks and ranks them so cloud GPT-4o sees only needed blocks; UI exposure drops up to 55.6%.
one_line_zh: 本地小模型按 XML 布局切分并排序界面块，只把必要块上传给云端 GPT-4o 决策，在 DroidTask/AndroidLab 上界面暴露最多降低 55.6%。

title_zh: PolySkill：通过多态抽象学习可泛化技能
one_line: Induces code skills as abstract domain classes with site-specific implementations from own successful runs; improves skill reuse and success on held-out websites over ASI/SkillWeaver.
one_line_zh: 将从自身成功轨迹归纳的代码技能组织为领域抽象类加站点实现，相比 ASI/SkillWeaver 提升技能复用率及未见网站成功率。

title_zh: GUIrilla：可扩展的桌面 UI 自动化探索框架
one_line: Crawls 1,108 macOS apps via the Accessibility API into state-action trees and derives 27K single-step grounding tasks; evaluated only by offline click-in-box accuracy.
one_line_zh: 借助 macOS 无障碍接口自动爬取 1108 个应用构建状态-动作树，并派生 2.7 万条单步定位任务，仅以离线点击命中率评测。

title_zh: UltraCUA：具备混合动作的计算机使用智能体基础模型
one_line: Adds mined programmatic tools to GUI primitives, trained by SFT plus online RL on 17K synthetic verifiable tasks; OSWorld 41.0% at 32B, transfers to WindowsAgentArena.
one_line_zh: 在 GUI 原子动作之外加入自动挖掘的程序化工具，以 1.7 万合成可验证任务做 SFT 与在线 RL，32B 在 OSWorld 达 41.0%，可迁移至 Windows。

title_zh: ColorAgent：构建鲁棒、个性化且可交互的操作系统智能体
one_line: Step-wise rule-reward GRPO, self-evolving data and a reflection/orchestration/retrieval multi-agent framework for a mobile agent; AndroidWorld 77.2%, AndroidLab 50.7%.
one_line_zh: 以逐步规则奖励 GRPO、自演化数据与含反思/编排/检索的多智能体框架构建移动端智能体，AndroidWorld 77.2%、AndroidLab 50.7%。

title_zh: VideoAgentTrek：基于无标注视频的计算机使用预训练
one_line: Inverse-dynamics model labels 39K YouTube tutorials into 1.52M action steps for continued pretraining; OSWorld-Verified 9.3% to 15.8%.
one_line_zh: 用逆动力学模型把 3.9 万个 YouTube 教程视频标注为 152 万步动作用于继续预训练，OSWorld-Verified 从 9.3% 提升到 15.8%。

title_zh: Surfer 2：新一代跨平台计算机使用智能体
one_line: Prompted orchestrator-navigator-validator hierarchy with a Holo1.5 localizer, purely visual, across web, desktop and mobile; WebArena 69.6%, OSWorld 60.1%, AndroidWorld 87.1%.
one_line_zh: 纯视觉的编排器-导航器-验证器分层提示框架配合 Holo1.5 定位器，跨网页/桌面/移动端，WebArena 69.6%、OSWorld 60.1%、AndroidWorld 87.1%。

title_zh: UI-Ins：以多视角“指令即推理”增强 GUI 定位
one_line: Cleans grounding data, SFT on multi-perspective rewritten instructions as reasoning, then GRPO picks perspectives; SOTA grounding and AndroidWorld 74.1% with GPT-5 planner.
one_line_zh: 清洗定位数据，先以多视角改写指令作为推理做 SFT，再用 GRPO 学习选择视角；定位基准领先，配合 GPT-5 规划器 AndroidWorld 74.1%。

title_zh: OpenPhone：移动端智能体基础模型
one_line: SFT-then-GRPO 3B on-device mobile policy with text-summary memory, escalating to a cloud MLLM on detected trouble; AndroidLab 15.2% alone, 47.1% with Gemini.
one_line_zh: SFT 后 GRPO 训练的 3B 端侧移动策略配合文本摘要记忆，遇困难时切换到云端大模型；AndroidLab 单独 15.2%，结合 Gemini 47.1%。

title_zh: WebATLAS：具备经验驱动记忆与动作模拟的 LLM 网页智能体
one_line: Actor proposes candidates, critic rolls them out over an exploration-built cognitive map before acting, with replanning; WebArena-Lite 63.0% without fine-tuning.
one_line_zh: 执行者提出候选动作，评论者在探索构建的认知地图上前瞻模拟后再执行，并支持重规划；无需微调在 WebArena-Lite 达 63.0%。

title_zh: MGA：面向以观察为中心交互的记忆驱动 GUI 智能体
one_line: Replaces raw history with a task-agnostic observer plus a validated append-only state-delta memory feeding a GPT-5 planner; OSWorld 64.7% at 50 steps.
one_line_zh: 以任务无关的观察器和经验证的追加式状态增量记忆替代原始历史，供 GPT-5 规划器使用；50 步内 OSWorld 达 64.7%。

title_zh: GUI-Rise：面向 GUI 导航的结构化推理与历史摘要
one_line: Policy emits progress reasoning, action and a running history summary, trained by SFT then GRPO with a history-summary reward; mostly offline gains, small online checks
one_line_zh: 策略每步输出结构化进度推理、动作和滚动历史摘要，经 SFT 与带历史摘要奖励的 GRPO 训练；主要为离线提升，在线验证较少。

title_zh: 通过自我批判强化学习提升可信的 GUI 定位
one_line: GRPO grounding with point-in-box plus Gaussian confidence-alignment rewards so the model emits a calibrated confidence per click; offline grounding only.
one_line_zh: 以框内点击奖励加高斯置信度对齐奖励做 GRPO 定位训练，使模型为每次点击输出校准后的置信度；仅离线定位评测。

title_zh: GUI-AIMA：以上下文锚点对齐多模态内在注意力实现 GUI 定位
one_line: Supervises an appended anchor token's head-weighted attention over patches for coordinate-free grounding, plus training-free zoom-in; 3B reaches ScreenSpot-Pro 61.5%, grounding only.
one_line_zh: 监督追加锚点 token 在图像块上的加权注意力实现无坐标定位，并支持免训练放大推理；3B 模型 ScreenSpot-Pro 达 61.5%，仅定位评测。

title_zh: 计算机使用智能体在推理时从在线视频中学习
one_line: Retrieves online tutorial videos, VLM-converts them into segmented demo trajectories, selects one per step in context; gains on OSWorld-Verified and WebArena.
one_line_zh: 推理时检索在线教程视频，用VLM转为分段演示轨迹并逐步选取一条放入上下文，在OSWorld-Verified与WebArena上提升成功率。

title_zh: SynthAgent：以合成监督适配网页智能体
one_line: Synthesises web tasks from categorized exploration, refines tasks on observed conflicts and trajectories post hoc, SFTs 7B agents; gains on WebArena and Online-Mind2Web.
one_line_zh: 通过分类探索合成网页任务，冲突触发任务精炼并事后精炼轨迹后微调7B智能体，在WebArena与Online-Mind2Web上提升。

title_zh: AUTO-Explorer：面向GUI智能体的自动化数据采集
one_line: Explores unseen Windows apps and websites with a UIA/OCR/template parser and new-element-driven clicking to harvest grounding data; offline in-house grounding gains.
one_line_zh: 用UIA/OCR/模板匹配解析器与新元素驱动的点击探索Windows软件和网站以采集定位数据，在自建离线定位基准上提升。

title_zh: 面向GUI智能体的历史感知推理
one_line: Warm-up SFT then GRPO on hard offline steps with teacher-written correction guidelines and rule rewards; 3B gains on AITW, Mind2Web, GUI-Odyssey step metrics.
one_line_zh: 先SFT预热，再在离线难样本上结合教师纠错指导与规则奖励做GRPO，3B模型在AITW、Mind2Web、GUI-Odyssey步级指标上提升。

title_zh: Co-EPG：自主GUI智能体中规划与定位协同进化的框架
one_line: Planner and grounder co-evolve: planner GRPO-trained with a confidence-weighted grounder-ensemble reward, grounder SFT on distilled plans; offline Mind2Web and AndroidControl gains.
one_line_zh: 规划模型与定位模型协同进化：规划器以置信加权的定位器集成奖励做GRPO，定位器在蒸馏计划上SFT，离线Mind2Web与AndroidControl提升。

title_zh: UFO3：编织数字智能体星系
one_line: An orchestrator turns each request into a dynamically edited subtask DAG executed by Windows/Linux device agents; 70.9% human-judged success on a 55-task in-house benchmark.
one_line_zh: 编排器将请求建模为可动态修改的子任务DAG，由Windows/Linux设备智能体并行执行；自建55任务基准上人工判定成功率70.9%。

title_zh: Mobile-Agent-RAG：以上下文知识赋能驱动长程移动自动化的智能多智能体协同
one_line: Adds dual retrieval to a manager-operator mobile agent: human-validated task plans for planning, app-specific guidance for actions; 76% SR on an in-house 50-task benchmark.
one_line_zh: 在管理者-操作者移动智能体中加入双层检索：规划检索人工验证的任务计划，执行检索应用级操作指导；自建50任务基准成功率76%。

title_zh: WebCoach：具有跨会话记忆指导的自进化网页智能体
one_line: Stores condensed past web trajectories in a vector memory; an 8B coach retrieves them and injects advice; WebVoyager live success 47% to 61% for 38B.
one_line_zh: 将历史网页轨迹压缩为摘要存入向量记忆，8B教练模型检索并在执行中注入建议；WebVoyager在线成功率38B模型由47%升至61%。

title_zh: MEGA-GUI：面向GUI元素的多阶段增强定位智能体
one_line: Multi-agent grounding: bidirectional ROI zoom by Gemini, instruction rewriting by GPT-4o, upscaled-crop grounding by UI-TARS-72B; 73.18% ScreenSpot-Pro, 68.63% OSWorld-G.
one_line_zh: 多智能体定位：Gemini双向ROI缩放、GPT-4o改写指令、UI-TARS-72B在放大裁剪图上定位；ScreenSpot-Pro 73.18%、OSWorld-G 68.63%。

title_zh: 构建浏览器智能体：架构、安全与实践方案
one_line: Production experience report arguing for hybrid accessibility-tree plus selective-vision context and code-enforced constraints; ~85% on 53 WebGames challenges, internally evaluated.
one_line_zh: 基于生产经验的报告，主张无障碍树结合选择性视觉的上下文管理与代码强制的安全约束；内部评测WebGames 53项挑战约85%。

title_zh: Fara-7B：面向计算机使用的高效智能体模型
one_line: FaraGen proposes, solves and LLM-verifies live-web tasks to SFT a 7B screenshot policy; live LLM-judged benchmarks, three runs, cost reported.
one_line_zh: FaraGen在真实网站上提出任务、多智能体求解并由LLM验证过滤，用于SFT 7B截图策略；在线评测由LLM判定，三次运行并报告成本。

title_zh: Prune4Web：面向网页智能体的DOM树剪枝编程
one_line: LLM writes keyword-scoring programs that prune the DOM to top-20 candidates for a grounder; offline Multimodal-Mind2Web gains plus 30-task LLM-verified online ablation.
one_line_zh: 由LLM生成关键词打分程序把DOM剪到前20候选再交给定位器；主要为离线Multimodal-Mind2Web提升，另有30个在线任务的LLM判定消融。

title_zh: 基于执行反馈强化学习训练高层调度器的长程GUI自动化
one_line: Coordinator and State Tracker trained by GRPO with a frozen executor's rule reward; offline AITZ/AMEX/GUI-Odyssey gains with role-removal ablations across executors.
one_line_zh: 用冻结执行器的规则奖励GRPO训练协调器与状态追踪器；在AITZ/AMEX/GUI-Odyssey离线指标上提升，含角色移除消融与多执行器验证。

title_zh: AFRAgent：基于自适应特征重归一化的高分辨率感知GUI智能体
one_line: Affine feature renormalisation fuses high-res crop features into InstructBLIP query tokens for a 4B mobile agent; offline AITW/Meta-GUI action matching, FLOPs and latency reported.
one_line_zh: 用仿射特征重归一化把高分辨率切块特征融入InstructBLIP查询token，4B移动端智能体；离线AITW/Meta-GUI动作匹配，报告FLOPs与延迟。

title_zh: HiconAgent：面向GUI智能体的历史上下文感知策略优化
one_line: GRPO with variable-length history sampling and action-anchored dropping of past screenshots; offline AndroidControl/AITW/GUI-Odyssey gains with 60% fewer FLOPs.
one_line_zh: GRPO训练中随机采样历史长度，并丢弃历史截图仅保留动作锚点；在AndroidControl/AITW/GUI-Odyssey离线指标提升，FLOPs降低60%。

title_zh: Chain-of-Ground：通过迭代推理与参考反馈改进GUI定位
one_line: Training-free multi-step grounding feeds back marked previous guesses across chained MLLMs; ScreenSpot-Pro 68.4 and an industrial-panel set, grounding only, cost unreported.
one_line_zh: 免训练多步定位：将上一步预测以标记反馈并串联多个MLLM迭代修正；ScreenSpot-Pro达68.4，另建工业面板集，仅评测定位，未报告成本。

title_zh: GUI探索实验室：通过多轮强化学习增强智能体的屏幕导航
one_line: Synthetic icon-graph simulator with exact rewards trains a 7B policy via SFT, single-turn and multi-turn RL; interactive gains in-simulator, real-world only static.
one_line_zh: 构建可精确给奖励的合成图标图仿真环境，对7B策略做SFT、单轮RL与多轮RL；仿真内交互评测提升，真实场景仅静态评测。

title_zh: LegalWebAgent：用基于大模型的网页智能体促进司法可及
one_line: Browser-Use-based agent acts on DOM-marked elements for Québec legal tasks; 15 live tasks judged by authors, three backbones, tokens and time reported.
one_line_zh: 基于Browser-Use、对DOM标注元素操作的法律网页智能体；在15个真实/沙盒任务上人工判定成功，比较三个模型并报告token与耗时。

title_zh: 放大再点击：释放并评测缩放在GUI定位中的潜力
one_line: Training-free pre-zoom plus progressive shrink-and-reground lifts several grounders on ScreenSpot-Pro and UI-Vision; grounding only, extra calls uncosted.
one_line_zh: 免训练的预缩放一致性检验加逐步缩小重定位，提升多种定位模型在ScreenSpot-Pro与UI-Vision的表现；仅评测定位，未计额外调用成本。

title_zh: MVP：多视图预测提升GUI定位
one_line: Training-free attention-guided multi-crop regrounding with densest-cluster voting lifts four grounders on ScreenSpot-Pro, UI-Vision and OSWorld-G; grounding only, latency unreported.
one_line_zh: 免训练：按注意力裁剪多个放大视图分别定位，取最密集聚类中心；提升四种模型在ScreenSpot-Pro、UI-Vision、OSWorld-G的表现，仅定位评测，未报告延迟。

title_zh: GAIR：基于信息联合推理与群体反思的 GUI 自动化
one_line: A general MLLM fuses three GUI grounders' outputs and re-prompts them when unsure; ScreenSpot 91.0, UI-I2E 78.4, offline grounding only.
one_line_zh: 通用 MLLM 融合多个 GUI 定位模型的输出并在信息不足时群体反思，仅在离线定位基准上评测。

title_zh: AgentProg：以程序引导的上下文管理增强长时程 GUI 智能体
one_line: Recasts history as a semantic task program: execution-tree pruning, explicit variables and a belief state; AndroidWorld 78.0%, 19-task AW-Extend 68.4%, ablated.
one_line_zh: 把交互历史重构为带变量与控制流的语义任务程序并做路径剪枝和信念状态，AndroidWorld 78.0%。

title_zh: WebSTAR：基于步级过滤的可扩展计算机使用智能体数据合成
one_line: Grades each step of OpenAI-CUA rollouts with o4-mini, trains only on correct steps plus generated thoughts; 7B beats UI-TARS-1.5-7B on WebVoyager.
one_line_zh: 用 o4-mini 对教师 CUA 轨迹逐步打分、仅在正确步上 SFT 并补充思考，7B 在 WebVoyager 超过 UI-TARS-1.5-7B。

title_zh: 将 GUI 智能体用于电子设计自动化
one_line: GUI-EDA: 2,082 expert-annotated single-step CAD screenshots scoring click-in-box and LLM-judged answers; 30+ agents benchmarked; MLLM-plus-grounder EDAgent proposed.
one_line_zh: GUI-EDA：2082 个专家标注的 CAD 单步截图基准（点击框与 LLM 评判答案），评测 30 余个智能体并提出 EDAgent。

title_zh: WebOperator：面向网页环境自主智能体的动作感知树搜索
one_line: Best-first real-execution tree search with validated, merged candidates, speculative backtracking and destructive-action deferral; WebArena 54.6% with gpt-4o, budget-scaled and ablated.
one_line_zh: 带候选校验合并、推测式回溯和破坏性动作延后的最佳优先真实执行树搜索，GPT-4o 下 WebArena 54.6%。

title_zh: Step-GUI 技术报告
one_line: Calibrated Step Reward System turns verified rollouts into LLM-written step data for 4B/8B models; OSWorld 48.5 and AndroidWorld 80.2 at pass@3.
one_line_zh: 以轨迹级校准的步奖励系统把验证过的轨迹转为 LLM 生成的步级数据训练 4B/8B 模型，pass@3 下 AndroidWorld 80.2。

title_zh: EchoTrail-GUI：通过评论家引导的自我探索为 GUI 智能体构建可执行记忆
one_line: Critic-filtered self-exploration builds a trajectory memory retrieved into a frozen VLM's prompt; AndroidWorld 51.7% (GPT-4o), critic checked against humans.
one_line_zh: 以评论家过滤的自我探索构建轨迹记忆并检索注入冻结 VLM 的提示，GPT-4o 在 AndroidWorld 达 51.7%。

title_zh: iSHIFT：具备自适应感知的轻量级快慢 GUI 智能体
one_line: 2.5B agent whose latent thinking tokens trigger an on-demand DINO perception module for precise clicks; offline AITW AMS 76.34, ablated, runtime reported.
one_line_zh: 2.5B 智能体以潜在思考令牌按需触发 DINO 视觉感知模块实现快慢切换，离线 AITW AMS 76.34。

title_zh: MAI-UI 技术报告：面向真实世界的基础 GUI 智能体
one_line: Qwen3-VL GUI agents (2B-235B) trained by self-evolving SFT then 512-environment online RL, with ask_user/MCP actions; AndroidWorld 76.7%, MobileWorld 41.7%.
one_line_zh: 基于 Qwen3-VL 的 2B-235B GUI 智能体，经自演化 SFT 与 512 并行环境在线 RL 训练，AndroidWorld 76.7%。

title_zh: SmartSnap：面向自验证智能体的主动证据搜寻
one_line: Agent curates and creates minimal evidence snapshots so an LLM judge rewards GRPO; AndroidLab SR +16-26 points for 8B-32B models, judge unvalidated.
one_line_zh: 让智能体主动收集并提交最少的证据快照供 LLM 评判给出 RL 奖励，AndroidLab 成功率提升 16-26 个百分点。

title_zh: 面向智能体信息检索的嵌套式浏览器使用学习
one_line: Minimal search/visit/click/fill toolkit with nested inner-loop page extraction, trained by multi-task imitation; strong BrowseComp/GAIA accuracy, ablated with GPT-OSS-120B.
one_line_zh: 四动作极简浏览器工具集加嵌套页内抽取，小模型深度检索表现强

title_zh: ShowUI-π：以流匹配生成模型作为 GUI 灵巧之手
one_line: Unified click/drag cursor trajectories from a flow-matching action expert (450M); ScreenDrag replay-based closed-loop success 26.98 vs Gemini-2.5-CUA 22.18.
one_line_zh: 流匹配动作专家统一生成点击与拖拽轨迹，回放式闭环评测领先

title_zh: FocusUI：基于位置保持的视觉 token 选择的高效 UI 定位
one_line: Query-guided patch saliency scorer with UI-graph prior keeps 30-50% visual tokens plus PosPad markers; grounding accuracy near dense, 1.44x faster.
one_line_zh: 指令引导视觉token选择并以PosPad保位，30%token精度接近且提速

title_zh: MobileDreamer：面向 GUI 智能体的生成式草图世界模型
one_line: OCR-element textual-sketch world model with order-invariant matching loss feeds a depth-2 tree-of-prediction to prompted agents; AndroidWorld +4-7 points across five backbones.
one_line_zh: 文本草图世界模型生成深度2预测树辅助选动作，AndroidWorld提升

title_zh: InfiniteWeb：面向 GUI 智能体训练的可扩展网页环境合成
one_line: Synthesises functional websites from task-derived specs with test-driven repair and instrumented dense evaluators; GRPO on 600 tasks lifts UI-TARS-1.5-7B on OSWorld/Online-Mind2Web/MobileWorld.
one_line_zh: 规格驱动测试修复合成可验证网站，GRPO训练后三类真实基准均提升

title_zh: GUITester：让 GUI 智能体进行探索式缺陷发现
one_line: Planner embeds test intents; a monitor checks each action's before/after screens and a reflector attributes anomalies; GUITestBench defect F1 48.90 vs 33.35 (Pass@3).
one_line_zh: 规划嵌入测试意图，监控与反思归因异常，缺陷发现F1达48.9%

title_zh: 从离策略到在策略：通过双层专家到策略同化增强 GUI 智能体
one_line: Re-rolls expert plans under the base policy and caches own successes, injected into GRPO on total group failure; OSWorld-Verified 22.87 -> 32.13 (3 runs).
one_line_zh: 按专家计划自滚轨迹并缓存自身成功，组失败时注入GRPO提升OSWorld

title_zh: 超越点击：通过文本拖拽迈向通用 GUI 定位
one_line: OCR-plus-LLM pipeline synthesises 161K text-drag grounding examples; continual training of Jedi raises offline ScreenDrag SR to 38.1% while keeping click accuracy.
one_line_zh: OCR加大模型合成16万文本拖拽数据，持续训练提升离线拖拽定位

title_zh: C-World：计算机使用智能体环境创建器
one_line: MCP tool environment creator with task synthesis, failure-injecting state controller and judge rewards; simulated World Engine preserves model ranking (rho 0.883); 1.2K trajectories fine-tune well.
one_line_zh: MCP工具环境创建器，模拟引擎与真实执行排名相关0.883

title_zh: V2P：通过背景抑制与中心峰化校准 GUI 定位的视觉注意力
one_line: Abstract only: suppression attention plus size-scaled Gaussian heatmap targets for attention-based GUI grounding; reports ScreenSpot-v2 92.4 and ScreenSpot-Pro 52.5.
one_line_zh: 仅摘要：背景抑制注意力与高斯中心监督提升GUI定位精度

title_zh: ShowUI-Aloha：由人类示教的GUI智能体
one_line: Converts recorded human desktop demonstrations into captioned traces that guide a GPT-4o planner; per-task demos on manually re-run OSWorld tasks, single run, no matched baseline.
one_line_zh: 把人类桌面录屏解析为示教轨迹指导规划；逐任务示教、单次运行、无可比基线。

title_zh: ColorBrowserAgent：具备自适应知识演化的复杂长程浏览器智能体
one_line: Retrieves human-distilled site tips built from WebArena failures plus progressive history summarization; GPT-5 agent reaches 71.2% WebArena, transfers to WebChoreArena, single runs.
one_line_zh: 人工提炼站点技巧入库检索并渐进摘要；WebArena达71.2%，可迁移。

title_zh: OS-Symphony：面向稳健通用计算机使用智能体的整体框架
one_line: Orchestrator with a milestone-memory reflection agent and a browsing tutorial searcher; OSWorld 65.8%, WindowsAgentArena, MacOSArena, ablations and cost reported, single runs.
one_line_zh: 里程碑记忆反思与多模态教程搜索；OSWorld达65.8%，含消融与成本。

title_zh: ExpSeek：面向网页智能体的自触发经验检索
one_line: Entropy-triggered step-level guidance generated from a mistake-triplet experience base for search web agents; +9.3/+7.5 on four web QA benchmarks, five runs, LLM-judged.
one_line_zh: 熵阈值自触发步级经验指导；四个网页问答基准提升7.5至9.3分。

title_zh: PersonalAlign：基于长期用户记录的个性化GUI智能体分层隐式意图对齐
one_line: AndroidIntent benchmark of vague instructions and routines from long-term user records, plus hierarchical preference/routine memory; offline step metrics and LLM-judged proactive suggestions.
one_line_zh: 长期用户记录个性化基准与分层意图记忆；仅离线步级与LLM评判。

title_zh: GUI-Eyes：面向GUI智能体视觉定位的工具增强感知
one_line: GRPO-trained two-stage grounding that learns when and where to crop/zoom, with a center-plus-overlap tool reward; ScreenSpot-Pro 44.8% at 3B, grounding only.
one_line_zh: RL学习何时如何裁剪放大再定位；3B在ScreenSpot-Pro达44.8%。

title_zh: CaMeL也能用电脑：面向计算机使用智能体的系统级安全
one_line: Single-shot branching Observe-Verify-Act plans from a screen-blind planner with quarantined perception; OSWorld utility retained, token cost reported, Branch Steering attacks break redundancy defenses.
one_line_zh: 盲规划器预生成分支计划隔离感知；OSWorld保留效用，分支操控仍可攻破。

title_zh: 压缩以聚焦：面向多轮GUI智能体策略优化的高效坐标压缩
one_line: Crops history screenshots around rollout-aggregated coordinates during semi-online RL with a distance-based reward; offline AndroidControl/GUI-Odyssey/Mind2Web/AITW gains, 3.8x faster training.
one_line_zh: 按坐标裁剪历史截图的半在线RL；离线基准小幅提升，训练快3.8倍。

title_zh: MirrorGuard：通过仿真到现实的推理纠正实现安全的计算机使用智能体
one_line: A 7B corrector trained on text-simulated risky trajectories rewrites unsafe thoughts before actions; lowers unsafe rates on OS-Harm/RiOSWorld across six CUAs with low false refusals.
one_line_zh: 文本仿真训练推理纠正器改写不安全思考；不安全率大降，误拒率低。

title_zh: EvoCUA：通过可扩展合成经验学习演化的计算机使用智能体
one_line: Co-generates desktop tasks with executable validators, rolls out at scale in sandboxes, and iterates RFT plus failure-derived DPO; OSWorld 56.7% at 32B, staged ablations.
one_line_zh: 合成任务与可执行验证器，迭代RFT与DPO；32B在OSWorld达56.7%。

title_zh: GraphPilot：基于知识图谱、一步式LLM推理的GUI任务自动化
one_line: Builds per-app knowledge graphs from offline exploration so GPT-4o plans whole action sequences in ~1 query; DroidTask exact-match TCR 74.1%, latency -70%.
one_line_zh: 离线探索目标应用构建知识图谱，使GPT-4o约一次查询生成完整动作序列；DroidTask精确匹配完成率74.1%，延迟降约70%。

title_zh: SwipeGen：通过类人滑动合成弥合GUI智能体的执行鸿沟
one_line: Explores apps, executes candidate swipes, keeps pixel-verified ones, VLM-describes them, RL-tunes a 3B model; SwipeBench 61.25%, AndroidWorld 40.52%.
one_line_zh: 探索应用并执行候选滑动，保留像素校验有效者并由VLM生成描述，用于RL微调3B模型；SwipeBench 61.25%，AndroidWorld 40.52%。

title_zh: MAGNET：基于记忆驱动知识演化的自适应GUI智能体
one_line: Dual memory (workflow templates for planner, UI-patch exemplars for actor) with usage-based ranking; AndroidWorld 42.62% vs Agent-S 40.98%, small offline shift gains.
one_line_zh: 双层记忆（规划器用工作流模板、执行器用UI图块示例）配合基于使用的排序；AndroidWorld 42.62%对比Agent-S 40.98%，分布偏移下增益较小。

title_zh: Me-Agent：具备两级用户习惯学习的个性化移动智能体
one_line: Training-free personalization: VLM-rewarded rollouts distilled into an experience pool plus app-level preference memory; beats Mobile-Agent-E on new User FingerTip benchmark.
one_line_zh: 免训练个性化：以VLM奖励评估多次执行并提炼经验池，结合按应用分层的偏好记忆；在新基准User FingerTip上优于Mobile-Agent-E。

title_zh: OmegaUse：构建面向自主任务执行的通用GUI智能体
one_line: MoE 30B-A3B GUI agent: curated grounding data, explored and taxonomy-synthesised trajectories, SFT then rule-reward GRPO; ScreenSpot-V2 96.3%, AndroidWorld 55.7%.
one_line_zh: 基于30B-A3B MoE的GUI智能体：人工精修定位数据与探索/分类体系合成轨迹，SFT后接规则奖励GRPO；ScreenSpot-V2 96.3%，AndroidWorld 55.7%。

title_zh: 持续学习GUI智能体
one_line: Adds prediction-diversity point/region rewards to GRPO grounding under sequential domain/resolution shifts; Qwen2.5VL-3B beats SE-GUI/GUI-G2 on ScreenSpot v1/v2/Pro.
one_line_zh: 在GRPO定位训练中加入预测点与区域多样性奖励以应对领域/分辨率的持续变化；Qwen2.5VL-3B在ScreenSpot系列上优于SE-GUI与GUI-G2。

title_zh: CUA-Skill：为计算机使用智能体开发技能
one_line: Hand-engineered library of 452 parameterised Windows skills with execution/composition graphs, retrieved and configured by a GPT-5 planner; WAA 50.3% (57.5% best-of-3).
one_line_zh: 人工构建452个带执行图与组合图的参数化Windows技能库，由GPT-5规划器检索并配置参数；WAA成功率50.3%（三次取优57.5%）。

title_zh: CovAgent：借助智能体AI与动态插桩突破移动应用30%覆盖率魔咒
one_line: LLM agents infer activation conditions of unreached Android activities from Smali/CTG and generate validated Frida hooks for fuzzers; activity coverage 49.5% vs APE 17.7%.
one_line_zh: LLM智能体从Smali代码与组件转移图推断未达活动的激活条件并生成经验证的Frida插桩脚本辅助模糊测试；活动覆盖率49.5%对比APE 17.7%。

title_zh: BEAP-Agent：面向GUI智能体的可回溯执行与自适应规划
one_line: Planner–Executor–Tracker agent treating execution as DFS with multi-step backtracking and plan updates; OSWorld 28.2% vs 26.3% without backtracking (50 steps).
one_line_zh: 规划器-执行器-追踪器框架将任务执行建模为DFS，支持多步状态回溯与计划更新；OSWorld 50步准确率28.2%，去掉回溯为26.3%。

title_zh: DynaWeb：网页智能体的基于模型强化学习
one_line: Model-based RL: an LLM web world model predicts state-change descriptions; GSPO trains on ≤5-step dreams mixed with real expert trajectories; WebArena 31.0%, WebVoyager 38.7%.
one_line_zh: 基于模型的强化学习：LLM网页世界模型预测状态变化描述，GSPO在不超过5步的想象轨迹与真实专家轨迹混合上训练；WebArena 31.0%，WebVoyager 38.7%。

title_zh: 达尔文记忆：面向 GUI 智能体进化的免训练自调节记忆系统
one_line: Training-free memory of precondition-goal subtask trajectories with utility-based pruning, mutation and Bayesian risk; AndroidWorld 41.0% to 66.4%, memory built on the test tasks.
one_line_zh: 以前置条件-目标子任务轨迹为单元的免训练记忆，按效用剪枝并做变异与贝叶斯风险抑制；AndroidWorld 由 41.0% 升至 66.4%，但记忆在测试任务上累积。

title_zh: 在挑战中学习：面向移动 GUI 智能体训练的自适应难度感知数据生成
one_line: Profiles the student agent's capability frontier and samples structural/semantic task difficulty for a multi-agent trajectory generator; beats OS-Genesis and GUI-ReWalk at 500 trajectories.
one_line_zh: 先刻画学生智能体的能力边界，再按结构与语义难度分布驱动多智能体生成轨迹；在 500 条轨迹规模下优于 OS-Genesis 与 GUI-ReWalk。

title_zh: SimGym：基于真实流量的浏览器智能体用于电商离线 A/B 测试
one_line: Traffic-grounded persona LLM agents browse live control/treatment storefronts to predict A/B outcomes; 69% directional alignment, 0.64 correlation on 20 shops; memory and persona ablated.
one_line_zh: 以真实流量提取的买家画像驱动 LLM 智能体在真实店面对照/实验版本中浏览以预测 A/B 结果；20 家店铺方向一致率 69%、相关 0.64，消融了记忆与画像。

title_zh: 生成式视觉代码移动端世界模型
one_line: Trains 8B/32B VLM world models emitting the next mobile screen as renderable web code from relabelled trajectories; VLM-judged accuracy 79.6% on offline ID/OOD sets.
one_line_zh: 把离线轨迹重标注为网页代码，训练 8B/32B VLM 世界模型以可渲染代码生成下一屏；在分布内外离线基准上 VLM 评判准确率达 79.6%。

title_zh: SafePred：基于世界模型的计算机使用智能体预测式护栏
one_line: Predictive guardrail: an LLM world model forecasts short- and long-term consequences of candidate actions against safety policies, pruning or replanning; OS-Harm/WASP compliance up to 99%.
one_line_zh: 预测式护栏：LLM 世界模型依据安全策略预测候选动作的短期与长期后果并剪枝或重规划；OS-Harm/WASP 合规率最高达 99%。

title_zh: Avenir-Web：模仿人类经验、采用混合定位专家的多模态网页智能体
one_line: Web agent combining web-guide-retrieved planning, a task checklist, recursive memory and visual-first grounding with DOM fallback; Online-Mind2Web 53.7% with Gemini 3 Pro.
one_line_zh: 结合检索在线指南的规划、任务检查清单、递归记忆与视觉优先+DOM 兜底定位的网页智能体；Gemini 3 Pro 下 Online-Mind2Web 成功率 53.7%。

title_zh: ToolTok：面向高效可泛化 GUI 智能体的工具 token 化
one_line: Replaces coordinate grounding with semantically initialised cursor-move/click tool tokens and multi-step pathfinding via a 3-stage curriculum; offline ScreenSpot-family accuracy only.
one_line_zh: 以语义初始化的光标移动/点击工具 token 和多步寻路取代坐标定位，并用三阶段课程训练；仅报告 ScreenSpot 系列离线准确率。

title_zh: Agent Alpha：统一生成、探索与评估的计算机使用智能体树搜索
one_line: Step-level MCTS over real OSWorld execution with comparative MLLM judging, max backup, deduplicated expansion; 77.29% SR; 64.27% vs Agent S3 54.29% same backbone.
one_line_zh: 在 OSWorld 真实执行上进行步级 MCTS，配合比较式 MLLM 评判、最大值回传与去重扩展；成功率 77.29%，同底座下 64.27% 对 Agent S3 的 54.29%。

title_zh: M²-Miner：多智能体增强的 MCTS 移动 GUI 智能体数据挖掘
one_line: MCTS data mining with infer/orchestra/judge agents, intent recycling of side branches and model-in-the-loop training; 7B SFT reaches SOTA offline step SR on AC, AITZ, CAGUI.
one_line_zh: 以推理/编排/评判多智能体增强 MCTS 挖掘意图-轨迹数据，回收分支路径生成新意图并迭代训练；7B 模型在 AC、AITZ、CAGUI 离线步成功率达 SOTA。

title_zh: UI-Mem：面向移动 GUI 智能体在线强化学习的自演化经验记忆
one_line: Hierarchical templated memory (workflows, skills, failure patterns) guides stratified GRPO rollouts and inference; AndroidWorld 8B 47.6% to 71.1%, gains on five held-out apps.
one_line_zh: 以模板化的层级记忆（工作流、子任务技能、失败模式）分层引导 GRPO 采样与推理；8B 模型 AndroidWorld 由 47.6% 升至 71.1%，在五个未见应用上也有提升。

title_zh: Trifuse：通过多模态融合增强基于注意力的 GUI 定位
one_line: Training-free grounding fuses MLLM attention, OCR and icon-caption heatmaps with consensus fusion and zoom; static grounding benchmarks only.
one_line_zh: 免训练地融合 MLLM 注意力、OCR 与图标描述热力图并放大细化定位，仅在静态定位基准上评估。

title_zh: POINTS-GUI-G：GUI 定位之旅
one_line: 8B grounder built via curated/filtered data, unfrozen encoder, resolution consistency and point-in-box GRPO; static grounding benchmarks only.
one_line_zh: 通过数据清洗与难度分级、解冻视觉编码器、分辨率一致性及点在框内奖励的 GRPO 训练 8B 定位模型，仅静态基准评估。

title_zh: ANCHOR：面向 GUI 智能体的分支点数据生成
one_line: Expands verified seed desktop trajectories at UI branch points into new verified tasks for SFT; OSWorld and WindowsAgentArena gains over task-driven synthesis.
one_line_zh: 在已验证种子轨迹的界面分支点扩展出新任务并验证过滤用于 SFT，在 OSWorld 与 WindowsAgentArena 上优于任务驱动合成。

title_zh: 多智能体会梦见电子屏幕吗？通过任务分解在 AndroidWorld 上实现满分
one_line: Six-agent planner/orchestrator/cortex/executor decomposition with deterministic text-input verification and loop detection; 100% AndroidWorld, role ablations and per-task cost.
one_line_zh: 六智能体规划-编排-决策-执行分解，加确定性文本输入校验与循环检测，AndroidWorld 达 100%，含角色消融与单任务成本。

title_zh: 当动作偏离任务：检测并纠正计算机使用智能体中的错位动作
one_line: Pre-execution LLM guardrail detects misaligned or injected actions and returns corrective feedback; human-labelled benchmark plus RedTeamCUA/OSWorld online ASR and utility.
one_line_zh: 执行前用 LLM 守卫检测偏离意图或被注入的动作并反馈纠正，配人工标注基准及 RedTeamCUA/OSWorld 在线攻击率与效用评估。

title_zh: UI-Venus-1.5 技术报告
one_line: End-to-end GUI agent trained by mid-training, offline GRPO, full-trajectory online RL and model merging; AndroidWorld 77.6% with stage ablations.
one_line_zh: 通过中期训练、离线 GRPO、全轨迹在线强化学习与模型合并训练端到端 GUI 智能体，AndroidWorld 77.6%，含分阶段消融。

title_zh: TreeCUA：以树结构可验证演化高效扩展 GUI 自动化
one_line: Tree-structured knowledge-guided exploration with node replay, hindsight task summarisation and branch-pair DPO; OSWorld-Verified 36.6% and judged OOD apps.
one_line_zh: 知识引导的树状探索配合节点重放、事后任务总结与分支偏好 DPO，OSWorld-Verified 36.6%，并在 LLM 评判的域外应用上测试。

title_zh: Code2World：基于可渲染代码生成的 GUI 世界模型
one_line: Next-screen prediction as renderable HTML via SFT plus VLM-judged render-aware RL; as a lookahead simulator lifts Gemini-2.5-Flash AndroidWorld 41.4 to 50.9.
