one_line_zh: 以可渲染 HTML 预测下一屏，经 SFT 与 VLM 评判的渲染感知强化学习训练，作为前瞻模拟器将 AndroidWorld 成功率从 41.4 提至 50.9。

title_zh: 面向移动 GUI 智能体的匿名化隐私保护：可用但不可见
one_line: Local layer replaces PII with consistent type-preserving placeholders and reverse-maps agent actions; AndroidLab utility near unprotected, PrivScreen leakage strongly reduced.
one_line_zh: 本地层以一致的类型保留占位符替换隐私信息并反向映射智能体动作，AndroidLab 效用接近无保护，PrivScreen 泄露大幅下降。

title_zh: 面向计算机使用智能体环境适应的自主持续学习
one_line: Exploration-grounded curriculum task generation plus validated CUAJudge reward for iterative GRPO in target apps; 3-29% gains on OSWorld/ScienceBoard without forgetting.
one_line_zh: 基于探索经验的课程式任务生成与经人工验证的 CUAJudge 奖励驱动目标应用内迭代 GRPO，获 3-29% 提升且无灾难性遗忘。

title_zh: 面向GUI智能体的自适应里程碑奖励
one_line: Dense RL reward from LLM-distilled, adaptively updated milestones matched by SBERT; beats outcome/process rewards by several SR points on AndroidWorld.
one_line_zh: 用LLM从成功轨迹提炼并自适应更新里程碑、经语义匹配给出稠密奖励；在AndroidWorld上优于结果与过程奖励。

title_zh: WebTestPilot：通过符号化GUI元素推断测试预言，依据自然语言需求进行智能体端到端Web测试
one_line: LLM tester symbolizes GUI elements and infers per-step pre/post-condition DSL assertions as oracles; 0.96 bug-detection precision/recall on in-house bug-injected apps.
one_line_zh: 将GUI元素符号化并为每步推断前后置条件断言作为测试预言；在自建注入缺陷的Web应用上缺陷检测精确率与召回率均为0.96。

title_zh: 面向网页智能体的智能体式测试时扩展
one_line: Allocates per-step test-time compute by vote entropy/margin, calling an LLM arbiter only on contentious steps; up to +11.8% over majority voting with fewer tokens.
one_line_zh: 依据候选动作投票熵/间隔动态分配每步测试时计算，仅在分歧步调用LLM仲裁；比多数投票最高提升11.8%且更省token。

title_zh: 通过自动数据生成与细粒度评估扩展网页智能体训练
one_line: LLM-judged constraint satisfaction filters teacher trajectories and keeps partial-success prefixes with hindsight relabeling; distilled 24B agent rivals commercial agents on LLM-judged live booking tasks.
one_line_zh: 用LLM逐约束判定满足率筛选教师轨迹并保留部分成功前缀、事后重标注；蒸馏的24B模型在LLM评判的真实预订任务上接近商用智能体。

title_zh: OpAgent：面向网页导航的操作员智能体
one_line: Multi-task SFT, then online GRPO on live sites with WebJudge outcome plus rule-tree process reward; modular Gemini-based agent reaches 71.6% WebArena with human site tips.
one_line_zh: 多任务SFT后在真实网站上以WebJudge结果奖励加规则决策树过程奖励做在线GRPO；模块化Gemini智能体借人工站点提示在WebArena达71.6%。

title_zh: 基于智能体Q估计与逐步策略优化构建自主GUI导航
one_line: Trains a step-level Q-model on outcome-propagated labels from self-generated trajectories, then environment-free step-wise GRPO/RLOO; about +10 points on live WebVoyager and Online-Mind2Web.
one_line_zh: 用自生成轨迹的结果回传标签训练步级Q模型，再脱离环境做逐步GRPO/RLOO；在实时WebVoyager与Online-Mind2Web上提升约10个点。

title_zh: GUI-GENESIS：为GUI智能体后训练自动合成带可验证奖励的高效环境
one_line: Code LLMs rebuild real mini-app traces into task-scoped Flask apps with code-native rewards; sim-only GRPO beats real-app RL (42.28 vs 40.94) on held-out real tasks.
one_line_zh: 用代码大模型把真实小程序轨迹重建为按任务限定的轻量Web应用并内嵌代码奖励；仅在合成环境训练即在真实保留任务上超过真实环境RL。

title_zh: AutoWebWorld：通过有限状态机合成无限可验证的网页环境
one_line: LLMs write FSM specs and code them into websites; BFS yields verified trajectories for GRPO; 7B agent reaches 27.42% on nine LLM-judged WebVoyager sites.
one_line_zh: 用LLM生成有限状态机规格并编码为网站，BFS得到可验证轨迹用于GRPO；7B模型在9个LLM评判的WebVoyager站点达27.42%。

title_zh: WebWorld：面向网页智能体训练的大规模世界模型
one_line: LLM world model trained on 1M+ real open-web a11y transitions synthesizes agent training trajectories; +9.2 WebArena SR for Qwen3-14B; fidelity GPT-4o-judged.
one_line_zh: 在百万级真实开放网页可访问性树转移上训练的LLM世界模型，用其合成轨迹训练智能体，Qwen3-14B在WebArena提升9.2点；保真度由GPT-4o评判。

title_zh: EmbeWebAgent：将网页智能体嵌入任意定制界面
one_line: Embeds agents via frontend ARIA/URL observations and a per-page function registry of mixed-granularity actions; demo only, without quantitative evaluation.
one_line_zh: 通过前端ARIA与URL观测及按页函数注册表（混合粒度动作）把智能体嵌入现有界面；仅有演示，无定量评估。

title_zh: 带动作纠正的世界模型增强网页智能体
one_line: Before execution, a prompted world model simulates candidate actions one step ahead and a judge triggers corrective re-proposal; small online gains on VisualWebArena and Online-Mind2Web.
one_line_zh: 执行前用提示式世界模型单步模拟候选动作并由评审模型触发纠正，在线网页基准上小幅提升。

title_zh: Mobile-Agent-v3.5：多平台基础 GUI 智能体
one_line: Native multi-size GUI policy trained via hybrid sim/sandbox data flywheel, thought synthesis and multi-platform environment RL; online results on desktop, mobile and web benchmarks.
one_line_zh: 以仿真与云沙箱混合数据飞轮、思维合成和多平台环境强化学习训练原生 GUI 模型，跨桌面、移动、网页在线评测。

title_zh: IntentCUA：为计算机使用智能体学习意图级表示以实现技能抽象与多智能体规划
one_line: Clusters user interaction traces into intent-level skills and plan memory retrieved by a GPT-4o planner/optimizer/critic; live desktop and web tasks, ablated.
one_line_zh: 将用户交互轨迹聚类为意图级技能与计划记忆，供 GPT-4o 多智能体规划检索，在真实桌面与网页任务上评测并消融。

title_zh: 计算机使用世界模型
one_line: Office world model predicts a textual UI change then renders the next screenshot by diffusion; used for one-step test-time action search, evaluated offline on GUI-360.
one_line_zh: Office 世界模型先预测文本化界面变化再用扩散模型渲染下一屏，用于单步测试时动作搜索，在 GUI-360 上离线评估。

title_zh: ActionEngine：借助状态机记忆从反应式走向程序化的网页智能体
one_line: Offline crawler builds a patchable state-machine memory of app states and operations; planner emits one program per task; WebArena success, latency and cost reported.
one_line_zh: 离线爬取构建可修补的应用状态机记忆，规划器每任务一次生成程序执行，在 WebArena 上报告成功率、延迟与成本。

title_zh: GUI-Libra：以动作感知监督与部分可验证强化学习训练能推理与行动的原生 GUI 智能体
one_line: Curated 81K reasoning data, action-weighted SFT and KL-regularised step-wise GRPO under partial verifiability; online gains on AndroidWorld, WebArena-Lite-v2, Online-Mind2Web.
one_line_zh: 整理 81K 推理数据，动作加权 SFT 加 KL 约束的逐步 GRPO 应对部分可验证性，在移动与网页在线基准上提升。

title_zh: 面向高效高分辨率 GUI 智能体的时空 token 剪枝
one_line: Training-free pruning: decaying resolution for history frames and structure-aware token retention for the current screen; offline step accuracy with FLOPs and latency.
one_line_zh: 免训练剪枝：历史帧按时间衰减降分辨率，当前帧结构感知保留 token，离线步准确率并报告算力与延迟。

title_zh: CoME：以信息丰富的混合能力推理赋能移动专家通道
one_line: Four stage-aligned FFN expert channels routed per output token, progressive SFT and information-gain DPO; offline AITZ and AMEX action-match accuracy only.
one_line_zh: 按推理阶段为输出 token 激活四个专家通道，渐进式微调加信息增益 DPO，仅在 AITZ 与 AMEX 离线动作匹配上评估。

title_zh: ST-Lite：面向长程 GUI 智能体的时空轨迹引导免训练 KV 缓存压缩
one_line: Training-free KV-cache eviction keeping UI-element boundary tokens and history tokens not covered by the current frame; per-step accuracy and decoding speedup.
one_line_zh: 免训练 KV 缓存压缩，保留界面元素边界 token 与当前帧未覆盖的历史 token，报告逐步准确率与解码加速。

title_zh: M²：通过轨迹摘要与洞见检索为长程网页智能体提供双重记忆增强
one_line: Training-free agent replaces raw history with self-written step summaries and retrieves insights distilled from 55k successful trajectories; live web, GPT-4o-judged success.
one_line_zh: 免训练地以自写步骤摘要替代原始历史，并检索由 5.5 万条成功轨迹提炼的洞见，在真实网页上评测、GPT-4o 判定成功。

title_zh: K²-Agent：面向分层移动设备控制的“知道什么”与“知道如何”协同进化
one_line: Planner distils per-task declarative knowledge from one demo and refines it by reflection; executor trained with curriculum GRPO; AndroidWorld 76.1% over 3 runs.
one_line_zh: 规划器从单条示范提炼任务知识并经反思修订，执行器用课程式 GRPO 训练，AndroidWorld 三次运行 76.1%。

title_zh: CGL：通过强化微调推进持续 GUI 学习
one_line: Mixes offline GRPO with entropy-weighted SFT and gradient surgery to curb forgetting across AndroidControl app groups; offline step accuracy only.
one_line_zh: 将离线 GRPO 与熵调节的 SFT 及梯度手术结合，缓解 AndroidControl 应用组间的遗忘，仅有离线步级准确率。

title_zh: 双模态多阶段对抗安全训练：增强多模态网页智能体抵御跨模态攻击的能力
one_line: Hardens a web agent against DOM injections hitting screenshot and a11y tree via imitation, oracle-guided SFT and GRPO attacker-agent self-play; held-out MiniWob++ and VisualWebArena.
one_line_zh: 通过模仿学习、预言机引导 SFT 与 GRPO 攻防自博弈，抵御同时污染截图与可访问性树的注入；在留出任务上验证。

title_zh: WebFactory：将基础语言智能自动压缩为具身网页智能体
one_line: LLM-built offline websites expose knowledge and data so generated tasks have verifiable answers; GRPO on executor trajectories; tested on internal sites and 90 live tasks.
one_line_zh: 用 LLM 构建离线网站并暴露数据层，生成可验证任务，以 GRPO 训练；在内部站点与 90 个在线任务上测试。

title_zh: 利用分层记忆树增强网页智能体
one_line: Abstracts successful trajectories into intent/stage/action tree with pre/post-conditions and semantic element descriptions; stage-aware planner-actor; WebArena 38.7%, Mind2Web cross-website gains.
one_line_zh: 将成功轨迹抽象为意图-阶段-动作树并配前后置条件，阶段感知的规划-执行；WebArena 38.7%，跨网站提升。

title_zh: OSExpert：计算机使用智能体通过探索学习专业技能
one_line: GUI-DFS exploration of each app builds a verified skill set plus fine-grained primitives, a one-pass planner and early stop; ~20-30% success on own 113-task benchmark.
one_line_zh: 以 GUI-DFS 探索各应用构建经验证的技能库与细粒度原语、单次规划及提前终止，在自建 113 任务基准上约 20-30%。

title_zh: SecAgent：具备语义上下文的高效移动 GUI 智能体
one_line: 3B mobile agent keeps the last screenshot plus a self-written semantic history summary, trained by SFT+GRPO on a new Chinese dataset; offline step metrics.
one_line_zh: 3B 移动智能体仅保留上一截图与自写的历史语义摘要，在新中文数据集上 SFT+GRPO 训练，仅离线步级评估。

title_zh: 面向 GUI 智能体的混合自进化结构化记忆
one_line: Graph memory couples VLM-written strategy/tag nodes with continuous trajectory embeddings, self-evolving add/merge/replace and phase-triggered re-retrieval; LLM-judged web success gains.
one_line_zh: 图结构记忆结合 VLM 生成的策略/标签节点与连续轨迹嵌入，支持自进化与阶段触发重检索，网页成功率由 LLM 评判。

title_zh: 通过重建网站实现安全且可扩展的网页智能体学习
one_line: Coding agent clones 149 real sites with backend and SDK; executable task validators give deterministic rewards for rejection fine-tuning; gains on held-out WebArena, Mind2Web-Online.
one_line_zh: 编码智能体克隆 149 个真实网站及后端与 SDK，任务附可执行验证程序提供确定性奖励，在留出 WebArena 与 Mind2Web-Online 上提升。

title_zh: HATS：面向 GUI 智能体的难度感知轨迹合成
one_line: Hardness-driven MCTS exploration plus replay-verified iterative instruction refinement for reverse-synthesised trajectories; SFT agents beat OS-Genesis on AndroidWorld and WebArena subsets.
one_line_zh: 以难度驱动的 MCTS 探索并通过回放验证迭代精炼反向合成指令，SFT 后在 AndroidWorld 与 WebArena 子集上超过 OS-Genesis。

title_zh: 面向基于大语言模型的网页智能体的 AI 规划框架
one_line: Maps web-agent architectures to search paradigms, adds LLM-judged trajectory metrics against human gold traces; WebArena comparison of two prompted agents.
one_line_zh: 将网页智能体架构映射到经典搜索范式，并提出基于人工金标轨迹、由 LLM 判定的轨迹质量指标，在 WebArena 上对比两种提示式智能体。

title_zh: 面向计算机使用智能体的自适应视觉语言模型路由
one_line: Routes each CUA tool call to the cheapest VLM by difficulty embedding and logprob confidence; cost savings are analytical projections, not measured on CUA tasks.
one_line_zh: 按难度嵌入与对数概率置信度将每次工具调用路由到最便宜的 VLM；成本节省为解析推算，未在 CUA 任务上实测。

title_zh: 聚焦本质：基于界面元素推理的免训练 GUI 定位
one_line: Training-free grounding: optimises latent thought vectors to refine instructions, then zooms iteratively via decoder attention; static grounding benchmarks only.
one_line_zh: 免训练定位：优化潜在思维向量改写指令，再依据解码注意力迭代放大目标区域；仅在静态定位基准上评估。

title_zh: AdaZoom-GUI：结合指令改写的自适应缩放 GUI 定位
one_line: GRPO-trained 4B grounder predicts point and box; zooms only on small predicted targets, with a 397B instruction refiner; ScreenSpot-Pro/v2 only.
one_line_zh: 以 GRPO 训练的 4B 定位模型同时预测点与框，仅对小目标触发二次放大，并用 397B 模型改写指令；仅在 ScreenSpot 系列上评估。

title_zh: AndroTMem：从交互轨迹到长时程 GUI 智能体的锚定记忆
one_line: Represents history as causally linked state anchors instead of full replay or summaries; long-horizon Android benchmark scored offline by action matching.
one_line_zh: 以因果关联的中间状态锚点表示交互历史，替代完整回放或摘要；在长时程安卓基准上以离线动作匹配评估。

title_zh: 用于改进长时程 LLM 智能体的子目标驱动框架
one_line: Teacher-generated subgoals give inference-time milestone checks and a dense potential-critic reward for online RL; Gemma3-12B reaches 43.0% on WebArena-Lite.
one_line_zh: 由教师模型生成子目标，用于推理时里程碑检查及在线强化学习的稠密势函数奖励；Gemma3-12B 在 WebArena-Lite 达 43.0%。

title_zh: ContractSkill：面向多模态网页智能体的可修复契约式技能
one_line: Compiles self-generated web skills into contracts repaired via deterministic step verification and minimal patches; VisualWebArena and MiniWoB gains, verifier itself unvalidated.
one_line_zh: 将自生成网页技能编译为契约，借确定性逐步校验与最小补丁修复；在 VisualWebArena 与 MiniWoB 上提升，但校验器未经验证。

title_zh: MANA：基于多模态智能体 UI 导航的高效移动广告检测
one_line: Fuses static-analysis ad priors, UTG context, VLM captions and cross-app memory to steer LLM app exploration toward hidden ads on real phones.
one_line_zh: 融合静态分析广告先验、UI 转移图上下文、VLM 描述与跨应用记忆，引导 LLM 在真机上探索以发现隐藏广告。

title_zh: 原生 GUI 智能体的验证码求解：自动化推理-动作数据生成与自纠正训练
one_line: Procedural CAPTCHA environment yields ground-truth-conditioned reasoning-action and self-correction traces for SFT; gains on held-out and zero-shot real-world CAPTCHAs.
one_line_zh: 以程序化验证码环境生成基于真值的推理-动作与自纠正轨迹进行 SFT，在留出及零样本真实验证码上提升。

title_zh: CarePilot：面向医疗领域长时程计算机任务自动化的多智能体框架
one_line: Actor-critic agent with tool grounding, dual memory and critic-driven hierarchical reflection on a healthcare GUI benchmark; offline exact-match step and task accuracy.
one_line_zh: 结合工具定位、双重记忆与评论家分层反思的演员-评论家智能体，在医疗软件基准上以离线精确匹配评估。

title_zh: UI-Voyager：从失败经验中学习的自演化 GUI 智能体
one_line: Rejection fine-tuning then fork-point self-distillation from successful to failed rollouts; 4B mobile agent reaches 81.0% on AndroidWorld, beating GRPO/PPO from same init.
one_line_zh: 先拒绝采样微调，再在分叉点用成功轨迹自蒸馏纠正失败轨迹；4B 模型 AndroidWorld 达 81.0%，优于同起点 GRPO/PPO。

title_zh: 迈向 GUI 智能体：用于 GUI 定位的视觉-语言扩散模型
one_line: Adapts discrete diffusion VLM LLaDA-V to single-step action and box prediction with hybrid masking; offline grounding near AR baselines, higher latency.
one_line_zh: 将离散扩散视觉语言模型 LLaDA-V 用于单步动作与框预测并提出混合掩码；离线定位接近自回归基线但延迟更高。

title_zh: GUIDE：通过实时网络视频检索与即插即用标注消除 GUI 智能体的领域偏差
one_line: Training-free retrieval of task-relevant YouTube tutorials, VLM keyframe-pair annotation into planning/grounding knowledge injected into agents; OSWorld +4.5-7.5pp, WAA gains.
one_line_zh: 免训练地按任务检索 YouTube 教程，用 VLM 对关键帧对标注出规划与定位知识注入智能体；OSWorld 提升 4.5-7.5 个点。

title_zh: GPA：从演示中学习 GUI 流程自动化
one_line: Single-demo record-and-replay: detector+OCR UI graphs, SMC neighbour-based target localisation and readiness gating; 16-task pilot beats Gemini CUA, 10x faster.
one_line_zh: 单次演示录制回放：检测器+OCR 构建 UI 图，用序贯蒙特卡洛按邻居定位目标并做就绪门控；16 任务试点优于 Gemini 且快 10 倍。

title_zh: UI-Oceanus：用合成环境动力学扩展 GUI 智能体
one_line: Continual pretraining on forward-dynamics descriptions of 3.4M explored real WeChat mini-program transitions; beats SFT-only offline and online, forward beats inverse objectives.
one_line_zh: 在 340 万条真实探索得到的微信小程序转移上以前向动力学描述继续预训练；离线与在线均优于仅 SFT，前向优于逆向目标。

title_zh: 不要盲目行动：基于动作效果验证与自我纠正的鲁棒 GUI 自动化
one_line: Policy outputs verification of previous action plus expected effect; SFT on synthetic no-change failures then offline GRPO; better recovery, AndroidWorld 25.1% at 7B.
one_line_zh: 策略逐步输出对上一步的验证与预期效果；先用合成无变化失败样本 SFT，再离线 GRPO；恢复率提升，7B 在 AndroidWorld 达 25.1%。

title_zh: MAESTRO：在带 GUI 的对话智能体中依据用户偏好调整界面并引导导航
one_line: Conversational GUI agent keeps preference memory, adapts GUI in place and suggests backtracking; N=33 movie-ticketing user study shows fewer preference violations.
one_line_zh: 对话式 GUI 智能体维护偏好记忆、就地调整界面并建议回溯；33 人购票用户研究显示偏好违背更少。

title_zh: 屏幕到动作缺了什么？面向多模态 GUI 推理的 UI 在环范式
one_line: Offline GRPO with rewards for locating, describing and using key UI elements before acting; gains on AndroidControl-High and ScreenSpot-Pro, offline only.
one_line_zh: 离线 GRPO 奖励模型先定位、描述并利用关键 UI 元素再行动；在 AndroidControl-High 与 ScreenSpot-Pro 上提升，仅离线评测。

title_zh: Android Coach：以单状态多动作提升在线智能体训练效率
one_line: Online actor-critic RL: PRM-informed Q critic scores several sampled actions per emulator state with leave-one-out advantage; +7.5/+8.3 SR over UI-TARS-1.5-7B.
one_line_zh: 在线演员-评论家强化学习：结合过程奖励的 Q 评论家为每个模拟器状态的多个采样动作打分并用留一优势；较 UI-TARS-1.5-7B 提升 7.5/8.3 个点。

title_zh: Web 智能体能力的结构化蒸馏实现泛化
one_line: Persona-driven exploration proposes grounded WebArena tasks with hints; Gemini teacher trajectories filtered by hinted judge train a 9B student: WebArena 41.5%, WorkArena +18.2pp.
one_line_zh: 以人设驱动探索生成带提示的 WebArena 任务，Gemini 教师轨迹经评审过滤后 SFT 9B 学生：WebArena 41.5%，WorkArena 提升 18.2 点。

title_zh: MolmoWeb：面向开放网络的开放视觉网页智能体与开放数据
one_line: Screenshot-only 4B/8B web policies SFT-ed on 100K+ synthetic and 30K human trajectories plus grounding data; live-site benchmarks, LLM-judged, multi-run averages.
one_line_zh: 用十万级合成与三万人类网页轨迹及定位数据微调纯截图网页策略，在真实网站基准上由 LLM 评判并多次运行取平均。

title_zh: CORA：用于安全移动 GUI 自动化的共形风险控制智能体
one_line: Wraps a fixed mobile policy with a trained action-risk guardian, conformal execute/abstain threshold and diagnostician; step-level harm benchmarks plus a 20-task AndroidWorld check.
one_line_zh: 为固定移动端策略加上训练的动作风险守护模型、共形风险阈值与干预诊断器，主要在步级危害基准上评估，另有 20 个 AndroidWorld 任务。

title_zh: Avenir-UX：基于 GUI 定位模拟人类网页交互的自动化用户体验评估
one_line: Prompted Gemini web agent with SoM tags, memory and per-step think-aloud/SEQ ratings produces UX reports; evidence is a single live-site case study.
one_line_zh: 基于 SoM 标注与记忆的提示式 Gemini 网页智能体逐步出声思考并打分生成可用性报告，证据仅为单个网站案例。

title_zh: EE-MCP：通过自动环境生成与经验学习自我进化的 MCP-GUI 智能体
one_line: Hybrid MCP-GUI 8B agent improved by expert distillation, gap-driven task generation and an LLM-distilled experience bank; 120 tasks, three apps, Claude-judged, single runs.
one_line_zh: 混合 MCP 与 GUI 的 8B 智能体通过专家蒸馏、缺口驱动任务生成和经验库自我改进，在三个应用 120 个任务上由 Claude 评判、单次运行。

title_zh: 基于轨迹诱导偏好优化的移动 GUI 智能体隐私个性化
one_line: Weighted, padding-gated step-level DPO aligns a 3B mobile planner to privacy personas on 151 paired-trajectory tasks; offline reference matching and LLM-assisted persona metrics.
one_line_zh: 以加权并屏蔽填充步的步级 DPO 让 3B 移动端规划器对齐隐私偏好，在 151 个成对轨迹任务上做离线参考匹配评估。

title_zh: ClawGUI：GUI 智能体训练、评测与部署的统一框架
one_line: Open RL/eval/deploy stack; a 2B mobile agent trained with GiGPO and an MLLM process reward reaches 17.1% on MobileWorld GUI-Only, single run.
one_line_zh: 开源的 GUI 智能体强化学习、评测与部署框架；用 GiGPO 和 MLLM 过程奖励训练的 2B 智能体在 MobileWorld 上达 17.1%，单次运行。

title_zh: PrecisionCUA：面向代码编辑器像素级光标定位的迭代视觉修正
one_line: Frontier models re-ground cursor targets in VS Code/Cursor after seeing their previous miss marked; 5,390 static samples, retries triggered by ground-truth misses.
one_line_zh: 前沿模型在看到上一次错误位置标记后重新定位代码编辑器中的光标目标；基于 5390 个静态样本，重试由真值判错触发。

title_zh: WebXSkill：自主网页智能体的技能学习
one_line: Executable skills with step guidance mined from synthetic trajectories, retrieved via a URL graph; gains on WebArena and live sites, cross-site transfer, component ablations.
one_line_zh: 从合成轨迹中提炼带步骤说明的可执行技能并按 URL 图检索，在 WebArena 与真实网站上提升成功率，并验证跨站迁移与组件消融。

title_zh: 通过多角色编排实现可扩展的轻量级 GUI 智能体
one_line: 3B MLLM trained with role-oriented synthetic data, perplexity-weighted SFT and multi-task GRPO serves as executor under strong planners; online MiniWob++, AndroidWorld, OSWorld subset.
one_line_zh: 以角色化合成数据、困惑度加权 SFT 与多任务 GRPO 训练的 3B 模型作为强规划器下的执行器，在 MiniWob++、AndroidWorld 与 OSWorld 子集在线评估。

title_zh: UI-Copilot：通过工具集成策略优化推进长程 GUI 自动化
one_line: 7B mobile policy keeps progress summaries in context, stores thoughts, and calls a retriever/calculator copilot, trained by decoupled RL; MemGUI-Bench and AndroidWorld online.
one_line_zh: 7B 移动端策略只在上下文保留进度摘要、将思考外存，并按需调用检索/计算副驾驶，经解耦强化学习训练，在 MemGUI-Bench 与 AndroidWorld 在线评估。

title_zh: UI-Zoomer：基于不确定性驱动的自适应放大GUI定位
one_line: Training-free grounder wrapper: gates zoom-in on sampling consensus and sizes crops from prediction variance; evidence is ScreenSpot-Pro/UI-Vision click accuracy only.
one_line_zh: 免训练方法：依据多次采样的一致性与置信度决定是否放大，并按预测方差确定裁剪尺寸；仅有离线定位精度证据。

title_zh: 超越聊天与点击：通过实时界面变换提供就地协助的GUI智能体
one_line: Chrome extension retrieves handbook cases to apply reversible DOM edits on user request; evidence is an LLM-judged 101-challenge set and a 12-user study.
one_line_zh: 浏览器扩展根据用户求助检索手册并可逆地修改DOM（提示、高亮、重排）；证据为LLM评判的101个挑战和12人用户研究。

title_zh: OpenMobile：通过任务与轨迹合成构建开放移动智能体
one_line: Synthesises mobile tasks from an exploration-built screen memory and collects error-recovery trajectories by learner-expert switching; SFT reaches 51.7/64.7% AndroidWorld, with overlap analysis.
one_line_zh: 基于探索构建的全局界面记忆合成任务，并以学习者-专家切换采集纠错轨迹；SFT后AndroidWorld达51.7%/64.7%，并分析数据重叠。

title_zh: WebUncertainty：面向自主网页智能体的双层不确定性驱动规划与推理
one_line: Prompted web agent switches explicit/implicit planning by estimated task uncertainty and runs MCTS with confidence-derived action priors and an LLM evaluator; WebArena 46.9%, WebVoyager subset.
one_line_zh: 提示式网页智能体按任务不确定性切换显式/隐式规划，并用置信度先验和LLM评估器做MCTS；WebArena 46.9%。

title_zh: 三思而后点：通过强化学习协同进化提议器与视觉评判器用于GUI定位
one_line: One MLLM proposes click candidates, marks them on the screenshot and ranks them as critic, co-trained by maturity-weighted GRPO; offline grounding gains only.
one_line_zh: 同一模型提出多个点击候选并标注于截图上再自评排序，以成熟度加权的GRPO协同训练；在六个定位基准上提升。

title_zh: VLAA-GUI：知道何时停止、恢复与搜索的模块化GUI自动化框架
one_line: Prompted desktop framework adds a criteria-plus-judge completion verifier, tiered loop breaker and text search agent; 77.5% OSWorld-Verified, 61.0% WAA, with per-component ablations.
one_line_zh: 提示式桌面框架加入完成度验证器、分层循环打破器和搜索代理；OSWorld-Verified 77.5%、WAA 61.0%，含组件消融。

title_zh: 高动态环境下GUI智能体的评测与改进
one_line: New 149-task online desktop benchmark of between-action dynamics, plus an agent selecting captioned key frames from screen video and reflecting; 22.1% vs 15.1%.
one_line_zh: 提出149个任务的高动态在线桌面基准，并设计从录屏中选关键帧、细化思路并反思的智能体；成功率22.1%对15.1%。

title_zh: 训练计算机使用智能体评估图形用户界面的可用性
one_line: Fine-tunes a CUA on synthetic site clones with injected usability defects and designer preferences to explore flows and score usability; AUC 0.632 vs 0.381.
one_line_zh: 在注入可用性缺陷的合成网站克隆和设计师偏好上微调CUA，使其探索关键流程并输出可用性分数；AUC 0.632。

title_zh: 面向高效计算机使用智能体的步级优化
one_line: Small GUI policy by default, escalating to a large model when learned stuck/milestone monitors fire; near large-model success on OSWorld/WebArena at lower cost.
one_line_zh: 默认运行小模型，学习到的卡顿/里程碑监测器触发时升级到大模型；在OSWorld/WebArena上以更低成本接近大模型成功率。

title_zh: AutoSurfer：通过全面浏览、学习与建模来训练网页智能体
one_line: BFS website exploration with menu expansion synthesises tasks from executed action chains, refines them with trace hints, and SFTs Qwen2.5-VL; WebArena 24.2% vs 19.6% SynthAgent.
one_line_zh: 广度优先探索网站（含菜单展开），由已执行动作链合成任务并以轨迹提示精炼，再SFT Qwen2.5-VL；WebArena 24.2%。

title_zh: A11y-Compressor：通过视觉上下文重建与冗余削减提升 GUI 智能体观测效率的框架
one_line: Rule-based a11y-tree compression with modal detection and semantic regions; OSWorld with one Qwen3-VL-32B backbone, 22% tokens, +5.1 SR.
one_line_zh: 用规则压缩无障碍树并显式标注弹窗与功能区域，在 OSWorld 上以单一骨干模型减少 78% token 并提升成功率。

title_zh: 从自身学习点击位置：面向 GUI 定位的在线策略自蒸馏
one_line: On-policy self-distillation with box-masked privileged teacher and digit-weighted KL replaces GRPO for grounding; static grounding benchmarks, one 8B backbone.
one_line_zh: 以带框与高斯遮罩的特权教师做在线自蒸馏并按数位熵加权，替代 GRPO 训练定位，仅在静态定位基准上评估。

title_zh: 基于引导优势估计器的忠实移动端 GUI 智能体
one_line: SFT on perturbed traps then step-level GRPO with anchored, variance-tempered advantages and consistency reward; offline step SR on an in-house split.
one_line_zh: 先用扰动陷阱数据 SFT 教会弃权，再用锚定与方差自适应优势的 GRPO 强化忠实性，仅以自建离线单步成功率评估。

title_zh: AutoFocus：面向 GUI 定位的不确定性感知主动视觉搜索
one_line: Training-free zoom search: coordinate-token perplexity defines anisotropic Gaussian crop proposals, regrounded and visually aggregated; grounding benchmarks only.
one_line_zh: 免训练地用坐标 token 困惑度构造各向异性高斯区域并放大重定位、视觉聚合选点，仅在定位基准上评估。

title_zh: 为可靠的计算机使用智能体增强界面可用性启发式
one_line: Redesigns interfaces with four agent-oriented usability heuristics; matched-pair OSWorld-style VM environments show success gains across three agents, human usability preserved.
one_line_zh: 提出四条面向智能体的界面可用性启发式，在成对对照的虚拟机环境中提升三类智能体成功率且不损害人类可用性。

title_zh: BAMI：GUI 定位中的免训练偏差缓解
one_line: Training-free coarse-to-fine cropping plus masked mutually exclusive candidates reselected by a prompted correction model; ScreenSpot-Pro/V2 grounding only.
one_line_zh: 免训练地由粗到细裁剪并对掩码生成的互斥候选框用纠正模型重选，仅在 ScreenSpot 定位基准上评估。

title_zh: Region4Web：重新思考 Web 智能体观测空间的粒度
one_line: Learned AXTree-to-functional-region decomposition and per-page digest with region selection; WebArena gains across four backbones and two agents, 43% fewer tokens.
one_line_zh: 将无障碍树学习式分解为功能区域并生成页面摘要，在 WebArena 上跨四个骨干与两种智能体减少 43% 观测 token 并提升成功率。

title_zh: LiteGUI：基于多解引导蒸馏与双层强化学习的轻量级 GUI 智能体
one_line: Guided on-policy distillation then GRPO on logged states with multi-solution action and judged plan rewards; 2B doubles OSWorld success versus backbone.
one_line_zh: 先以最匹配有效动作作为教师特权信息进行在线蒸馏，再在记录状态上用多解动作与规划奖励做 GRPO，2B 模型 OSWorld 成功率翻倍。

title_zh: Mem-W：原生潜在记忆的 GUI 智能体
one_line: Q-Former compressor turns retrieved trajectories and expired history into latent tokens for a frozen GUI policy; gains on mostly offline web/mobile benchmarks.
one_line_zh: 用 Q-Former 将检索到的历史轨迹与会话内历史压缩为潜在记忆 token 供冻结策略使用，主要在离线网页与移动基准上取得提升。

title_zh: 别点那个：教会 Web 智能体抵御欺骗性界面
one_line: RL-calibrated click evaluator with asymmetric penalties plus summarized failure experience gates agent clicks; static-screenshot in-house benchmark, deception failures reduced.
one_line_zh: 用非对称惩罚强化学习校准点击评估器并蒸馏失败经验来拦截可疑点击，在自建静态截图基准上降低受骗率。

title_zh: 移动端世界模型如何引导 GUI 智能体？
one_line: Trains mobile world models in four output modalities and compares them as prior perception, posterior verifier and imagination data; offline plus AndroidWorld evidence.
one_line_zh: 训练文本差分、全文本、可渲染代码与扩散图像四种移动端世界模型，比较其作为先验感知、后验校验和想象数据的作用。

title_zh: ReVision：通过削减时序视觉冗余扩展计算机使用智能体
one_line: Learned patch selector drops temporally redundant screenshot patches so a fine-tuned CUA uses longer image history; OSWorld/WebTailBench gains at ~46% fewer tokens.
one_line_zh: 用学习的补丁选择器删除相邻截图间冗余视觉 token 并微调模型，以更少 token 利用更长历史，OSWorld 等在线提升。

title_zh: 面向 GUI 智能体的可执行智能体记忆
one_line: Builds an app knowledge graph from DFS exploration, then plans by Q-model-guided MCTS over it; AndroidWorld 52.6% with low latency and token cost.
one_line_zh: 通过 DFS 探索构建应用知识图谱并挖掘动作组，再以 Q 模型引导 MCTS 抽取可执行路径，AndroidWorld 成功率 52.6%。

title_zh: ToolCUA：面向计算机使用智能体的最优 GUI-工具路径编排
one_line: Synthesises interleaved GUI-tool trajectories, then SFT, switch-point RL and online RL with tool/length rewards; OSWorld-MCP 46.85% with held-out and Windows transfer.
one_line_zh: 由静态 GUI 轨迹合成 GUI-工具交错数据，经 SFT、切换点强化学习和带工具/路径奖励的在线 RL，OSWorld-MCP 达 46.85%。

title_zh: 覆盖人类计算机操作动作空间：数据合成与基准
one_line: Renders GUI, text, table, canvas and image scenes with exact coordinates to synthesise click/drag/draw grounding data; new CUActSpot benchmark plus fixed-planner OSWorld check.
one_line_zh: 通过代码渲染多模态场景获取精确坐标并合成点击/拖拽/绘制定位数据，提出 CUActSpot 基准并以固定规划器在 OSWorld 验证。

title_zh: 解码之前发生了什么？预填充决定 VLM 的 GUI 定位
one_line: Training-free Re-Prefill re-runs prefill with high-attention visual tokens to refine target selection before coordinate decoding; consistent offline grounding gains, up to +4.3 ScreenSpot-Pro.
one_line_zh: 免训练的 Re-Prefill 以高注意力视觉 token 进行第二次预填充以修正目标选择，离线定位基准稳定提升，ScreenSpot-Pro 最高 +4.3。

title_zh: 网页智能体应采用“先规划后执行”范式
one_line: Position paper arguing web agents should plan a fixed program over typed site APIs before seeing untrusted content; supported only by a WebArena task-compatibility analysis.
one_line_zh: 立场论文：主张网页智能体在接触不可信内容前基于类型化站点 API 先生成固定程序再执行，仅以 WebArena 任务兼容性分析支撑。

title_zh: Video2GUI：为通用 GUI 智能体预训练合成大规模交互轨迹
one_line: Mines 12.7M grounded GUI trajectories from filtered YouTube tutorials for continual pretraining; grounding/offline gains plus AndroidWorld and OSWorld improvements over Stage2-only.
one_line_zh: 从筛选后的 YouTube 教程视频中提取 1270 万条带坐标的 GUI 轨迹用于持续预训练，定位、离线及 AndroidWorld/OSWorld 在线均有提升。

title_zh: DRS-GUI：用于免训练 GUI 定位的动态区域搜索
one_line: Training-free MCTS searches crop regions (Focus/Shift/Scatter) scored by an OmniParser-based reward before grounding; offline ScreenSpot-Pro gains of ~14 points.
one_line_zh: 免训练方法：以 MCTS 调度聚焦/平移/扩展动作搜索裁剪区域，并用基于解析器的区域奖励选择后再定位，ScreenSpot-Pro 提升约 14 点。

title_zh: ScreenSearch：不确定性感知的操作系统探索
one_line: Distributed desktop exploration builds a deduplicated UIA state graph and selects actions by an ambiguity-aware one-step PUCT; coverage gains over greedy, offline downstream use only.
one_line_zh: 分布式桌面探索构建去重的 UIA 状态图，以考虑歧义的一步 PUCT 选择动作，覆盖率优于贪心，下游仅离线验证。

title_zh: Skim：面向快速高效网页智能体的推测执行框架
one_line: Offline per-site profiles let a small model synthesise URLs and extract answers, verifier-gated with ReAct fallback; live WebVoyager/WebShop, 1.9x cheaper.
one_line_zh: 离线为每个站点建立 URL 模板与答案模式画像，在线用小模型推测执行并由验证器把关，失败回退到完整智能体，成本降 1.9 倍。

title_zh: SE-GA：面向 GUI 智能体的记忆增强自进化框架
one_line: Retrieves episodic, semantic and experiential memories into context and trains on memory-curated data with GRPO; mostly offline, AndroidWorld 39.0 at 7B.
one_line_zh: 在推理时检索情景、语义与经验三层记忆，并用记忆收集的数据做 SFT+GRPO 训练；主要为离线评测，AndroidWorld 达 39.0%。

title_zh: DocOS：迈向 GUI 智能体中主动的文档引导操作
one_line: Benchmark of 817 desktop tasks where agents must search web documentation then execute; final-state verifier, six 4-8B agents, TCR mostly below 20%.
one_line_zh: 提出主动文档引导操作范式与 DocOS 基准：智能体需先上网检索官方文档再在桌面应用中执行，现有模型任务完成率普遍很低。

title_zh: MementoGUI：为长时程 GUI 智能体学习智能体式多模态记忆控制
one_line: Plug-in learned controller writes salient events with ROI crops, compresses old memory and retrieves episodes for frozen backbones; offline GUI-Odyssey/Mind2Web gains only.
one_line_zh: 为冻结的 GUI 骨干模型外挂可学习的记忆控制器，选择性写入带 ROI 图像的事件、压缩旧记忆并检索历史轨迹；仅有离线评测。

title_zh: AQuaUI：基于自适应四叉树的 GUI 智能体视觉 token 压缩
one_line: Training-free quadtree merges homogeneous screenshot regions into single tokens, reusing prior frames' trees; ~30% fewer tokens, small grounding and AndroidWorld drops.
one_line_zh: 无需训练，用自适应四叉树把截图中均匀区域合并为单个视觉 token，并参考前一帧的划分；约减少 30% token，精度小幅下降。

title_zh: Weasel：通过重要性-多样性数据选择实现网页智能体的域外泛化
one_line: Selects important, diverse trajectory steps, prunes AXTrees around targets and self-synthesises rationales for offline SFT; zero-shot WebArena/WorkArena gains with ~10x cheaper training.
one_line_zh: 通过重要性与多样性目标贪心挑选训练步骤、围绕目标元素裁剪无障碍树并自生成推理，离线微调后在未见基准上零样本提升且训练快约 10 倍。

title_zh: 智能体 JIT 编译：面向时延优化的网页智能体规划与调度
one_line: Compiles tasks into code plans over cached app tools with pre/postcondition checks, picks the cheapest plan and parallel schedule; 37 REAL/WebArena tasks, 10.4x faster.
one_line_zh: 把任务编译成调用缓存工具的代码计划，用前后置条件静态校验并选最低代价计划与并行调度；在 37 个任务上比 Browser-Use 快 10.4 倍。

title_zh: Spreadsheet-RL：通过强化学习提升大模型智能体处理真实电子表格任务的能力
one_line: GRPO in a real-Excel gym with oracle-workbook cell-match rewards, forum-mined tasks and a spreadsheet-native tool harness; 4B model SpreadsheetBench 12.0 to 23.4.
one_line_zh: 在真实 Excel 环境中用与参考工作簿逐单元格比对的结果奖励做多轮 GRPO，并配套论坛挖掘任务与表格原生工具，4B 模型通过率翻倍。

title_zh: DRIVE：在持续学习下对网页智能体的推理层与交互层技能分别建模
one_line: Splits past trajectories into NL reasoning skills and programmatic interaction skills with failure attribution; WebArena same-site split, 52.8% vs 45.5% AgentOccam.
one_line_zh: 把历史轨迹拆为自然语言推理技能与可执行交互技能并按失败归因更新，在 WebArena 同站点划分上成功率 52.8%，高于基线 7.3 点。

title_zh: PANDO：通过在线技能蒸馏实现高效的多模态 AI 智能体
one_line: Grows a rule-and-routine skill library online over the VWA test stream with demotion, routing and cache-aware prompts; 58.3% SR on 910 tasks, 58% fewer tokens.
one_line_zh: 在 VisualWebArena 测试流中在线积累规则与参数化例程技能库，配合降级、路由和缓存友好提示，以更少 token 达到 58.3% 成功率。

title_zh: MobileExplorer：通过在线探索加速移动GUI智能体的端侧推理
one_line: Overlaps on-device VLM reasoning with parallel probing of task-relevant UI elements plus rollback, injecting hints; AndroidWorld 50.9% SR with fewer steps and lower latency.
one_line_zh: 利用端侧VLM推理空闲时间并行探测相关UI元素并回滚，将探索结果作为提示注入；AndroidWorld成功率50.9%，步数与延迟下降。

title_zh: 面向移动GUI导航的视觉语言智能体：扩展、基准测试与推理
one_line: 16K-task Chinese mobile dataset and offline/semi-online evaluation toolkit; studies SFT vs RL data scaling and reasoning modes; evidence is offline step matching.
one_line_zh: 提出1.6万任务中文移动数据集HyperTrack与离线/半在线评测工具GUIEvalKit，研究数据规模、RL与推理；证据为离线步级匹配。

title_zh: 用于持续游戏生成的GUI智能体
one_line: GUI agents play generated browser games: an independent rubric judge scores PlaytestArena, a rubric-blind playtester drives code refinement; judge agrees with humans (kappa 0.66).
one_line_zh: GUI智能体试玩生成的网页游戏：独立评审按评分细则打分，盲测试玩者提供改进反馈；评审与人类一致性κ=0.66。

title_zh: GUI-CIDER：通过因果内化与密度感知样本重选对GUI智能体进行中期训练
one_line: Mid-trains a VLM on LLM-distilled textual planning and causal-transition knowledge filtered by causal saliency and density; offline AndroidControl/AITZ/Odyssey and knowledge MCQ gains.
one_line_zh: 用大模型将GUI轨迹蒸馏为文本化规划与因果转移知识并按因果显著性与密度筛选后中期训练；离线基准与知识问答提升。

title_zh: 从弱点中学习：小型计算机使用智能体的自动化领域专精
one_line: Teacher-student failure comparison drives weakness-conditioned OSWorld task synthesis and error-aware masked DPO; +11.6/+11.1 points on eight OSWorld domains, three trials.
one_line_zh: 以教师成功而学生失败的任务生成弱点报告并合成针对性任务，配合区分规划/执行错误的掩码DPO；OSWorld八领域平均提升约11个百分点。

title_zh: PRO-CUA：面向计算机使用智能体的过程奖励优化
one_line: Collects on-policy live web states, samples candidate actions offline, rewards them with a VLM PRM, trains step-level GRPO; gains on WebVoyager/Mind2Web-Live judged by GPT-5.
one_line_zh: 在线采集智能体自身状态，离线采样候选动作并由VLM过程奖励模型打分，进行步级GRPO；在GPT-5评判的在线网页基准上提升。

title_zh: STAMP：在可控可扩展虚拟环境中训练移动GUI智能体的显式记忆
one_line: Trains a mobile agent to emit an explicit memory field using LLM-generated virtual apps with injected memory variables, SFT plus online RL; small AndroidWorld-M/MemGUI gains.
one_line_zh: 在LLM生成且注入记忆变量的虚拟应用中，以SFT和在线RL训练移动智能体输出显式记忆字段；在AndroidWorld-M等基准上有提升。

title_zh: 恢复策略诱发错误：面向鲁棒GUI智能体的基准与轨迹合成
one_line: Tree-based synthesis branches from fragile states and replays error states for advice-conditioned recovery; 800K SFT steps lift OSWorld to 47.4%, plus GUI-RobustEval benchmark.
one_line_zh: 基于轨迹树从脆弱状态分支探索并在错误状态重放生成恢复轨迹，80万步SFT使OSWorld达47.4%，并提出GUI-RobustEval。

title_zh: UI-KOBE：面向轻量级图引导GUI智能体的知识导向行为探索
one_line: Explores each app for 300 steps into an audited UI-state graph; a small runtime agent picks graph edges or free actions; AndroidWorld 70.7% with 4B.
one_line_zh: 对每个应用自主探索构建经审计的UI状态知识图，运行时小模型据图选择边或自由动作；4B模型AndroidWorld达70.7%。

title_zh: GUI-C²：基于难度感知强化学习的由粗到细GUI定位
one_line: Difficulty-filtered, difficulty-weighted GRPO trains a 3B grounder whose predicted-box area gates up to two crop-and-reground stages; ScreenSpot-Pro 46.4%.
one_line_zh: 难度筛选与加权的GRPO训练3B定位模型，以预测框面积触发至多两级裁剪重定位；ScreenSpot-Pro达46.4%。

title_zh: 学会适应：基于认知感知探索的自我改进网页智能体
one_line: Self-adversarial Selector/Predictor/Judger exploration fine-tunes on mispredicted real transitions; VisualWebArena and WebVoyager gains for 7-8B backbones, unvalidated self-judge.
one_line_zh: 同一模型扮演选择者、预测者与评判者，在真实网页上探索并用预测失误的转移微调，在 VisualWebArena 与 WebVoyager 上提升 7-8B 模型。

title_zh: STaR-KV：面向 GUI 视觉语言模型 KV 缓存压缩的时空自适应重加权
one_line: Training-free KV-cache eviction reweighting visual tokens by subspace spatial MI, temporal stability and entropy; offline grounding/step benchmarks, matched budgets, two 7B models.
one_line_zh: 无需训练的 KV 缓存压缩，按注意力子空间空间互信息、时间稳定性与熵重加权视觉 token，仅在离线定位与步级基准上评估。

title_zh: OpenWebRL：揭秘面向视觉网页智能体的在线多轮强化学习
one_line: Online multi-turn GRPO on live websites with VLM-judge reward, SFT warm start and text-feedback context; live Online-Mind2Web/DeepShop/WebVoyager gains, judge validated only against GPT-4.1.
one_line_zh: 在真实网站上以 VLM 评判奖励进行多轮 GRPO 在线强化学习，配合少量 SFT 预热与文本反馈上下文，在三个在线网页基准上取得提升。

title_zh: 先感知后推理：面向高效可靠主动式移动智能体的推理前感知框架
one_line: Lightweight perceptor gates when a proactive mobile agent intervenes and prunes functions before a 9B reasoner; offline ProactiveMobile gains, fewer false triggers.
one_line_zh: 用轻量感知器先判断主动式移动助手是否介入并压缩候选函数，再调用 9B 推理器，在离线 ProactiveMobile 上降低误触发与计算。

title_zh: CLI-Anything：迈向智能体原生的计算机使用
one_line: Lifts GUI applications into stateful JSON-emitting CLI harnesses over real backends as agent interface; evidence is catalog size, telemetry, demos, no task success.
one_line_zh: 把 GUI 应用改造成基于真实后端、输出 JSON 的有状态命令行工具作为智能体动作接口，仅以目录规模、使用统计与演示为证据。

title_zh: 基于状态锚定动态检索的网页智能体在线技能学习
one_line: Sliding-window text-code skills induced online from self-judged successful runs, retrieved per step by task and page state; WebArena gains over AWM/ASI/CER with two backbones.
one_line_zh: 从自评成功轨迹中滑窗提取文本-代码技能，并按任务与当前页面状态逐步检索，在 WebArena 上优于 AWM、ASI、CER。

title_zh: MIRAGE：具备隐式推理与生成式世界模型的移动智能体
one_line: Latent-slot reasoning distilled from explicit thoughts, regularised by next-screenshot feature prediction; AndroidWorld SR gains over same-size Qwen3-VL with ~70% fewer tokens.
one_line_zh: 把显式思维链蒸馏为连续隐式推理槽，并用下一帧截图特征对齐作世界模型正则，在 AndroidWorld 上以更少 token 提升成功率。

title_zh: AsyncWebRL：面向多步视觉网页智能体的高效异步强化学习
one_line: Fully asynchronous multi-step GRPO with decoupled importance ratio and constant 1/k normaliser; 2.4-2.9x throughput and WebGym held-out-site gains, single seed, GPT-4o rubric reward.
one_line_zh: 全异步多步 GRPO，配合解耦重要性比与常数长度归一化，训练吞吐提升 2.4-2.9 倍，并在 WebGym 未见网站测试集上提升成功率。

title_zh: 面向长时程网页智能体的信号驱动观测
one_line: Position paper: a sub-call returns task-relevant DOM elements, re-observed only when browser-event signals fire; no experiments.
one_line_zh: 立场论文：由子调用从完整 DOM 中只返回任务相关元素，并仅在浏览器事件信号触发时重新观测，未做实验。

title_zh: StainFlow：面向 GUI 智能体过程奖励的实体染色追踪与证据关联
one_line: VLM-tracked task-entity stains and evidence-linked key-node checks give dense step rewards for GRPO; AndroidWorld online RL and OGRBench completion-judgment gains over PRM baselines.
one_line_zh: 用 VLM 追踪任务实体的“染色”浓度并关联证据验证关键节点，生成稠密步级奖励用于 GRPO，在 AndroidWorld 与 OGRBench 上优于已有过程奖励方法。

title_zh: Syll：支持跨界面执行的开源个人自动化系统
one_line: Harness routes tasks across MCP/API, CLI and GUI control and replays demonstration skills; evidence is a few single-run live mechanism probes.
one_line_zh: 开源智能体框架在 MCP/API、命令行与 GUI 间路由执行并回放演示技能，仅以少量单次实机机制探针验证。

title_zh: RunAgent SuperBrowser：基于人类浏览行为的自主网页导航理论
one_line: Prompted web agent with bounded ledger memory, context eviction, three roles and chevron-aware snapping; Mind2Web Hard 89.47% without component ablations.
one_line_zh: 以有界结构化账本、上下文淘汰、三角色分工和小控件优先点击构建网页智能体，在 Mind2Web Hard 达 89.47%，但无组件消融。

title_zh: AliyunConsoleAgent：在真实云环境中通过蒸馏与强化学习训练网页智能体
one_line: SFT-then-GRPO 32B console agent with audit-log rule rewards and provisioned real cloud accounts; 278 live tasks, 3 runs, 63.52%.
one_line_zh: 在真实云控制台中以审计日志规则奖励和资源预置环境做蒸馏 SFT 加 GRPO，278 项实机任务三次运行达 63.52%。

title_zh: WebChallenger：可靠且高效的通用网页智能体
one_line: DOM-derived sectioned page representation with selective extraction, offline site exploration memory and compound actions; open 32B model, four live web benchmarks, ablations.
one_line_zh: 将 DOM 构造成带摘要的语义分区并选择性提取，配合离线站点探索记忆与复合动作，用开源 32B 模型在四个在线网页基准上评测并消融。

title_zh: GUI-AC：增强 GUI 智能体的持续学习能力
one_line: Certainty-scaled advantage and dynamic clipping for GRPO grounding under continual domain/resolution shifts; ScreenSpot-only evidence, one 3B backbone.
one_line_zh: 在持续的领域与分辨率迁移下，以定位确定性缩放 GRPO 优势并动态放宽裁剪，仅在 ScreenSpot 系列上以 3B 模型验证。

title_zh: 面向计算机使用智能体的历史感知、视觉落地的评论家模型
one_line: 8B critic gives pre-execution, marker-grounded verdicts and compressed macro-action history to a frozen policy; live web/mobile/desktop gains, ablated, critic accuracy unmeasured.
one_line_zh: 训练 8B 评论家在执行前基于标记截图判定动作并提供压缩的宏动作历史，在网页、移动与桌面在线基准上提升且有消融，但评论家准确率未测。

title_zh: ISE：面向多轮操作系统智能体轨迹的执行落地数据合成方法
one_line: Synthesises multi-turn shell-agent SFT data from 4D sampled intents, a role-locked user simulator and live OS execution; single-trial LLM-judged ClawEval gains.
one_line_zh: 以四维意图采样、角色锁定的用户模拟器和真实系统执行合成多轮命令行智能体训练数据，在单次运行、LLM 评判的 ClawEval 上提升。

title_zh: 面向质量多样化网页智能体模仿学习的推测式回滚纠正
one_line: Student runs short branches, teacher rolls back to first harmful action and corrects; verified diverse trajectories plus corrections for SFT; live web and OSWorld-subset gains.
one_line_zh: 学生策略先执行短分支，教师定位首个有害动作并回滚纠正，结合验证通过的多样轨迹做 SFT，在网页与 OSWorld 子集在线评测中提升。

title_zh: ComAct：以 COM 作为动作范式重构专业软件操作
one_line: Replaces GUI actions with COM-script synthesis for real CAD software; 9B agent trained by SFT then GRPO on Chamfer reward; own executable benchmark.
one_line_zh: 以 COM 脚本生成替代 GUI 操作来控制真实 CAD 软件，9B 模型经 SFT 与基于倒角距离奖励的 GRPO 训练，在自建可执行基准上评测。

title_zh: VISTA：面向 GUI 定位的视图一致自验证训练
one_line: GRPO grounding groups built from target-preserving crops with a self-verified gated oracle anchor; static grounding benchmarks, three scales, two backbone families, ablated.
one_line_zh: 以保留目标的多裁剪视图构建 GRPO 组并加入自验证门控的标准答案锚点训练 GUI 定位，在静态定位基准、多尺度与两类骨干上验证并消融。

title_zh: PhoneHarness：通过混合 GUI、CLI 与工具动作驾驭手机使用智能体
one_line: Phone agent loop routes between device CLI, host MCP tools and delegated GUI subtasks; in-house verifier-checked benchmark, 75.0% vs 62.1% GUI-only, single run.
one_line_zh: 手机智能体在设备 CLI、宿主 MCP 工具与委派 GUI 子任务间路由，自建可验证基准上通过率 75.0%。

title_zh: ProCUA-SFT 技术报告
one_line: Synthesises desktop-grounded tasks with VLM precondition checks and single-VLM rollouts; SFT of UI-TARS-7B reaches 45.0% OSWorld, seeded from OSWorld configs.
one_line_zh: 以前置条件校验合成桌面任务并由同一 VLM 执行生成 93K 轨迹，SFT 后 UI-TARS-7B 在 OSWorld 达 45.0%。

title_zh: 超越领域：通过可迁移交互模式复用网页技能
one_line: Stores induced web skills with accessibility-tree sketches, retrieves by layout similarity across domains; 8-10% fewer LLM actions on WebArena/Mind2Web at slightly lower SR.
one_line_zh: 将网页技能与页面结构草图配对并按布局相似度跨域检索，在 WebArena/Mind2Web 上减少 8-10% 的 LLM 调用。

title_zh: PreAct：在重复任务上越用越快的计算机使用智能体
one_line: Compiles successful runs into screen-checked state-machine programs replayed without LLM calls; store-time evaluator gate; 8.5-13x faster on repeated mobile/desktop/web tasks.
one_line_zh: 把成功轨迹编译为带屏幕校验的状态机程序并免模型重放，存储前经评测器复核，在重复任务上快 8.5-13 倍。

title_zh: 信任正确的教师：面向 GUI 定位的质量感知自蒸馏
one_line: On-policy self-distillation for grounding down-weights coordinate-token teacher signals incompatible with the target box; offline, six grounding benchmarks, 72.23 vs 70.07 GUI-SD.
one_line_zh: 在 GUI 定位自蒸馏中按目标框可达性门控并按教师概率缩放坐标 token 监督，六个定位基准均值 72.23。

title_zh: VISUALSKILL：面向计算机使用智能体的多模态技能
one_line: Per-app multimodal skills from manuals plus live UI exploration, loaded on demand; Claude Opus agent 0.303 to 0.456 on CUA-World/OSExpert, +8.3 over matched text-only skill.
one_line_zh: 由文档与实时界面探索构建按应用的图文技能并按需加载，Claude 智能体得分从 0.303 升至 0.456。

title_zh: 面向 GUI 智能体的技能引导续写蒸馏
one_line: Rolls own policy k steps off-trajectory, completes with skill-guided policy, trains on verified continuations; OSWorld-Verified from low-30% to over 50% across three backbones.
one_line_zh: 先用自身策略走偏 k 步，再由技能引导策略续写成功轨迹并蒸馏，OSWorld-Verified 上三个基座从约 30% 提升到 50% 以上。

title_zh: MemGUI-Agent：具备主动上下文管理的端到端长程移动 GUI 智能体
one_line: Context-as-action: policy emits memory writes and history folding with UI actions; SFT on 3K trajectories; MemGUI-Bench 62.5% Pass@3 zero-shot, MobileWorld transfer.
one_line_zh: 将上下文管理作为动作，由策略同时输出记忆读写与历史折叠，在 MemGUI-Bench 与 MobileWorld 上提升长程成功率。

title_zh: MobileForge：基于分层反馈引导策略优化的移动 GUI 智能体免标注适配
one_line: Exploration-grounded task curriculum plus VLM critic step labels and hints drive step-level GRPO; AndroidWorld 77.6% Pass@3, MobileWorld 41.0% held-out.
one_line_zh: 以探索生成任务、VLM 评判器给出步级标签与纠错提示驱动步级 GRPO，AndroidWorld Pass@3 达 77.6%，并迁移到 MobileWorld。

title_zh: 通过交互轨迹挖掘自动生成计算机使用智能体的 SKILL.md
one_line: Segments and clusters GUI trajectories into readable skills, trains GRPO skill-composition policy; offline, single-run, fails to beat a frequency prior or transfer.
one_line_zh: 将 GUI 轨迹切分聚类为可读技能并用 GRPO 训练技能组合策略，离线评测中未超过频率基线且迁移失败。

title_zh: SkillHarness：为计算机使用智能体安全地驾驭技能
one_line: Skill library learned from exploration with success, failure and risk boundaries, selectively reused; WASP, ST-WebAgentBench, OS-Harm, OpenApps show fewer unsafe skills.
one_line_zh: 从探索轨迹中学习带有成功模式、失败教训和风险约束的技能并选择性复用，在多个安全基准上降低不安全技能比例。

title_zh: Fara-1.5：面向计算机使用智能体的可扩展学习环境
one_line: Live-web plus synthetic replica environments, GPT-5.4 solver and verifiers produce SFT data for 4B-27B browser agents; Online-Mind2Web 63.4/72.3, replica-to-live transfer shown.
one_line_zh: 结合真实网站与合成复刻环境、强教师求解器和多重验证器生成数据，蒸馏出多尺寸浏览器智能体并验证复刻环境向真实网站迁移。

title_zh: ENVS：面向长时程 GUI 智能体的环境原生验证搜索
one_line: Branches over distinct actions in live OSWorld VMs, keeps oracle-verified successes, trains balanced SFT; beats matched ARPO (30.3 vs 26.7 pass@8) with less compute.
one_line_zh: 在真实 OSWorld 虚拟机中按行为分歧分支搜索，保留评测器验证成功的轨迹做平衡监督微调，以更少算力超过在线强化学习基线。

title_zh: AOHP：面向个性化、高效与安全交互的开源操作系统级智能体框架
one_line: Android fork exposes API/CLI/structured-UI interfaces, event streams and information-flow sandbox; 30 self-made tasks: completion 54.4 to 75.6%, tokens halved.
one_line_zh: 在安卓系统层为智能体提供接口、命令行、结构化界面、事件流与信息流沙箱，在自建任务上提升完成率并减半令牌消耗。

title_zh: 基于自主评估的计算机使用智能体强化学习
one_line: VLM judges final screenshot as PPO reward, corrected with calibrated false-positive/negative rates; macOSWorld, WindowsAgentArena, OSWorld gains over raw-judge reward.
one_line_zh: 以视觉语言模型对最终截图的判定作为强化学习奖励，并用标定的误报漏报率做噪声校正，在三个桌面系统基准上优于原始奖励。

title_zh: GUI 智能体：用户敏感界面的引导式探索
one_line: Explorer LM trained with SFT and GRPO on novelty rewards generates queries reaching user-sensitive Android screens; evidence is only shrinking novelty scores over rounds.
one_line_zh: 训练探索模型以新颖性奖励生成会到达用户敏感界面的查询，仅以新颖性分数随轮次下降作为证据。

title_zh: WinDOM：面向小模型 GUI 定位的同族自蒸馏
one_line: DOM-read boxes from a Windows-11 web clone train a 2B grounder via filtered self-family distillation then GRPO; +5.4 OOD mean on static grounding benchmarks.
one_line_zh: 从 Windows 11 网页复刻的 DOM 读取边界框构建定位语料，用同族自蒸馏冷启动加 GRPO 训练 2B 模型，在静态定位基准上提升。

title_zh: 通过自主经验探索与事后经验利用增强 GUI 智能体的任务规划
one_line: Explores websites, relabels trajectories with hindsight-aligned high-level tasks, trains 3B/7B MLLMs; 7B reaches 30.6% on seven unseen WebVoyager sites at equal data.
one_line_zh: 自主探索网站后用事后经验把任务改写为与轨迹严格对齐的高层任务训练小模型，在未见网站上以同等数据量优于基线。

title_zh: 智能体-计算机观测接口实现动态计算机使用
one_line: Model-agnostic observation layer adds keyframes, gated audio transcription and persistent visual narration between actions; DynaCU-Bench gains reported, abstract only.
one_line_zh: 在动作之间加入关键帧捕获、音频转写和持久化文本叙述的观测层，摘要报告动态任务上的大幅提升（仅有摘要）。

title_zh: GUICrafter：利用海量无标注截图的弱监督 GUI 智能体
one_line: GRPO on unannotated screenshots with meta-tasks and DOM/a11y-derived boxes, then small annotated RL; Mind2Web and ScreenSpot-Pro gains, AndroidWorld 25.4 at 3B.
one_line_zh: 用网页 DOM 与无障碍树自动提取可交互元素构造元任务做规则奖励强化学习，再用少量标注数据校准，在多基准上提升。

title_zh: 一次前向胜过两次：用于精准高效 GUI 定位的 InnerZoom
one_line: Single-forward grounding that re-injects intermediate-layer target-region evidence into decoding; offline grounding benchmarks with same-data baseline and latency/TFLOPs versus two-pass zoom.
one_line_zh: 在单次前向中提取中间层目标区域证据并跨层注入坐标解码，在六个离线定位基准上优于同数据基线与两遍放大法，且延迟更低。

title_zh: LUMOS：面向无障碍信息落地 AI 智能体的语义操作系统层
one_line: Converts UIA/DOM accessibility metadata into id-indexed semantic blueprints for a one-action LLM loop; only case studies and regression tests, no benchmark evaluation.
one_line_zh: 将 UIA/DOM 无障碍元数据转为带稳定 ID 的语义蓝图供 LLM 单步决策，仅有案例演示与回归测试，无基准评测。

title_zh: 从失败中学习：计算机使用智能体的推理时自我改进
one_line: LLM diagnoses failed OSWorld trajectories and writes inference-time patches; OpenCUA-72B 42.3 to 48.9 over 3 runs, with per-strategy ablation and cross-benchmark transfer.
one_line_zh: 让 LLM 分析失败轨迹并生成推理时代码补丁，OpenCUA-72B 在 OSWorld 上三次运行由 42.3 提升至 48.9，并迁移到其他基准。

title_zh: Xiaomi-GUI-0 技术报告
one_line: Native mobile agent trained in a real-device closed loop with an error-driven correction flywheel and SFT plus step-level and agentic RL; 78.9% AndroidWorld, in-house RealMobile.
one_line_zh: 在真机闭环中采集数据并以错误驱动飞轮构造纠错数据，经 SFT、步级 RL 与智能体 RL 训练，AndroidWorld 达 78.9%。

title_zh: GUI 智能体真正需要什么记忆？从被动记录到主动驱动任务的状态
one_line: Agent-maintained structured task-state memory trained by SFT and memory-on/off contrastive GRPO; 76.6% AndroidWorld, 23.3% on unseen MobileWorld, plus DataScope benchmark.
one_line_zh: 让智能体主动维护带状态与约束的结构化任务记忆，并用记忆开/关对比的在线 RL 学习何时使用，在 AndroidWorld 与未见 MobileWorld 上提升。

title_zh: 面向长程移动 GUI 智能体的任务状态表示
one_line: Training-free LLM updater maintains task summary, progress tracker and before/after transition check for a fixed actor; four online mobile benchmarks, two backbones, mixed gains.
one_line_zh: 用免训练的 LLM 更新器维护任务摘要、进度追踪与动作前后转移校验并注入固定执行器，在四个在线移动基准上多数提升但并非一致。

title_zh: UI-MOPD：面向统一 GUI 智能体的多平台在线策略蒸馏
one_line: Shared 8B student trained by rule-reward RL with KL to a platform-routed desktop or mobile teacher; OSWorld 38.2%, MobileWorld 12.0%, beating parameter-matched mixing and merging.
one_line_zh: 共享 8B 学生在规则奖励 RL 中按平台路由到桌面或移动教师做在线 KL 蒸馏，OSWorld 38.2%、MobileWorld 12.0%，优于同参数混合与合并。

title_zh: EvoCUA-1.5：面向多轮计算机使用智能体的在线强化学习
one_line: Online multi-turn RL with length-balanced step-level advantages, policy-aware task filtering and adaptive curriculum; OSWorld-Verified 63.2% at 32B, gains on WindowsAgentArena and MacOSArena.
one_line_zh: 以步级优势重分配、策略感知任务筛选与自适应课程进行多轮在线 RL，32B 模型 OSWorld-Verified 达 63.2%，并在 Windows/macOS 上提升。

title_zh: SCALECUA：以可验证任务合成与高效在线 RL 扩展计算机使用智能体
one_line: Synthesises 3K verifiable RL tasks with container-tested judges, frontier task sampling and sliding visual window; OSWorld 68.7% over 4 passes, with component ablations.
one_line_zh: 通过多智能体在真实容器中合成带可执行判定器的任务，并以前沿采样与滑动视觉窗口做在线 RL，OSWorld 达 68.7%。

title_zh: StructAgent：以统一因果结构驾驭长程数字智能体
one_line: Planner-actor-verifier loop commits progress to typed state only on verifier evidence; OSWorld-Verified gains on three backbones under matched runners; single run; verifier validated against checker.
one_line_zh: 以规划-执行-验证循环且仅凭验证证据更新统一任务状态，在三种骨干上于 OSWorld-Verified 显著提升，并迁移到网页与 Minecraft。

title_zh: KnowAct-GUIClaw：知深行精——具备自演化记忆与技能的个人GUI助手
one_line: Host plus GUI-subagent framework with self-evolving experience memory and validated skills/shortcuts; MobileWorld pass@1 24.8→37.9 for Qwen-35B, single runs, memory from same benchmark.
one_line_zh: 宿主-GUI子代理框架，结合自演化经验记忆与状态校验技能；MobileWorld单次成功率24.8升至37.9，记忆来自同一基准。

title_zh: PalmClaw：面向手机的原生端侧智能体框架
one_line: On-device mobile agent framework replacing GUI actions with schema- and permission-checked device tools; 97.1% vs 87.1% on a 70-task in-house set, single run, no ablation.
one_line_zh: 在手机端运行的智能体框架，用带参数校验和权限边界的设备工具取代GUI操作；70任务自建集上97.1%对87.1%，单次运行。

title_zh: Tactile：为计算机使用智能体装上“手脚”
one_line: MCP tool layer compiling accessibility, OCR and visual fallback into ranked actionable targets with post-action verification; macOSWorld Codex Success@100 41.1→50.0%, no uncertainty.
one_line_zh: MCP工具层，将无障碍语义、OCR与视觉兜底编译为可执行目标候选并在动作后验证；macOSWorld上Codex成功率41.1%升至50.0%。

title_zh: HyMobileAgent：面向高效GUI智能体的数据-环境协同扩展
one_line: A3B mobile agent trained through perception, video-knowledge and million-scale trajectory pipelines plus mock-app environments and SFT+RL; AndroidWorld 82.6%, no component ablations.
one_line_zh: 基于Hy3.0-VL-A3B的移动GUI智能体，结合感知飞轮、视频知识、百万级轨迹与模拟应用环境及SFT+RL训练；AndroidWorld 82.6%。

title_zh: Plover：通过以计划为中心的交互引导GUI智能体
one_line: Plan-centric planner–executor GUI system with editable plans, screenshot annotation and visible replanning; first-author interventions repair 23/26 failed OSWorld-Verified tasks, no user study.
one_line_zh: 以计划为中心的规划-执行GUI系统，支持可编辑计划、截图标注与显式重规划；第一作者干预修复26个失败任务中的23个。

title_zh: SeerGuard：基于世界模型预测的移动GUI智能体安全框架
one_line: Separate safety-augmented world model screens instructions and predicts each proposed action's consequence to refuse risky steps; MobileSafetyBench RCS 0.347→0.135, no adaptive attacks.
one_line_zh: 独立的安全增强世界模型先筛查指令，再预测每个候选动作的后果以拒绝高风险操作；风险代价分0.347降至0.135。

title_zh: SEE：面向长程GUI智能体轨迹合成的结构感知探索与利用
one_line: Builds verified screen–element transition graphs by guided exploration, then composes long trajectories via graph search with LLM-written instructions; offline AndroidControl SR gains of 0.8–7.7.
one_line_zh: 通过引导式探索构建经校验的屏幕-元素转移图，再用图搜索组合长轨迹并由LLM生成指令；AndroidControl离线成功率小幅提升。

title_zh: StateAct：面向长程计算机使用智能体的“先程序状态、后像素”
one_line: Code-first harness acting on program state with a GUI subagent, narration-blind finish gate and fresh-context delegation; OSWorld 2.0 Opus 4.8 20.6→26.9%, ~9x cheaper.
one_line_zh: 以代码直接操作程序状态为主、GUI子代理为辅，并配独立完成校验与上下文管理；OSWorld 2.0成功率20.6%升至26.9%，成本降约9倍。

title_zh: 以视觉状态转移扩展GUI智能体
one_line: Continual pretraining of a unified multimodal model on forward and inverse GUI dynamics before trajectory SFT; offline gains +0.6 to +6.2 points, no online evaluation.
one_line_zh: 在轨迹微调前，用前向与逆向GUI动力学目标继续预训练统一多模态模型；离线基准提升0.6至6.2个点，无在线评测。

title_zh: 面向自我纠错网页智能体的可证伪承诺规划
one_line: Plans as falsifiable commitments whose evidence is tested before and after actions, with scope-aware repair and WebArena-derived skills; WebArena 57.4→65.3% at equal backbone.
one_line_zh: 将计划步骤表示为带确认与证伪证据的承诺，在动作前后检验并按范围修复；WebArena平均成功率57.4%升至65.3%。

title_zh: Qwen-UI-Agent 技术报告：面向真实世界的下一代基础 GUI 智能体
one_line: Foundation GUI agent trained by SFT and online RL over sandboxes and 100+ real phones with GUI+CLI batched actions; strong live mobile, desktop, web results.
one_line_zh: 基于沙箱与百余台真机的SFT+在线RL基础GUI智能体，统一GUI+CLI批量动作，在移动、桌面、网页在线基准上表现领先。

title_zh: GUI 智能体为何正确却迟到？在决策关键路径上解码——以预编译策略树验证
one_line: Frozen model precompiles a guarded policy tree during idle time and a fast observer routes events; pre-registered paired trials on timed GUI prompts.
one_line_zh: 冻结模型在空闲时预编译带守卫的条件策略树，事件发生时轻量观察器直接路由执行；以预注册配对实验在限时GUI任务上验证。

title_zh: MAGA：基于结构化动作蒸馏的多平台 GUI 智能体自融合
one_line: Fuses mobile, desktop and web teachers into one student via single-step on-policy distillation reweighted by rule-checked action type/parameter correctness; online SR gains ~2 points.
one_line_zh: 通过按规则判定动作类型/参数正确性重新分配权重的单步在策略蒸馏，将移动、桌面、网页专家融合为单一学生模型；在线成功率提升约2个点。

title_zh: RMSWeb：面向网页智能体强化学习的反思式采集、失败模式挖掘与 Salvage-DS
one_line: Reflection-conditioned teacher collection, SFT-failure state mining and gated offline step-level GRPO with an action anchor; live-web gains of 1.2-7.7 points over SFT.
one_line_zh: 反思式教师轨迹采集、挖掘SFT失败关键状态，并用带门控与动作锚定的离线单步GRPO训练；在线网页基准较SFT提升1.2-7.7分。

title_zh: Qwen-CUA：面向（几乎）一切的原生计算机使用智能体
one_line: Screenshot-only 397B MoE agent trained with SFT and outcome-reward RL on 40K verifiable tasks with folded visual history; 86.2 OSWorld-Verified across eight live benchmarks.
one_line_zh: 仅用截图与键鼠的397B MoE智能体，在4万可验证任务上进行SFT与结果奖励RL并折叠视觉历史；8个在线基准中OSWorld-Verified达86.2。

title_zh: CUADebug：诊断与修复计算机使用智能体的失败
one_line: ReAct debugger inspects before/after screenshots to localise failed trajectories' root-cause step, validated on 204 human-annotated OSWorld failures; diagnosis-guided re-rollout doubles recovery.
one_line_zh: ReAct调试器检查前后截图定位失败轨迹的根因步骤，在204条人工标注OSWorld失败轨迹上验证；诊断引导的重执行使恢复率翻倍。

title_zh: GUI-Lens：基于通用视觉语言模型的由粗到细裁剪式 GUI 定位
one_line: Training-free grounding: VLM picks successive crop regions with OCR/detector coordinate references and self-verification; large ScreenSpot-Pro gains, small OSWorld check.
one_line_zh: 免训练定位框架：通用VLM借助OCR/检测坐标参考逐级选择裁剪区域并自我验证，ScreenSpot-Pro大幅提升，另有OSWorld小规模在线验证。

title_zh: FocusMem：在潜在 GUI 记忆中分解内容、读出与信任
one_line: Frozen-policy latent memory with role-aware content basis, state-conditioned readout and trust gate; matched gains on five live web benchmarks, Gemini-judged.
one_line_zh: 冻结策略下的潜在记忆：角色感知内容基、状态条件读出与信任门控，在五个在线网页基准上优于匹配基线，成功率由Gemini评判。

title_zh: Q-Reflector：借助生成的前后置条件学习 GUI 动作反思
one_line: Trained 8B post-action reflector generates pre/post-conditions then judges before/after screenshots; validated on labelled transitions, lifts live MobileWorld success for two policies.
one_line_zh: 训练8B独立反思器，先生成前后置条件再判断动作前后截图；在人工标注转移上双向验证，并提升两种策略在MobileWorld上的在线成功率。

title_zh: 活动帧：面向智能体记忆与回放的确定性屏幕活动编译
one_line: Deterministic zero-model compiler turns passive screen capture into typed activity frames as agent memory; single-user QA accuracy and token savings, one replay demo.
one_line_zh: 零模型确定性编译器把被动屏幕采集转成类型化活动帧供智能体记忆；单用户问答准确率与token节省，仅一次回放演示。

title_zh: AppDeltaWorld：面向移动GUI智能体的转移约束增量代码世界模型
one_line: Mobile world model generating next-screen HTML as a delta from retrieved app-specific references; its filtered rollouts, mixed with public data, modestly lift online success.
one_line_zh: 以检索到的应用参考HTML为基础增量生成下一屏的世界模型，其过滤后的轨迹与公开数据混合训练，小幅提升在线成功率。

title_zh: 下一张截图知道答案：面向移动GUI智能体的门控后见蒸馏
one_line: Adds next-screenshot-conditioned self-teacher distillation, gated on student failure, to offline step GRPO; three-seed gains on AndroidWorld and AndroidLab.
one_line_zh: 在离线单步GRPO上加入以下一张截图为特权信息的自蒸馏，仅在学生失败且教师纠正时启用，在AndroidWorld和AndroidLab上多次运行均提升。

title_zh: 基于免回归布局感知匹配的无幻觉GUI定位
one_line: Frozen MLLM elaborates the instruction; a Text/Icon detector proposes boxes and CLIP with a linear geometry offset picks one; offline grounding and step-accuracy gains only.
one_line_zh: 冻结MLLM细化指令描述，文本/图标检测器产生候选框，CLIP加线性几何偏置选框；仅有离线定位与单步准确率证据。

title_zh: LookAgain：基于视觉锚定反思的闭环GUI定位
one_line: Grounder iterates locate (marker plus crop of its own guess) and confirm/refuse, trained by SFT cold start then GRPO; offline grounding gains only.
one_line_zh: 定位器反复执行“定位（在自身预测处标记并裁剪）—确认/拒绝”，经SFT冷启动与GRPO训练；仅在离线定位基准上提升。

title_zh: CoAdapt-GUI：面向未见GUI应用的工作流上下文与策略联合自适应
one_line: Test-time adaptation on unseen apps jointly evolves a reward-rated workflow context and a LoRA policy from own rollouts; held-out apps and templates, multi-run.
one_line_zh: 在未见应用上测试时自适应，用自身轨迹与奖励同时演化工作流上下文并更新LoRA策略；在独立的应用与任务模板上评估。

title_zh: SynWeaver：基于网站先验的网页智能体任务与轨迹协同合成
one_line: DFS website maps train a site-aware task proposer; teachers co-refine task and trajectory, then verify; SFT gains on WebArena and out-of-domain WebVoyager.
one_line_zh: 以DFS网站地图训练具备站点先验的任务提议模型，教师模型协同修正任务与轨迹并校验；SFT后在WebArena及域外WebVoyager上提升。

title_zh: UI-Mate：借助上下文示范推进开源权重基础GUI智能体
one_line: Open-weight desktop agent from a verifier-bundled data engine, SFT and online RL, plus demonstration-to-workflow conditioning; strong OSWorld-Verified and WindowsAgentArena results.
one_line_zh: 基于带验证器的数据引擎、SFT与在线RL训练的开源桌面智能体，并可将示范转为子任务工作流作为上下文；在OSWorld-Verified与WAA上表现强劲。

title_zh: Wuying-Browser-Agent：面向真实世界的长程基础浏览器智能体
one_line: Browser agent trained with recovery- and complex-UI curriculum SFT, then online GRPO with progress shaping and divergence weighting; live-web gains over SFT across three scales.
one_line_zh: 浏览器智能体先经含错误恢复与复杂控件数据的课程SFT，再以进度奖励塑形与分歧加权的在线GRPO优化；三种规模在真实网页基准上均优于SFT。

title_zh: 从计算机使用轨迹中归纳任务模型
one_line: LLM pipeline turns raw human computer-use traces into latent tasks with goal hierarchies and loop-aware procedures; LLM-judged fidelity and modest held-out skill gains.
one_line_zh: 用LLM流水线把原始人类电脑操作轨迹解析为潜在任务及其目标层级与含循环的流程模型；以LLM评审衡量保真度，生成技能在留出任务上小幅提升。

title_zh: 超越成败：面向GUI智能体的长度感知对比学习
one_line: Contrastive RLVR objective prefers shorter successes and later-diverging failures in online OSWorld RL; small gains over GRPO/REAL, trained and evaluated on the same tasks.
one_line_zh: 在线OSWorld强化学习中的对比式RLVR目标，偏好更短的成功轨迹与更晚偏离的失败轨迹；相对GRPO/REAL小幅提升，但训练与评测使用同一任务集。

title_zh: 面向多智能体计算机使用的主干-分支协调
one_line: Manager decomposes tasks into a VM-state spine plus disposable parallel branches; Odysseys success up 6-16.5 points over MACU at lower cost, three runs.
one_line_zh: 主干保留VM状态、分支并行收集信息，Odysseys成功率高于MACU且更省钱。

title_zh: CONTRAMEM：从多模型对比轨迹中学习自演化程序性记忆
one_line: Training-free procedural memory distilled from contrasting multi-model trajectories into curated cards; GAIA2/ARE held-out success 26.2%->55.3%, AppWorld gains.
one_line_zh: 对比多模型轨迹提炼函数卡与技能卡，GAIA2留出成功率26.2%升至55.3%。

title_zh: CausalCache：面向长程GUI智能体的条件式高保真恢复
one_line: Text history plus a learned selector restoring which past screenshots fill a fixed image budget; desktop-trained, zero-shot MobileWorld 30.2%->36.8%.
one_line_zh: 学习选择哪些历史截图占用固定预算，桌面训练零样本移动端提升6.6点。

title_zh: GSAR：面向移动GUI智能体的目标状态锚点奖励与自演化数据合成
one_line: VLM outcome reward anchored on annotated goal-state screenshots plus self-evolving task synthesis; >90% offline verification accuracy, AndroidWorld 26.7%->30.2%.
one_line_zh: 以锚定目标状态截图辅助VLM判奖励，离线验证超90%，在线RL有提升。

title_zh: 基于动作诱发视觉差异的桌面GUI智能体反思
one_line: Reflector decouples SoM-marked visual-diff evidence from outcome verification; three-run OSWorld-Verified +5.94 and WindowsAgentArena +4.95 points across four backbones.
one_line_zh: 反思器先提取差异证据再判定结果，OSWorld与WAA三次平均提升约5点。

title_zh: 从盲目编辑到验证修复：构建可信的用户端LLM网页无障碍智能体
one_line: Local-LLM browser extension injecting CSS for accessibility; blind edits help and harm equally, so an audit-inject-verify loop accepts only violation-reducing edits.
one_line_zh: 本地小模型注入无障碍CSS盲改利弊相当，提出仅接受改进的验证循环。

title_zh: LocalLSTC：面向本地部署GUI智能体的长短期控制架构
one_line: Training-free loop keeping a persistent subgoal/evidence/feedback state with step abstraction and final verification; Qwen3.8-27B reaches 73.7% OSWorld, 68.5% WindowsAgentArena.
one_line_zh: 免训练维护持久子目标与证据状态，本地27B模型OSWorld达73.7%。

title_zh: ASIL：以结构化状态与语义动作取代截图加点击
one_line: Agent-software layer exposing structured JSON state and semantic code actions across 15 apps; ~81% vs 6.6-26.6% GUI success, SFT/RL gains for small models.
one_line_zh: 用结构化状态与语义动作替代截图点击，成功率约81%远超GUI控制。

title_zh: WM-R1：用强化学习训练GUI智能体推理并利用世界模型
one_line: GRPO trains mobile agents entirely inside a frozen Code2World world model with in-thought simulation calls; AndroidWorld 7B 39.8 vs UI-R1 30.8.
one_line_zh: 完全在世界模型中用GRPO训练手机智能体，AndroidWorld达39.8。

title_zh: Iron：增强通用虚拟智能体的意图对齐与回顾式对偶学习框架
one_line: Self-training with intent-action cycle-consistency rewards in MCTS and hindsight relabelling of failed trajectories; gains on OSWorld, AndroidWorld and unseen VisualWebArena.
one_line_zh: 循环一致性奖励引导MCTS并回顾重标注失败轨迹，跨平台自训练提升。

title_zh: 为 LLM 网页智能体学习简单的测试时环境
one_line: Agent decomposes observations into sub-goals and pruned sub-observations, adapted by self-assessed test-time RL; WebArena 12.1->21.0, WorkArena transfer.
one_line_zh: 测试时分解网页观测为子目标与子观测，自评强化学习提升并可迁移。

title_zh: UI-Venus-2 技术报告
one_line: Multi-platform GUI foundation model trained by mid-training, step-level offline RL and action-aware multi-teacher distillation; strong online mobile, desktop and web results.
one_line_zh: 跨平台GUI基础模型，经中期训练、离线强化学习与多教师蒸馏取得强结果。

title_zh: OmegaUse-SOP：基于人类演示的专业计算机使用 SOP 工程
one_line: Expert demonstrations recorded and abstracted by a VLM into parameterised SOP skills with step verification; 5 PVsyst tasks, expert-judged, best of three.
one_line_zh: 把专家演示抽象为可配置SOP技能执行，在5个专业软件任务上提升。

title_zh: 面向网页智能体的判别式世界模型
one_line: World model trained by predicted-state matching to discriminate candidate outcomes; improves PRM ranking and WebArena-Lite Best-of-5 selection 21.8->28.5.
one_line_zh: 判别式世界模型让预测状态区分候选动作结果，提升排序与端到端成功率。

title_zh: GUI 智能体知道何时不该行动吗？面向多模态 GUI 智能体的冲突感知终止
one_line: Feasibility prompt plus conditional activation steering makes GUI agents terminate on infeasible instructions; offline step-wise ConflictGUI conflict SR 6.9->58.6.
one_line_zh: 可行性提示加条件激活引导，使GUI智能体在冲突指令下主动终止。

title_zh: 从交互轨迹到持久技能：计算机使用智能体的在线演化
one_line: Fixed executor-grounder stack gains an evolving versioned skill library from its own OSWorld runs; +5.7 to +18.6 points over empty-library control, single run.
one_line_zh: 固定执行栈靠自身轨迹演化版本化技能库，较空库对照提升，仅单次运行。

title_zh: SCAFFOLD：通过递归参数化技能抽象实现自我改进的网页智能体
one_line: Induces recursive parametric skills from own successes, MDL-compacts the library and distils into weights; WebArena 42.7, held-out Online-Mind2Web sites 43.5.
one_line_zh: 归纳递归参数化技能，MDL压缩并蒸馏回权重，在留出站点上显著提升。

title_zh: 何时教、教什么：面向网页智能体的预算感知在线适应
one_line: Online student DPO/SimPO against teacher trajectories, gated by k-NN teacher solvability and log-prob turn trimming; similar MiniWoB/TimeWarp success, fewer calls and FLOPs.
one_line_zh: 按可解性门控求教并裁剪轮次做偏好优化，节省教师调用与训练算力。

title_zh: 面向应用流的持续 GUI 智能体学习中的选择性知识控制
one_line: Continual OSWorld RL over an 8-app stream with activation-conditioned neuron gradient truncation/projection; beats sequential, replay, EWC and LoRA baselines.
one_line_zh: 应用流上持续强化学习，按激活截断或正交投影神经元梯度以减轻遗忘。

title_zh: 通过自生成工具动作提升安卓 GUI 智能体的熟练度与效率
one_line: Agentic workflow generates and relation-tests Python tools over app state, added to Android GUI actions; +4.47 points and 20% fewer steps over GUI-only.
one_line_zh: 自动生成并测试操作应用状态的工具加入安卓动作空间，提升成功率减步数。

title_zh: TRACE：面向高效GUI智能体的轨迹鲁棒准入与证据排序
one_line: Training-free nested visual-token pruning plus KV contraction for GUI agent histories; beats pruning baselines at matched budgets offline, 2.4x faster TTFT.
one_line_zh: 免训练的嵌套视觉token剪枝与KV收缩，离线基准上在同等预算下优于剪枝基线，首token延迟快2.4倍。

title_zh: JarvisGUI：通过动态任务组合迈向跨设备GUI智能体
one_line: Cross-device executable benchmark (Android/Windows/Ubuntu) composing typed atomic tasks with state checkers; open agents near zero on dependent multi-device workflows.
one_line_zh: 跨安卓/Windows/Ubuntu的可执行基准，以类型系统组合原子任务并用终态检查器评分；开源智能体在依赖型跨设备任务上近乎零分。

title_zh: BlueLM-GUI技术报告：以真机为中心的自我改进移动GUI智能体飞轮
one_line: 35B-A3B mobile agent trained CPT→SFT→online GRPO on real phones with judge reward and failure repair; AndroidWorld 84.9, online RL beats offline replay.
one_line_zh: 35B-A3B移动智能体在真机上经CPT、SFT与在线GRPO训练并修复失败轨迹；AndroidWorld达84.9，在线RL优于离线回放。

title_zh: LLaDA-UI：将块式扩散引入视觉-语言GUI智能体
one_line: 16.7B MoE block-diffusion VLM SFT'd as an end-to-end GUI agent; online mobile/desktop/web results near Qwen3-VL-8B with 3.6-9x lower latency.
one_line_zh: 16.7B MoE块式扩散视觉语言模型经SFT成为端到端GUI智能体；移动/桌面/网页在线结果接近Qwen3-VL-8B，延迟低3.6-9倍。

title_zh: 基于应用行为建模的Web智能体高效令牌任务执行
one_line: OdoBot builds an event-graph behaviour model from demonstrations and replays it with minimal LLM calls; 45 Canvas tasks, 44-80% fewer tokens than Agent-E/WebVoyager.
one_line_zh: OdoBot从演示构建应用事件图行为模型并以极少LLM调用回放；在45个Canvas任务上比Agent-E/WebVoyager省44-80%令牌。

title_zh: AutoTailor：面向Web智能体的自动化、用户对齐能力选择与自适应
one_line: Converts web trajectories into filtered MCP browser-API tools with usage-driven reselection; WebArena Postmill 90.6% vs ReAct 87.5%, 57.8% fewer tokens, calibrated on test tasks.
one_line_zh: 将网页轨迹转为经筛选的MCP浏览器API工具并按使用动态重选；WebArena Postmill正确率90.6%对ReAct 87.5%，令牌降57.8%，但在测试任务上校准。

title_zh: 从可靠负样本中学习：面向GUI定位的置信度锚定测试时自适应
one_line: Label-free test-time GRPO for GUI grounding using coordinate-token-confidence pseudo-labels and negative-only advantages; ScreenSpot-Pro 24.9→33.8, trained on test sets.
one_line_zh: 利用坐标token置信度伪标签与仅负样本优势做无标注测试时GRPO定位训练；ScreenSpot-Pro由24.9升至33.8，但在测试集上训练。

title_zh: RSIAgent：新环境中面向递归自我改进的自主探索
one_line: Training-free curriculum-actor-verifier exploration builds frozen environment memory; OSWorld 2.0 partial 71.97→78.98, but exploration is conditioned on target test queries.
one_line_zh: 免训练的课程-执行-验证多智能体探索构建冻结环境记忆；OSWorld 2.0部分分由71.97升至78.98，但探索以测试目标查询为参照。

title_zh: AnchorGUI：面向GUI导航双尺度学习的非对称记忆
one_line: Per-step expected-vs-observed verdict keeps screenshots only for mismatches and focuses cross-trial distillation; AndroidWorld SR@1 57.3 (ReAct 43.7), 2.4x fewer tokens.
one_line_zh: 每步比较预期与实际转移，仅为不符步骤保留截图并聚焦跨轮蒸馏；AndroidWorld单次成功率57.3（ReAct 43.7），令牌减少2.4倍。

title_zh: EchoPath：面向GUI智能体的执行级可回放记忆
one_line: Converts validated GUI runs into precondition-gated callable memories replayed with image-based re-aiming; OSWorld-Verified rerun 91.2% at ~20k vs 586k tokens, same tasks.
one_line_zh: 将已验证GUI轨迹转为带前置条件门控、可调用的记忆并以图像重定位回放；OSWorld-Verified重跑成功率91.2%，令牌约2万对58.6万，但为同一任务。

title_zh: 反思、修订、复用：面向GUI智能体的免训练技能演化
one_line: Training-free reflect-revise-reuse loop evolves structured skill packages; online gains on MobileWorld, AndroidWorld, OSWorld, but skills are revised on the test tasks themselves.
one_line_zh: 免训练的反思-修订-复用循环演化结构化技能包，在MobileWorld/AndroidWorld/OSWorld在线提升，但技能在测试任务上反复修订。

title_zh: RankGround：基于轻量级重排序器引导裁剪选择的高效高分辨率GUI定位
one_line: A trained reranker selects one high-resolution crop for a single grounder call; ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy beats ZoomIn/MVP at lower latency, grounding-only evaluation.
one_line_zh: 训练轻量重排序器挑选高分辨率裁剪区域，仅调用一次定位模型；ScreenSpot-Pro精度与延迟优于ZoomIn/MVP，仅离线定位评测。

title_zh: EconSkills：面向实时经济数据的网页智能体技能迁移与检索研究
one_line: Verified EconWebArena trajectories become parameterised SOP skills injected into prompts; matched skills lift live success 41.0→49.3 (3 runs), library retrieval only ties baseline.
one_line_zh: 将验证过的EconWebArena轨迹提炼为参数化SOP技能注入提示；匹配技能使实时成功率41.0升至49.3，全库检索仅与基线持平。

title_zh: MintAct：面向数字环境的统一视觉智能体
one_line: One 2B-8B VLM unifies grounding, mobile/desktop/web navigation and tool use via SFT, specialist distillation and joint async online RL; OSWorld-Verified 48.9.
one_line_zh: 以SFT、专家蒸馏与异步在线联合强化学习训练统一2B-8B视觉智能体，覆盖定位、多端导航与工具调用；OSWorld-Verified达48.9。

title_zh: 超越任务完成：训练兼具能力与安全的计算机使用智能体
one_line: Joint SFT on capability, safe-continuation and refusal trajectories then online RL; Qwen3.5-9B reaches OSWorld 54.17% with 64.30% OS-BLIND attack avoidance, no adaptive attacks.
one_line_zh: 联合能力、安全续行与拒绝轨迹做SFT后在线RL；Qwen3.5-9B在OSWorld达54.17%，OS-BLIND避免攻击率64.30%，未测自适应攻击。

title_zh: 一个数字值多少像素？面向GUI智能体置信度估计的位值感知坐标熵
one_line: Weights coordinate-digit entropy by place value for single-pass click confidence; best AUROC/AUARC on ScreenSpot-Pro/v2 versus 12 baselines, no closed-loop agent test.
one_line_zh: 按位值加权坐标数字熵，单次前向得到点击置信度；在ScreenSpot-Pro/v2上AUROC与AUARC优于12个基线，未做闭环智能体测试。

title_zh: 基于掩码轨迹预测的全维度GUI智能体导航
one_line: Masked trajectory prediction with role-routed LoRA adapters unifies heterogeneous navigation data; small offline step-SR gains over equal-data direct mixing, small AndroidWorld check.
one_line_zh: 以掩码轨迹预测和角色路由LoRA适配器统一异构导航数据；相比等量直接混合训练离线步成功率小幅提升，AndroidWorld仅小规模验证。

title_zh: 从自身交互中学会行动：面向GUI智能体的在策略自蒸馏
one_line: Two-stage on-policy self-distillation with Kimi-K3 reasoning/memory privileges and privilege-following GRPO; Qwen3-VL-8B AndroidWorld 40.5→67.2 pass@1, single backbone size.
one_line_zh: 两阶段在策略自蒸馏，结合Kimi-K3推理/记忆特权与特权跟随GRPO；Qwen3-VL-8B的AndroidWorld pass@1从40.5升至67.2，仅单一规模。

title_zh: 通过过滤改进基于大语言模型的自主网页智能体
one_line: A DeBERTa ranker trained on Mind2Web keeps the top half of a11y-tree elements; WebArena SR rises 1.97→2.96 for LLaMA-2-70B but drops for GPT-3.5.
one_line_zh: 在Mind2Web上训练DeBERTa排序器保留可访问性树前50%元素；LLaMA-2-70B的WebArena成功率1.97升至2.96，GPT-3.5反降。

title_zh: Qwen-Planner-Agent：面向真实移动端规划智能体的闭环AI-for-AI框架
one_line: Closed-loop data flywheel, SFT plus hybrid-environment online RL (CARE) and harness co-evolution for a tool-calling mobile planner; MobilePA-Bench 67.22→77.05, single runs.
one_line_zh: 以数据飞轮、SFT加混合环境在线RL（CARE）及模型-Harness协同演化训练工具调用式移动规划智能体；MobilePA-Bench由67.22升至77.05。

title_zh: Jev-Mobile：以 Jev 作为移动端 GUI 智能体的执行器
one_line: A VLM sets local goals while a typed decision model executes several accessibility-tree actions per goal; near-baseline AndroidWorld success with lower latency and cost.
one_line_zh: VLM低频设定局部目标，类型化决策模型在无障碍树候选中连续执行多步，AndroidWorld成功率接近基线且时延与成本更低。

title_zh: 从点击到跳转：用应用原生深度链接增强移动端 GUI 智能体
one_line: Adds verified app deeplinks as tool actions beside GUI actions, trained by hybrid SFT and online RL; higher MobileWorld and real-device success with fewer steps.
one_line_zh: 将经真机验证的应用深度链接作为工具动作与GUI操作混合，经SFT与在线RL训练，在MobileWorld及真机上成功率更高、步数更少。

title_zh: REBASE：跨应用更新的GUI智能体端云经验一致性
one_line: Keeps cached on-device action-path experience coherent after app updates via cloud replay, step verification and staged-evidence patches; restores success at far lower bytes.
one_line_zh: 应用更新后通过云端回放、端侧逐步校验与分级证据补丁保持端云经验一致，以极少流量恢复成功率。

title_zh: PastForward：通过计算经验复用加速端侧GUI智能体
one_line: Reuses past output token sequences as verified speculative proposals, predicted next screens for early inference, and carried KV state; 1.4-2.4x faster steps, same AndroidWorld success.
one_line_zh: 复用历史输出token序列做可验证的推测解码、用历史转移预测下一屏提前推理并延续KV状态，步时延提速1.4-2.4倍且成功率不变。

title_zh: GUI不等于状态：诊断GUI世界模型中的状态混叠
one_line: Shows observation-only GUI world models fail on hidden-state strict pairs and adds a distilled history-based state estimator to frozen WMs; small AndroidWorld gains.
one_line_zh: 揭示仅依赖观测的GUI世界模型在隐藏状态严格配对上失效，为冻结世界模型加入从历史恢复结构化状态的估计器，AndroidWorld小幅提升。

title_zh: CUA-Sandbox：面向计算机使用智能体强化学习的高效环境
one_line: Separates per-rollout state capsules from shared initialized runtimes with transactional reset/fork; matches Docker success on WebArena, VWA, OSWorld with up to 6.2x throughput.
one_line_zh: 将每条轨迹的可变状态胶囊与共享运行时分离并支持事务式重置/分叉，在WebArena等上成功率不低于Docker，吞吐最高提升6.2倍。

title_zh: 相关不等于适用：面向个人GUI智能体的经验激活
one_line: Training-free: matches each screen to past personal states to inject one action reference, and gates proactive suggestions by time/scenario; offline AndroidIntent gains.
one_line_zh: 免训练方法：每步按骨干潜空间将当前屏幕匹配到个人历史状态并注入对应动作参考，主动建议按时间与场景门控，离线基准提升。

title_zh: 先探查再行动：通过主动视觉探查提升浏览器智能体
one_line: Replaces static DOM Set-of-Marks with on-demand probes rendering DOM elements to pixels and back, plus evidence-only memory; prompted and distilled agents gain on VisualWebArena.
one_line_zh: 以按需探查替代静态SoM，在DOM与像素间双向对齐并仅保留证据记忆，提示与蒸馏模型在VisualWebArena上均提升。

title_zh: 只有一次机会：GUI智能体的完全测试时自适应
one_line: Updates a small adapter during deployment by top-K self-distillation on judge-admitted and hindsight-relabeled own episodes, one attempt per task; +3-6 points on web/mobile streams.
one_line_zh: 部署中基于评判模型筛选及事后重标注的自身轨迹，以top-K自蒸馏更新小适配器，每任务仅一次尝试，网页与移动流上提升3-6点。

title_zh: 行动之前先改变状态：欺骗性界面下Web智能体的前瞻式状态干预
one_line: Runtime defense that detects unauthorized consequences and plans then executes verified browser actions to change consequence-causing web state; highest safe task completion on dark-pattern benchmarks.
one_line_zh: 运行时防御：识别动作的未授权后果，先规划再经验证地执行浏览器操作改变致害网页状态，在暗模式基准上安全完成率最高。

title_zh: PhoneCLI：将应用界面编译为移动智能体可调用的命令
one_line: Offline app exploration compiles navigation into deterministic replay commands with VLM fallback; online AndroidLab/AndroidWorld gains, but maps built on evaluated apps, single run.
one_line_zh: 离线探索应用编译导航命令回放，AndroidLab在线提升，但地图建于被测应用

title_zh: SPECTRA：面向自主端云协同GUI定位的端侧认知扰动与轨迹分析
one_line: Edge grounder decides cloud offloading from saliency-masked prefill hidden-state divergence; offline grounding benchmarks only, beats uncertainty baselines at matched samples with cost reported.
one_line_zh: 扰动隐状态发散决定端云请求，仅离线定位基准，附成本对比

title_zh: 面向复杂网页任务的结构化交互、视觉定位与鲁棒执行：WebRetriever挑战赛技术报告
one_line: Challenge-winning web agent: accessibility-first actions, grid visual localisation, summarised history, fault recovery; 59% live pass rate, no baselines or ablations.
one_line_zh: 竞赛冠军网页智能体，结构优先加视觉兜底，在线59%但无基线消融

title_zh: PrecogUI：基于预认知模拟与经验检索的主动式GUI智能体
one_line: One-step layout world model ranks candidate actions with anomaly rules plus experience memory; offline AndroidControl and in-house perturbation replays, no search or cost baselines.
one_line_zh: 单步布局世界模型为候选动作排序，仅离线与自建回放评测

title_zh: 神经符号计算机使用：学习可复用策略以实现可靠高效执行
one_line: Judge-guided policy iteration turns one agent trajectory into a reusable code policy with neural primitives; OSWorld/ScienceBoard Pass^3 gains, much cheaper, judges validated.
one_line_zh: 评判器引导迭代出可复用代码策略，OSWorld可靠性升且成本大降

title_zh: SCA：面向GUI智能体强化学习的空间信用分配
one_line: Refines GRPO click credit with held-out spatial residuals and target proximity; three-seed offline grounding gains of ~1 point over reported GUI-R1, 3B only.
one_line_zh: 空间残差细化GRPO点击信用，三种子离线约提升1点，仅3B

title_zh: HybridCUA：学习为计算机使用智能体编排GUI与CLI
one_line: Trains a 9B CUA on GUI, CLI and interleaved trajectories with SFT then CLI-aware RL; abstract-only, reported OSWorld 53.6%.
one_line_zh: GUI与CLI混合轨迹SFT加CLI感知RL，仅摘要，OSWorld 53.6%

title_zh: 面向GUI智能体记忆的动作条件互模拟
one_line: Merges memory states by action-conditioned bisimulation instead of observation similarity; closed-loop MiniWoB++ +6.0 SR over ReAct with matched controls, single seed, 10 tasks.
one_line_zh: 动作条件互模拟合并记忆状态，MiniWoB++闭环提升6点，单种子

title_zh: 在不完美先验下学习可靠的GUI智能体
one_line: Self-explored UI graphs give retrieved trajectory priors; drift-perturbed training teaches follow/partial/ignore decisions; offline and online gains over SFT, priors still hurt AndroidWorld.
one_line_zh: 自探索先验加漂移扰动训练学会取舍先验，在线离线均优于SFT

title_zh: ComputerSD：基于实时反馈的计算机使用智能体在线自蒸馏
one_line: Step-level analyzer feedback gates on-policy self-distillation combined with outcome GRPO; OSWorld-Verified +1.9/+4.1 over GRPO, larger on held-out categories and WindowsAgentArena.
one_line_zh: 步级分析器门控在线自蒸馏，OSWorld较GRPO提升且泛化更好

title_zh: GUI-HARVEST：通过证据驱动的执行框架演化实现自我改进的GUI智能体
one_line: Evolves the executable harness around a frozen GUI model from repeated multimodal runs; held-out OSWorld-Verified gains on six backbones and WAA transfer.
one_line_zh: 用重复执行证据演化冻结模型的执行框架代码，OSWorld留出集提升并迁移WAA。

title_zh: AutoGUIWorld：以图像生成器作为GUI智能体的视觉世界模型
one_line: Planner plus image-editing generator synthesises desktop trajectories without running apps; SFT lifts OSWorld 33.0->40.8 and ScienceBoard 14.0->32.2, single run, no real anchor.
one_line_zh: 图像生成器作世界模型合成桌面轨迹并SFT，OSWorld提升但单次运行无真实锚定

title_zh: 并非所有经验都应写入权重：自我改进GUI智能体的组件路由
one_line: Splits an agent's own experience into locators, procedures, state facts and lessons, routing each to context or weights; checker-scored held-out apps, three backbones and seeds.
one_line_zh: 将自身经验按组件路由到上下文或权重，留出应用、多骨干、三种子验证。

title_zh: 何时编译计算机使用智能体？衡量回本次数并为令牌效率做出编译决策
one_line: Measures cost and payback of compiling repeated GUI procedures into programs and decides online when to compile; simulated streams save 17.3% tokens versus ReAct.
one_line_zh: 测量GUI流程编译为程序的回本次数并在线决定何时编译，模拟中省17.3%令牌。

title_zh: WebFovea：模型正确但点击错误——面向真实网站视觉网页智能体的可靠往返
one_line: Hardens parsing, execution, feedback and observation in a vision web agent's harness; hidden live-site score 31.0->57.0 with one model, single runs, tiny ablations.
one_line_zh: 加固视觉网页智能体执行框架四环节，同模型隐藏集得分31升至57，单次运行。

title_zh: CUAWright：面向数字智能体的极简统一接口
one_line: Replaces GUI-native harnesses with bash as sole action plus a file-system tool workspace; gains on OSWorld 2.0, Online-Mind2Web, Odysseys, CAD, frontier models only.
one_line_zh: 以bash为唯一动作接口加文件系统工具，网页、桌面、CAD均提升，仅用前沿模型。

title_zh: 面向GUI定位的循环潜在视觉搜索
one_line: Recurrent latent visual search: a patch-attention head refines a spatial focus coarse-to-fine in one pass; ScreenSpot-Pro 53.2->56.3 over same-data baseline, grounding only.
one_line_zh: 单次交互内由粗到细的循环潜在视觉搜索，ScreenSpot-Pro升3.1点

title_zh: TeleTune：从离线遥测日志演化智能体技能
one_line: Learns a textual skill library from goal-free, non-replayable logs via teacher-forced action-prediction validation; beats AWM on WorkArena and Online-Mind2Web over three seeds.
one_line_zh: 从无目标不可重放日志学习技能库并离线验证，WorkArena与OM2W优于AWM

title_zh: 想象以行动：基于图像编辑世界模型的高保真数据合成用于可扩展GUI智能体训练
one_line: Delta-text-conditioned image-editing world model synthesises mobile trajectories; synthetic-only SFT lifts AndroidWorld and MobileWorld, but trails real-data SFT; VLM-judged fidelity.
one_line_zh: 差分文本条件图像编辑世界模型合成移动轨迹，纯合成SFT提升但不及真实数据。

title_zh: CLIFT：用于网页智能体训练与测试时扩展的共形自我验证
one_line: Conformally certified self-verification questions densify GRPO step rewards and select among retries at test time; WAI 61.8->74.6, VWA and OM2W transfer, judge-certified only.
one_line_zh: 共形认证自验证问题库加密步级奖励并做测试时轨迹选择，WAI提升12.8点。

title_zh: AMBER：通过仅追加记忆训练长时程网页智能体
one_line: Agent writes a memory entry each step into an append-only bank, trained with outcome RL; beats overwrite memory on WebArena Lite over five seeds.
one_line_zh: 每步写入仅追加记忆并用结果奖励RL训练，WebArena Lite上优于覆盖式记忆。

title_zh: 解耦“做什么”与“在哪里”：小型GUI定位模型应如何接收动作类型？
one_line: Compares five ways to feed action type to a 2B grounder on offline AITW; gains vanish once a serialization artifact is removed.
one_line_zh: 离线比较五种向2B定位模型提供动作类型的方式，去除伪影后增益消失。

title_zh: AdvSim2Real：在网页世界模型中训练网页智能体抵御自适应提示注入
one_line: Co-evolves task curriculum, injection adversary and 4B web agent inside a frozen web world model; judged robustness gains, capability transfers to real browser.
one_line_zh: 在冻结网页世界模型内协同进化课程、注入对手与智能体，能力迁移到真实浏览器。

title_zh: DeltaReplay：面向移动GUI智能体的任务相对记忆复用
one_line: Per-step decision to replay, re-ground parameters of, or discard retrieved trajectory steps; gains on AndroidWorld and SPA-Bench, single runs, LLM-judged success.
one_line_zh: 逐步决定重放、替换参数或丢弃检索到的轨迹步骤，提升移动端任务成功率。

title_zh: CaptchaAgent：面向验证码求解的可验证视觉推理
one_line: Builds a count-committed ASCII entity-relation scene representation, local zoom refinement and transformation-consistency voting before acting; +21-26 Pass@1 on Open CaptchaWorld, single run.
one_line_zh: 先构建ASCII实体关系表示，再局部精修与一致性投票，验证码通过率提升21-26点。

title_zh: Work2Skill：捕获人类GUI经验以归纳可复用的智能体技能
one_line: An agent turns aligned human desktop recordings, input events and AX data into reusable skills; beats demo-based baselines on MyPCBench and OSWorld subset.
one_line_zh: 将对齐的人类桌面录屏与事件归纳为可复用技能，在桌面基准上优于演示基线。

title_zh: ConClick：元素级对比学习提升GUI定位
one_line: Trains attention-derived region scores to prefer targets over observed distractor elements, plus zoom revisits at test time; offline grounding gains on ScreenSpot-Pro and OSWorld-G.
one_line_zh: 以对比学习让区域分数偏好目标而非干扰元素，并放大复查，离线定位提升。

title_zh: Web$hell：面向智能体网页访问的统一接口
one_line: Compiles live pages into addressable information and action objects with a persistent cache; beats access-model baselines on six web benchmarks at lower cost.
one_line_zh: 将网页编译为可寻址的信息与动作对象并缓存，六个基准上以更低成本领先。

title_zh: OpenMobile-2：以可扩展环境和应用原生工具构建通用移动智能体
one_line: Resettable simulated commercial apps with programmatic business-state checkers supply SFT/RL data and hybrid GUI-tool tasks; 79.9 AndroidWorld, transfers to real-device SPA-Bench.
one_line_zh: 可重置仿真商业应用与程序化检查器提供训练数据，AndroidWorld达79.9并迁移真机。

title_zh: 面向GUI智能体的潜空间世界-动作模型
one_line: LoRA LMM rescoring a frozen agent's candidate actions, trained with latent next-state contrastive prediction; beats pixel world models on AndroidWorld at far lower latency.
one_line_zh: 以潜空间下一状态对比预测辅助候选动作重打分，优于像素世界模型且更快。

title_zh: 十年一日：从面向人类的软件演化中合成智能体原生接口
one_line: Synthesises agent-native atomic and goal-level commands from desktop app SDKs; artifact-verified tasks show higher success and ~73% fewer tokens than native SDK.
one_line_zh: 从桌面应用SDK合成智能体原生命令接口，在产物校验任务上成功率高于原生SDK且token减少约73%。

title_zh: Seg2Click：为GUI视觉定位学习像素级动作掩码
